REPORT
Date November 29, 19 39.
Subject Foreign Lodging Houses No.91-97 Fearon Road - Cancellation of Licence.
Made by D.S. Mischenko Forwarded by D.S.I. O Atkinson
(批：P.a & D.C (4) Information C 39 P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.))
(印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 30 NOV. 1939 (CRIM. DIV.))
(批：FILE C/)
Mrs. K.V.SIMONOVA, the licensee of Houses No.91-97, Fearon Road, came to this office on November 28, 1939, and informed the undersigned of her intention to cancel the lodging house licence in respect of above premises. She stated that the houses are actually owned and operated by a Mrs. V. Gorskaya with whom she severed all connections.
Mrs. Varvara or Vera Gorskaya, naturalized Japanese subject of Russian origin, who is better known under the name of Viola Smith, C.R.O. F-1096, is a well known brothel keeper in Shanghai. She is at present operating brothels at 650 Wei Hai Wei Road, 50-52 Love Lane, 97 Fearon Road, and it is believed that another establishment numbering some 30 Korean girls, also owned by her, is operating on Boone Road, and is patronized mainly by the Japanese Military.
Following the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese Hostilities locally, Mrs. V. Gorskaya started a transport company and is reported to own about 30 motor-trucks which do business in the Japanese occupied areas. It is also reported that Mrs. V. Gorskaya is engaged in an import and export business and for this purpose she has an office in the Liza Hardoon Building, Nanking Road; the firm being known as the "Oriental Trans-Pacific Syndicates".
There is no definite proof as to the present national status of Mrs. V. Gorskaya available, but it should be mentioned that the records at the Finger Print Bureau show that on 18-4-35, she was charged at the 1st Shanghai Special District Court with keeping open a brothel and sentenced to 10 days detention.

日期 1939年11月29日。
主题：斐伦路（Fearon Road）91-97号外国寄宿舍——执照注销。
由副巡官 Mischenko 编制，经副巡官督察 O Atkinson 转呈
(批注：P.a & D.C (4) 信息 C 39 P.A. 致副警务处长（特科）)
(印：副警务处长 1939年11月30日（犯罪组）)
(批注：归档 C/)
斐伦路91-97号房屋的持照人 K.V.SIMONOVA 女士于1939年11月28日来到本办公室，告知下文签署人其意图注销上述场所的寄宿舍执照。她声称这些房屋实际上由一位 V. Gorskaya 女士所有并经营，她已与此人断绝一切联系。
Varvara 或 Vera Gorskaya 女士，俄裔归化日本臣民，更广为人知的名字是 Viola Smith，刑事记录办公室档案号 F-1096，是上海知名的妓院经营者。她目前在威海卫路650号、爱文义路（Love Lane）50-52号、斐伦路97号经营妓院，据信她在布恩路（Boone Road）还经营着另一家拥有约30名朝鲜女孩的场所，该场所也归她所有，主要顾客为日本军人。
自本地中日敌对行动爆发以来，V. Gorskaya 女士创办了一家运输公司，据报道拥有约30辆卡车，在日本占领区开展业务。另有报道称，V. Gorskaya 女士从事进出口业务，为此她在南京路的李查德·哈同大楼（Liza Hardoon Building）设有办事处；该公司名为“东方跨太平洋辛迪加”（Oriental Trans-Pacific Syndicates）。
目前没有确凿证据证明 V. Gorskaya 女士目前的国籍状态，但应提及的是，指纹局的记录显示，1935年4月18日，她在上海第一特区地方法院被指控开设妓院，并被判处拘留10天。
K.V.Simonova 女士曾任

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C.S.6, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date Feb 25 1936
Subject Notes On Foreign Criminals And Suspects.
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Golder.

The attached which comprises notes on Foreign
Criminals and Suspects has been prepared in accordance with
the instructions of the Acting Commissioner dated November 5,
1935.

In comparison with the information contained in
the notes forwarded by the Straits Settlement Police, the
attached show in many instances a lack of essential detail,
due to the fact that the preparation of these notes is an
innovation.

Part (1) of these notes when complete will
comprise information on approximately 100 persons and include
reference to some 450. To produce a work of informative
value it will be necessary to prepare notes on some 500 persons,
with reference, if the aforementioned ratio is maintained, to
some 2,000. This would entail about 15 months work at the

NOTES ON FOREIGN CRIMINALS
Section C.S.6.
PART I
March 1936.

ABOLNIK, Samuil N., Russian, born at Vilno in 1905
C.R.O.F-746. Files: D.2237, D.6202, C.5353, C.989/32,
I.O. 8646, D.I.S. 1067/33.
Associates:
Pochkovsky. Soolevitch, M. Soolevitch, I.
Beilin, J. Shapoonoff, E.L. Polonetzky.

Following the German occupation of Vilno in 1917
Abolnik and his brother fled to America where they remained for
three months. Samuil went to Harbin and was next heard of in
Tientsin in 1923. Later in the same year he came to Shanghai
and obtained employment with the Commercial Express & Storage Co.
He subsequently worked with various transportation companies until
1930, when he made a trip to Soviet Russia. He first came to
notice locally as the result of his connection with certain
undesirable political intrigue. In November 1931 he was arrested
together with J. Beilin and charged with fraud, but the prosecution
failed. He was again arrested in July 1932 and charged with a
similar offence and sentenced to 10 months imprisonment. He
appealed and the sentence was set aside on January 25, 1933. .
Modus Operandi
Acting as a customs-broker he makes a practice of so
falsifying the accounts of importers whose business he is entrusted
with that they are charged more than the legitimate customs dues.
Last known address: 5. Yang Terrace.

ACKERMAN, Victor A., Russian, born in 1905

ABOLNIK, Samuil N.，俄国人，1905年生于维尔诺（Vilno）
刑事记录办公室档案号 F-746。卷宗：D.2237, D.6202, C.5353, C.989/32,
I.O. 8646, D.I.S. 1067/33。
同伙：
Pochkovsky。Soolevitch, M. Soolevitch, I.
Beilin, J. Shapoonoff, E.L. Polonetzky。

1917年德国占领维尔诺后，阿博尔尼克（Abolnik）与其兄弟逃往美国，在那里停留了三个月。萨穆伊尔（Samuil）前往哈尔滨，随后于1923年在天津出现。同年晚些时候他来到上海，在商业快递与仓储公司（Commercial Express & Storage Co.）谋得职位。此后他在多家运输公司工作，直到1930年前往苏维埃俄国旅行。他最初引起本地当局注意，是因为其与某些不良政治阴谋有关联。1931年11月，他与 J. Beilin 一同被捕并被指控欺诈，但检方起诉失败。1932年7月他再次被捕，被控类似罪行并判处监禁10个月。他提出上诉，判决于1933年1月25日被撤销。
作案手法
作为报关行经纪人，他惯常篡改其所受托处理业务的进口商账目，致使进口商被收取高于合法关税的费用。
最后已知地址：杨氏里5号（5. Yang Terrace）。

ADAMSKY, J.S., alias BUGAEFF, Stanislav, alias DOERN, A.,
born on 31.10.1891, Polish.
C.R.C. 922. Files: Sinza 1473/35. D.1451. E.163/50.
French Police.

Associates:
Dr. Kurt Barth. Neviarovskaya, Mrs.M.F. Estubier, M.

This individual was charged at the Mixed Court on
December 8, 1926 for selling arms and ammunition, and was sentenced
to two years imprisonment and expelled. On July 8, 1932 he
was escorted from Dairen to Shanghai on behalf of the French Police
and was sentenced to a fine of $200 on a charge of fraud.

It is alleged that he makes a practice of smuggling arms
from German ships putting in at wharves in the Wayside District.

On March 6, 1935 he was arrested by the French Police
for participating in the manufacturing of drugs at the residence
of Dr. Kurt Barth on Columbia Road. In this connection he was
sentenced on October 21, 1935 to 18 months imprisonment by the
Shanghai District Court, Nantao. Another associate in this
case, a Dr.Ryabine, who committed suicide as a result of these
disclosures, had been introduced to Adamsky by Dr.Marshad-Marsh.

他在法租界被捕，当时身上藏有部分赃款，并被提起公诉。1934年2月21日，他因此项罪行被判罚款120美元或拘留60天。

出狱后，他与 N. Droos、J. Rojinsky 和 C. MacBain 合伙，在圆明园路149号开设了上海农产品贸易公司（Shanghai Produce Trading Company），并成功从博物馆路128号的 J.E.Turner & Co. 骗取了价值约400美元的货物。仅因威胁对愚蠢到签署某些文件的 C. MacBain 提起诉讼，才追回了这笔钱。这家带有虚假性质的公司在三个月后关闭。

法国警察。

此人于1926年12月8日在会审公廨被控贩卖军火弹药，被判监禁两年并驱逐出境。1932年7月8日，他受法国警方委托，由大连被押解至上海，并因欺诈罪被罚款200美元。

据称，他惯常从停靠在越界筑路区域码头的德国船只上走私军火。

1935年3月6日，他因参与在哥伦比亚路 Kurt Barth 博士寓所制造毒品，被法国警察逮捕。为此，他于1935年10月21日被南市上海地方法院判处监禁18个月。此案中的另一名同伙 Ryabine 博士，因这些揭露而自杀，是由 Marshad-Marsh 博士介绍给 Adamsky 的。

ALPHONSI, P.A., alias ALPHONS, French, born about 1875
Files: D.6695. E.1108.

Associates
Schwartz, Joseph. Nicoli. Bro, Maurice.

This individual resigned from the French Municipal
Police in 1920 or 1922 after having served in the Force for 15
years. He proceeded to France where he remained until about
1923 when he returned to Shanghai almost penniless and
unsuccessfully sought reinstatement in the French Police. After
a period during which he made his living by acting as souteneur
to two French prostitutes, he obtained employment with the late
French lawyer Du Pac de Marsoulies and whilst so employed engaged
in various enterprises of a doubtful character.

In 1930 he left for Indo-China, where he subsequently
served a term of imprisonment for arms smuggling. On his
release from gaol he returned to Shanghai and associated himself
with Chinese criminals. He is known to be active in smuggling
of contraband from French steamers. In April 1935 he was under
the surveillance of the French Police on suspicion of being engaged
in gambling.
Last known address:

阿尔丰西，P.A.（ALPHONSI, P.A.），别名阿尔丰斯（ALPHONS），法国人，约生于1875年

关联人员

此人在法租界巡捕房服役15年后，于1920年或1922年辞职。他前往法国，在那里停留至约1923年，随后身无分文地回到上海，并试图重新加入法租界巡捕房但未获成功。在一段靠为两名法国妓女充当皮条客（souteneur）谋生的时期过后，他受雇于已故的法国律师杜·帕克·德·马苏利耶（Du Pac de Marsoulies），在此期间从事各种性质可疑的活动。

1930年，他前往印度支那，后来因走私武器而服刑。出狱后，他返回上海并与中国罪犯勾结。众所周知，他积极参与从法国轮船上走私违禁品的活动。1935年4月，法国巡捕房因涉嫌其参与赌博而对其实施监视。

ALVAREZ, Juan Jose, Spanish, born about 1894
Files: G.F.55/1. B.3447. A.9398.

Associates:
Price. Garcia. La Fuente.

Alvarez, a Mexican born Spaniard, is of short
stature and of Latin appearance. He is reported to have
served with the French Army during the Great War and to have
deserted from the Foreign Legion. It is also alleged that
he was charged with a criminal offence in Mexico.

In 1926 he became connected with the Price-Garcia
gambling combine and operated a gambling house at No.105 North
Szechuen Road, O.O.L. On December 18, 1927 the premises were
raided by the Chapei Police and 54 persons of divers nationalities
arrested, among them being J.J. Alvarez. His gambling para-
phernalia was seized and Alvarez was handed over to the Mexican
Consul on December 20, 1927. The outcome of the case is
unknown.

In 1928 Alvarez was operating the famous wheel at
No.151C Bubbling Well Road for Garcia, the house being owned
by one La Fuente, an intimate friend of Garcia's. On
April 22, 1928, the Shanghai Municipal Police raided the house,
arrested Alvarez and charged him before the Mexican Consul when
he was fined Pesos 500. He left Shanghai soon after
ostensibly for Mexico, and has not been heard of since.
Last known address:

阿尔瓦雷斯，胡安·何塞（ALVAREZ, Juan Jose），西班牙人，约生于1894年
档案号：G.F.55/1. B.3447. A.9398.

关联人员：
普赖斯（Price）。加西亚（Garcia）。拉富恩特（La Fuente）。

阿尔瓦雷斯是一名出生于墨西哥的西班牙人，身材矮小，具有拉丁人外貌。据报他在第一次世界大战期间曾在法国军队服役，并从外籍军团开小差。另有指控称他在墨西哥曾被控刑事犯罪。

1926年，他与普赖斯-加西亚赌博集团发生联系，并在北四川路105号经营一家赌窟，该处位于越界筑路区域（O.O.L.）。1927年12月18日，闸北警察突袭了该场所，逮捕了54名不同国籍的人，其中包括J.J. 阿尔瓦雷斯。他的赌博用具被没收，阿尔瓦雷斯于1927年12月20日被移交给墨西哥领事。案件结果不详。

1928年，阿尔瓦雷斯在静安寺路151C号为加西亚操作著名的轮盘赌，该房产由加西亚的密友拉富恩特所有。1928年4月22日，上海公共租界工部局警务处突袭了该住所，逮捕了阿尔瓦雷斯，并在墨西哥领事面前对他提出指控，他被罚款500比索。此后不久，他表面上离开上海前往墨西哥，自此杳无音信。

Bachin, on November 22, 1932, was sentenced in the
Shanghai Second Special District Court to one year and four

of drink and causing an accident).

He again came to notice in January 1934 during the

He had been employed as a reporter on the Russian newspaper
"Shanghai Zaria" and had occasionally acted as interpreter for
Ionin, one of the principals in the case. He furnished the
Police with information regarding the part played by different
individuals in the case.

1928年之前的七年里，巴尔是一名摄影师。他现在以国际骗子和与已知涉及毒品交易的阿尔伯特·罗森鲍姆（Albert ROSENBAUM）有联系而闻名。

他于1928年5月22日在上海被捕，并于1928年6月29日因虚假借口罪（False Pretences）被判处一年零六个月监禁。上诉后刑期减为一年监禁。该项指控源于

conspiracy with I. Gilbert and a Chinese to swindle Chinese
on the pretext of manufacturing currency notes by means of
chemicals. Sleight of hand methods were necessarily used.
Bahr appears to have practised the trick in different parts of
China and locally on many occasions. His victims hesitate to
lodge a complaint because of their own fraudulent intentions.
In 1933 at Singapore in company with A. Rosenbaum,
Bahr again attempted the trick, but was unsuccessful.
He is at present residing at 745 Dixwell Road and
is not known to have any regular occupation. On several
occasions during 1935 he travelled to Dairen and on one occasion
to Hongkong.

BALANOVSKY (Belanovsky or Belonorsky or Boolanovsky), Sergey P.,
Russian, born in 1898, nickname "Seregka Poliak"
Files: D. 5272. G.F. 42.

Associates:
Borodofsky, V. Cheney, J.B. Cortez, Joseph.
Llado, S. Neilmayer, D.

Balanovsky arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock on
November 22, 1922.
In 1925, under the nickname of Seregka Poliak, he
resided at 9 Dent Road, where he cohabited with V. Borodofsky,
Russian Jewess, proprietress of the house which was frequently
visited by persons suspected of smuggling.
He was sentenced on August 5, 1925 at the Mixed Court
to pay a fine of $100 for trafficking in arms.
In 1931 Balanovsky was associated with J.B. Cheney
in the operation of a gambling den at 7 Route des Soeurs.
During the period July-September 1933 he was employed
as cashier at a gambling den conducted by S. Llado, D. Neilmayer
and J. Cortez.

与I. 吉尔伯特和一名中国人合谋，以通过化学手段制造钞票为借口诈骗中国人的阴谋。必然使用了手法技巧（Sleight of hand）。巴尔似乎在中国各地及本地多次行骗。受害者因自身也有欺诈意图而犹豫是否提出控告。

BARLING, Frederick William James, British, born in 1901,
Holds Passport No.6303 issued by H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai, on 8.5.1930.
Files: B. 684. H.1227/34. C.1450/34.

Associates:
Capes, B. Murphy, Patrick James.

Barling left the Shanghai Defence Force on November 27,
1927 and joined the Shanghai Municipal Police. He was dismissed
from the Force in May 1929, after continued misconduct. About
18 months later he left for Vancouver and subsequently estranged
himself from his wife, whom he had left in Shanghai. In
Vancouver he lived by his wits, and served terms of imprisonment
on charges of larceny and fraud. At the expiration of the
sentence for fraud he was deported to Shanghai, where he arrived
on July 19, 1934. He resided temporarily at the Astor House
and attempted to settle his bill with a cheque stolen from H.
Wadham of the Victoria Club, who had befriended him. He also
stole clothing from B. Capes (another ex S.M.P. employee) and
pawned it.

At the time of the Wessels-Burton murder he attempted
to intimidate his wife (nee Hetherton) by sending her press reports
of the case.

Barling was prosecuted in the H.B.M. Police Court on
July 30, 1934 on two charges of obtaining money by false pretences,
but escaped punishment when he promised to refund the sums in full.

He again appeared in the H.B.M. Police Court on
January 7, 1936, when he was fined $5.00 for failing to register
himself as a British subject.

Since Barling returned to Shanghai he has been
suspected of minor pilfering and false pretences in cases where
the injured parties declined to institute proceedings against him.

He may be located at the Ritz Cafe, 26 Rue Chu Pao
San, French Concession, where he is employed as a bartender.

巴林，弗雷德里克·威廉·詹姆斯（BARLING, Frederick William James），英国人，生于1901年，持有1930年5月8日由英国驻上海总领事馆签发的第6303号护照。
档案号：B. 684. H.1227/34. C.1450/34.

关联人员：
凯普斯，B.（Capes, B.）。墨菲，帕特里克·詹姆斯（Murphy, Patrick James.）。

巴林于1927年11月27日离开上海防卫队，加入上海公共租界工部局警务处。1929年5月，因持续行为不端而被开除出警队。大约18个月后，他前往温哥华，随后与留在上海的妻子疏远。在温哥华，他靠耍小聪明过活，并因盗窃和欺诈罪服刑。欺诈罪刑满后，他被驱逐至上海，于1934年7月19日抵达。他暂时住在礼查饭店（Astor House），并试图用从维多利亚俱乐部（Victoria Club）的H. 沃德姆（H. Wadham）那里偷来的支票支付账单，沃德姆曾帮助过他。他还从B. 凯普斯（另一名前工部局警务处雇员）那里偷窃衣物并典当。

在韦塞尔斯-伯顿（Wessels-Burton）谋杀案发生时，他试图通过向其妻子（娘家姓赫瑟顿 Hetherton）寄送该案的新闻报道来恐吓她。

1934年7月30日，巴林在英国警察法庭因两项虚假借口获取钱财罪被起诉，但在他承诺全额退还款项后逃脱了惩罚。

1936年1月7日，他再次出现在英国警察法庭，因未注册为英国臣民而被罚款5.00美元。

自从巴林回到上海以来，在受害方不愿对他提起诉讼的案件中，他一直涉嫌轻微扒窃和虚假借口诈骗。

他可能在法租界朱葆三路（Rue Chu Pao San）26号的丽都咖啡馆（Ritz Cafe）工作，担任酒保。

BASS, Isamor Gregorivitch (or A), Russian Jew, born in
1910 at Elizabethgrad. Height 5'2½"; Hazel eyes; fair
complexion; Married; Barber.
C.R.O. F-97. Files: S.145/31. L.359/31. W.594/31.
Y.728/31. E.820. French Police.

Associate :
Mussin, Leonid.

Bass is an expert pickpocket, and has several
convictions to his credit in Shanghai, dating from February 2,
1931. He has not been before a court locally since August 8,

Bass returned to Shanghai from Dairen on 15.10.35
in company with L. Mussin, Russian pickpocket, who travelled
on a Netherlands passport which had been forged.

巴特，库尔特博士（BARTH, Dr. Kurt），德国人。
档案号：D. 4431. B.W. 61/35.

关联人员：
阿达姆斯基，J.S.（Adamsky, J.S.）。巴特（Barter）。埃斯蒂布利耶，M.（Estublier, M.）。莱斯皮纳斯（Lespinasse）。里亚宾，J.P.博士（Rvabine, Dr. J.P.）。

巴特曾任芬兰国家在华枪械代表。

1933年1月，他因参与在上海香水厂（Shanghai Perfumery Factory，位于越界筑路区域 O.O.L.）内制造吗啡，被判处一年监禁及3,000美元罚款。

巴斯，伊萨莫尔·格里戈里维奇（BASS, Isamor Gregorivitch）（或 A），俄罗斯犹太人，1910年生于伊丽莎白格勒（Elizabethgrad）。身高5英尺2.5英寸；榛色眼睛；肤色白皙；已婚；理发师。
中央登记处编号：F-97. 档案号：S.145/31. L.359/31. W.594/31. Y.728/31. E.820. 法国巡捕房。

关联人员：
穆辛，列昂尼德（Mussin, Leonid.）。

巴斯是一名扒窃专家，自1931年2月2日起，他在上海有多次定罪记录。自1932年8月8日因扒窃罪被判处4个月监禁以来，他未再在当地出庭受审。

1935年10月15日，巴斯与俄罗斯扒手L. 穆辛一同从大连返回上海，穆辛所持的荷兰护照系伪造。

最后已知住址：

博蒙特，阿道夫·魏斯曼（BEAUMONT, Adolphe Weisman），别名伊斯雷洛维奇，阿道夫（ISRAELOWICZ, Adolphe），比利时人，1897年3月4日生于安特卫普，父母为波兰人
档案号：D.3307. E. 881. C(Misc)408/34. C.1662/34. C.1168/34.

关联人员：
利亚多，S.（Llado, S.）。马克斯，杰罗姆（Marcs, Jerome.）。斯特鲁贝尔（Strubell.）。伯格，蒙特（Berg, Mont.）。

page_data.en:
(10)

Beaumont arrived in Shanghai on June 14, 1929 from
Vancouver after having been deported from the U. S. A. on grounds
of illegal entry. In Shanghai he associated himself with a
number of business ventures, including the Riverview Golf Club,
the Speedway and with the Velodrome Inc., each of which proved
a financial failure, and he became heavily saddled with debts.
He appeared in the role of editor of the "Shanghai
Spectator", a semi-sporting and social paper of scurrilous
tendencies, which made its initial appearance in 1931. Many
of the articles published were directed against the Shanghai
Municipal Council's administrative policy with the ulterior
motive of championing his own cause and later his own election
campaign as a member of the Shanghai Municipal Council. At
the polls on March 26, and 27, 1934 he was soundly defeated.
Beaumont was sentenced in the Belgian Consular Court
in 1932 to 10 days imprisonment for defamation of character.
In 1932 he was summoned to the Belgian Consulate-General regarding
debts incurred by him all over Shanghai. On numerous occasions
he issued cheques without having funds in the bank to meet them.
Beaumont in January 1933 was closely associated with
"Jimmy" Llaco, a notorious gambler and conductor of several secret
gambling dens in Shanghai. He was among the persons
apprehended by the French Police on January 31, 1935, in a raid
on a gambling establishment at 803 Avenue Foch. He was alleged
to be one of the principals of the place, but he was released
and not charged due to lack of evidence.
A complaint of attempted extortion was filed against
Beaumont during 1932 by R.N. Mayer.
Whilst in Paris in 1928 under the name of Israelowicz,
he was the instigator of a Fcs.3,000,000 fraud (precious stones,
jewels, etc.) on Blumenthal Freres. He left France to escape
page_data.zh:
(10)

博蒙特（Beaumont）于1929年6月14日从温哥华抵达上海，此前他因非法入境被美国驱逐。在上海，他参与了一些商业冒险活动，包括江景高尔夫俱乐部（Riverview Golf Club）、 Speedway 以及 Velodrome Inc.，但这些企业均在财务上以失败告终，使他背负了沉重的债务。他以《上海观察家》（Shanghai Spectator）编辑的身份出现，这是一份带有诽谤倾向的半体育、半社交刊物，于1931年首次发行。许多发表的文章针对上海工部局的行政政策，其潜在动机是为他自己的事业辩护，并为其后来竞选上海工部局董事铺路。在1934年3月26日和27日的投票中，他惨败。
博蒙特于1932年在比利时领事法庭因诽谤罪被判处监禁10天。1932年，他因在上海各地欠下的债务被传唤至比利时总领事馆。他多次在银行无足够资金兑付的情况下签发支票。
1933年1月，博蒙特与“吉米”·利亚科（"Jimmy" Llaco）关系密切，后者是上海臭名昭著的赌徒，经营着几家秘密赌场。1935年1月31日，法国警察突袭霞飞路（Avenue Foch）803号的一家赌博场所时，博蒙特是被捕人员之一。据称他是该场所的主要负责人之一，但因证据不足，他被释放且未被起诉。
1932年间，R.N. 迈耶（Mayer）对博蒙特提出了企图勒索的指控。
1928年他在巴黎期间，使用伊斯雷洛维奇（Israelowicz）之名，策划了一起针对布卢门塔尔兄弟公司（Blumenthal Freres）的价值300万法郎的诈骗案（涉及宝石、珠宝等）。他逃离法国以躲避

page_data.en:
(11)

arrest and was convicted by default to five years imprisonment
and fined Fcs.85,000.

Beaumont left Shanghai for Kobe en route to the U. S. A.
on March 19, 1935.

Last known address:

BEDNER, Richard, alias Bednorg, alias Bednorz, M.R., alias
Count Bednorz Ishigi, German or Polish, born in Upper Silesia
about 1889, Engineer, Height 6'8"
C.R.O. F-377. Files: H.1309/29. I.O.D.9144. I.O.D.309/29.

Associates:
Hahmer, A.A. Hanar.

When Bedner first came to Shanghai in 1911, he was
employed by the firm Kattwinkle & Co., for which concern he later
became local manager. He lost this position through having
absconded with a considerable sum of money. He then obtained a
post as an engineer in certain coal mines on the Island of Saghalien,
from which position he was dismissed for attempting to sell mining
machinery to Japanese interests. He subsequently worked in coal
mines near Peiping, and later returned to Shanghai to set up house
with his wife.

In 1928 Bedner became the confederate of one Hanar, a
former employee of the Chinese Maritime Customs, in arms smuggling.
He was sentenced on February 22, 1929, to a fine of
$400 for possession of morphia.

Nothing is known of Bedner's movements since he left
Hongkong in 1930.

Last known address:

BELOUSOFF, Boris, alias BELOUSOFF, Jacob, alias Morgalo (Blinker),
Russian
Files: D. 2485. E.695.

Associates:
Bliacher alias Blaher. Kerner. Zelindis.
Gloushkova, P. alias Permiakoff A.,
Brana Schazker, alias alias Kozak.
Russian Mary.
page_data.zh:
(11)

逮捕，并被缺席判处五年监禁及罚款8.5万法郎。

博蒙特于1935年3月19日离开上海前往神户，途中转往美国。

最后已知地址：

贝德纳（BEDNER），理查德（Richard），别名贝德诺格（Bednorg），别名贝德诺兹（Bednorz），别名 M.R.，别名贝德诺兹·伊希吉伯爵（Count Bednorz Ishigi），德国人或波兰人，约1889年出生于上西里西亚，工程师，身高6英尺8英寸
刑事登记处编号 F-377。档案：H.1309/29。I.O.D.9144。I.O.D.309/29。

关联人员：
哈默（Hahmer），A.A. 哈纳尔（Hanar）。

贝德纳于1911年初次来到上海时，受雇于卡特温克尔公司（Kattwinkle & Co.），后来成为该公司的本地经理。他因携巨款潜逃而失去了这一职位。随后，他在萨哈林岛（Saghalien）的某些煤矿获得了一份工程师的工作，但因试图向日本势力出售采矿机械而被解雇。此后，他在北平附近的煤矿工作，后来回到上海与妻子同居。

1928年，贝德纳成为前中国海关雇员哈纳尔（Hanar）的共犯，从事武器走私。1929年2月22日，他因持有吗啡被判处400美元罚款。

自1930年离开香港后，贝德纳的行踪不明。

最后已知地址：

贝卢索夫（BELOUSOFF），鲍里斯（Boris），别名 BELOUSOFF，雅各布（Jacob），别名莫尔加洛（Morgalo）（布林克/Blinker），俄罗斯人
档案：D. 2485。E.695。

关联人员：
布里亚赫（Bliacher）别名布拉赫尔（Blaher）。克纳尔（Kerner）。泽林迪斯（Zelindis）。
格鲁什科娃（Gloushkova），P. 别名佩尔米亚科夫（Permiakoff） A.，
布拉娜·沙茨克（Brana Schazker），别名 别名 科扎克（Kozak）。
俄罗斯玛丽（Russian Mary）。

page_data.en:
(12)

First came to the notice of the Shanghai Municipal
Police in 1931 as the result of his being prosecuted in Harbin,
together with Kerner, Blaher or Bliacher, and his (Belaousoff's)
wife on a charge of selling into prostitution a Russian girl
named Stefanovitch. All were found guilty. Belaousoff
and his wife were sentenced to 6 years and a fine of $1,000
whilst Blaher and Kerner received one year and 10 months
imprisonment each, with hard labour.

Belaousoff in all probability appealed the decision
of the Court, for in 1934 he was in Shanghai and known to be an
associate of Gloushkova, P. (Russian Mary), a Russian Jewess,
known to the Police as a prostitute and procuress who at that
time was living together with the proprietress of the "New York
Cafe", Nanzing Road. The pair were trying to recruit women
for a house operated by Belaousoff in Peiping or Tientsin.
Whatever the outcome Belaousoff eventually threw in his lot with
Mrs. L. Zelinkis, the common-law wife of one Joseph Schwartz in
the operation of a brothel in Avenue du Roi Albert, Shanghai.
Note: P. Gloushkova (Russian Mary) is in possession of a
Chinese passport issued in the name of Mrs. Brana Schazker
under which name she registered when living at No. 268
Range Road, her last known address in Shanghai.

Last known address:

BISBJERG, Neils Gorgen Henik, Danish, born in 1890,
Height 5'8", Brown hair, Blue eyes.
C.R.O.F-160. Files: A.9295. C.1278/30. D.4850. D.1242.
E.260. I.O.D.755. I.O.9630.

Associates:
Borchers, Ernst. Crawley, Knight M. Col.J. Christie.
Joverelva, Miss M. Krausz (Krausch, C.A.)
Lambrum. Pateson, J. Pisarevsky, A.G.
Weilden, Robt. G.

Bisbjerg came to China in 1921. He obtained employment
with the B. A. T., and later ran a small import and export
business of his own. In 1927 he endeavoured to negotiate
page_data.zh:
(12)

1931年，因在哈尔滨与克纳尔（Kerner）、布拉赫尔（Blaher）或布里亚赫（Bliacher）及其（贝卢索夫的）妻子一起被起诉，指控将一名名为斯特凡诺维奇（Stefanovitch）的俄罗斯女孩卖入娼妓行业，贝卢索夫首次引起上海公共租界警务处的注意。所有人均被判有罪。贝卢索夫及其妻子被判处六年监禁及1000美元罚款，而布拉赫尔和克纳尔各被判处一年零十个月苦役监禁。

贝卢索夫很可能对法院判决提出了上诉，因为1934年他在上海，且已知与格鲁什科娃 P.（俄罗斯玛丽）有交往，后者是一名俄罗斯犹太女性，被警方认定为妓女和鸨母，当时她与南京路“纽约咖啡馆”（New York Cafe）的女店主同居。这两人正试图为贝卢索夫在北平或天津经营的一处场所招募女性。无论结果如何，贝卢索夫最终与 L. 泽林基斯夫人（Mrs. L. Zelinkis）合伙，她是约瑟夫·施瓦茨（Joseph Schwartz）的事实婚姻妻子，两人在上海阿尔贝国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）经营一家妓院。
注：P. 格鲁什科娃（俄罗斯玛丽）持有一本以布拉娜·沙茨克夫人（Mrs. Brana Schazker）名义签发的中国护照，她住在兰路（Range Road）268号时使用该名字登记，这是她在上海的最后已知地址。

最后已知地址：

比斯比约格（BISBJERG），尼尔斯·乔根·亨尼克（Neils Gorgen Henik），丹麦人，1890年出生，身高5英尺8英寸，棕色头发，蓝色眼睛。
刑事登记处编号 F-160。档案：A.9295。C.1278/30。D.4850。D.1242。
E.260。I.O.D.755。I.O.9630。

关联人员：
博歇尔斯（Borchers），恩斯特（Ernst）。克劳利（Crawley），奈特 M.（Knight M.）。克里斯蒂上校（Col.J. Christie）。
乔韦雷尔瓦小姐（Miss M. Joverelva）。克劳斯（Krausz）（克劳施 C.A./Krausch, C.A.）
兰布鲁姆（Lambrum）。帕特森（Pateson），J. 皮萨列夫斯基（Pisarevsky），A.G.
韦尔登（Weilden），罗伯特 G.（Robt. G.）。

比斯比约格于1921年来到中国。他受雇于英美烟草公司（B. A. T.），后来经营自己的小型进出口业务。1927年，他试图洽谈

page_data.en:
(13)
arms and morphine deals. In 1928 he specialized in the
manufacture and sale of steel vests. During the same year
he was sentenced at the Danish Consular Court to 14 days
imprisonment on a charge of unintentional manslaughter (motor
car accident). In 1929 he purchased material for the
manufacture of gas pistols. He was forbidden to sell the
product locally, but he appears to have marketed same in other
parts of China. In 1930 he was unconfirmedly reported to
have been concerned in a large deal in munitions with the
Nationalist Government. In 1930 he was charged at the Danish
Consular Court for fraud, resulting in his being sent to Denmark
for trial on September 2, 1930. Bisbjerg was last heard of
in April 1933, when he was reliably reported to have been
examined by the Berlin Police with regard to a charge of opium
smuggling. The charge, however, could not be substantiated.
Last known address:

BLOM, Pieter, Netherlander
File: C. (Misc) 137.
Blom was representative of an Amsterdam firm of
brokers in Medan, and Sumatra. He embezzled a substantial
sum of money and fled to Shanghai, where he was arrested and
deported to Batavia on July 27, 1933.

武器和吗啡交易。1928年，他专门从事钢背心的制造和销售。同年，他在丹麦领事法庭因过失杀人罪（汽车事故）被判处监禁14天。1929年，他购买了制造气体手枪的材料。他被禁止在当地销售该产品，但他似乎在中国其他地区进行了销售。1930年，有未经证实的报告称他参与了与国民政府的大宗军火交易。1930年，他在丹麦领事法庭被控欺诈，导致他于1930年9月2日被送往丹麦受审。关于比斯比约格的最后消息是在1933年4月，据可靠报告称，柏林警方就鸦片走私指控对他进行了审查。然而，该指控未能得到证实。

Refineries Associated Ltd. He was sentenced on September 7,
1932, to one year's imprisonment and fined $1,000 for
misappropriation.

Bagdanoff is an expert safe breaker. He was arrested
by the British Municipal Police, Tientsin, in 1925, and sent to
Harbin under escort for suspected complicity in a murder and
robbery at Harbin.

He was sentenced on July 5, 1926 to three months
imprisonment for receiving stolen property, and on November 23,
1929 at the Shanghai 1st Special District Court to six years
plus 15 days R.O.S. for being a member of a criminal gang and
for shopbreaking (Ulman Jewellery Store robbery). His
sentence was reduced to four years on appeal, and he was released
under Government Amnesty on October 5, 1932, but handed over to
Tientsin Police on October 21, 1932.

He is suspected of being concerned in an office-breaking
at 4 Avenue Edward VII on August 24, 1929 and of conspiracy to
commit robbery at Reuter. Brockelman's, 62 Kiangse Road, in
September 1929.

布卢姆（BLUM），罗伯特（Robert），拉脱维亚人，1897年出生，身高5英尺6½英寸，深金色卷发，灰色眼睛，面色红润。

巴格达诺夫（Bagdanoff）是一名开锁专家。1925年，他被天津英租界工部局警察逮捕，并被押送至哈尔滨，因涉嫌参与哈尔滨的一起谋杀抢劫案。

1926年7月5日，他因收受赃物被判处三个月监禁；1929年11月23日，在上海第一特区地方法院，他因身为犯罪团伙成员及破门盗窃（乌尔曼珠宝店抢劫案）被判处六年监禁外加15天反省院监禁（R.O.S.）。上诉后刑期减为四年，他于1932年10月5日因政府大赦获释，但于1932年10月21日被移交给天津警方。

他涉嫌参与1929年8月24日爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII）4号的办公室破门盗窃案，以及1929年9月在江西路62号罗伊特·布罗克尔曼公司（Reuter. Brockelman's）策划抢劫阴谋。

page_data.en:

He married Natalia Kousheshova, notorious shop-lifter,
whose former husband was executed for murder in 1926.

BORCHERS, Ernst, German, born on 7.11.1898, Passport No.1107
issued by German Consulate, Bilbao, Spain, on 10.10.1929
File : D. 1242.

Associates:
Bisbjerg, N.G.H.        Pisarevsky, A.G.        Krausz.

Borchers came to Shanghai in 1930 as export manager of
the Spanish Firearms Manufacturing Co.    He made no attempt to
conceal the nature of his business, which he maintained, was
perfectly legitimate, and he admitted having concluded during
August 1930 a deal with the Nanking Government for the supply
of a large quantity of arms and ammunition.

He associated in Shanghai with Bisbjerg, Krausz and
Pisarevsky, all of whom have good connections with Chinese arms
dealers and similarly are suspected of criminal activity.
Last known address:

BORGININO, Italian
File : I.O. 5618.
Associates :
Marzoli.                Polagoti.

Borginino in 1924 was unconfirmedly reported to
have concluded a contract with a Chinese military clique to
supply a large consignment of arms and ammunition.    Borginino,
and his two associates, Marzoli and Polagoti, were at that time
employed in an Italian bank in Peking.

博歇尔斯于1930年来到上海，担任西班牙枪械制造公司（Spanish Firearms Manufacturing Co.）的出口经理。他并未试图隐瞒其业务性质，他声称该业务完全合法，并承认在1930年8月期间与南京政府达成了一项供应大量武器弹药的协议。

他在上海与比斯比约格、克劳斯和皮萨列夫斯基交往，这些人与中国军火商均有良好联系，同样涉嫌犯罪活动。

Boutakoff first came to Shanghai in July 1923.

In 1927 he was employed with the Shanghai Tramway Co.,
but his services were soon dispensed with on account of the
disappearance of some tools which had been entrusted to his care.

He was found not guilty when charged before the French
Mixed Court on 2.4.28 with uttering counterfeit money.

He was sentenced to 50 days imprisonment for larceny
on April 2, 1928 and later to four months imprisonment and a
fine of $300 for misappropriation. He did not serve the
last sentence as he was found not guilty on November 12, 1933
on appeal.

He was arrested together with E.J. Lookianchenko
in connection with the Siberian Jewellery Store robbery (safe
breaking) and sentenced on May 27, 1934 at the Shanghai 1st
Special District Court to eight months imprisonment for
burglary and two months imprisonment for using a forged
passport - to serve 9 months imprisonment in all and was released
from gaol on March 29, 1935.

1927年，他受雇于上海电车公司（Shanghai Tramway Co.），但由于交由他保管的一些工具失踪，他的服务很快被终止。

1928年4月2日，他因盗窃罪被判处监禁50天，后来因挪用公款被判处监禁四个月并罚款300美元。他没有服完最后一次判决的刑期，因为他在1933年11月12日的上诉中被判无罪。

他与 E.J. 卢基扬琴科一起因西伯利亚珠宝店抢劫案（撬保险箱）被捕，1934年5月27日在上海第一特区地方法院被判入室盗窃罪监禁八个月，使用伪造护照罪监禁两个月——共计服刑九个月，并于1935年3月29日获释出狱。

Brinberg was arrested in Tientsin on October 10, 1929,
when the British Police discovered a house containing an elaborate
plant which was used for extracting heroin from floor polish,
in which form the drug was being shipped from France.
During 1935 Brinberg made numerous trips between Shanghai
and Dairen.
Last known address: 146A Route des Soeurs.

BRO, Maurice, Russian Jew, born in Shanghai about 1909, Speaks
Russian, English, French and Chinese
C.R.O. F-712. Files: D. 6696. French Police.

Associates:
Rosenbaum, Albert. Broque, S.M.
Bro in 1925/26 was employed with Pathe Orient Ltd. at
the firm's factory on Route Zikawei. He was discharged from
this post on account of a number of thefts for which he was held
responsible.
In September 1932 he was employed for a short period
with Clarke's Enquiry Agency. His services, however, were
unsatisfactory and his dismissal was expedited by the theft of
two pistols from Clarke's office. Bro was strongly suspected
of the theft, but no proof was forthcoming.
Subsequent to 1932, Bro clashed with the notorious A.
Rosenbaum. Duplicity in some underhanded affair in which the
pair were concerned is believed to have been the cause of the
bitter enmity which existed between them.
Towards the end of 1934 Bro claimed that he could, in
return for a practical consideration, facilitate aliens' entry
into America.
On February 1, 1935, he publicly claimed to have invented
a perpetual motion machine which he named "R.A.E.". The claim
savoured of a swindle and nothing came of it.
Bro on October 26, 1935 was sentenced in the Shanghai
2nd Special District Court to 50 days imprisonment for fraud.
Last known address: 498 Rue Cardinal Mercier.

(17)

布林伯格（Brinberg）于1929年10月10日在天津被捕，当时英国警察发现一处房屋内设有精密设备，用于从地板蜡中提取海洛因，该毒品即以这种形式从法国运出。
1935年间，布林伯格多次往返于上海与大连之间。
最后已知住址：姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）146A号。

布罗（BRO），莫里斯（Maurice），俄籍犹太人，约1909年生于上海，讲俄语、英语、法语和中文
中央登记处档案号 F-712。卷宗：D. 6696。法国警察。

关联人：
罗森鲍姆（Rosenbaum），阿尔伯特（Albert）。布罗克（Broque），S.M.
布罗于1925/26年受雇于百代东方有限公司（Pathe Orient Ltd.），在该公司位于徐家汇路（Route Zikawei）的工厂工作。他因多起由其负责的盗窃案而被解雇。
1932年9月，他在克拉克侦探社（Clarke's Enquiry Agency）短暂任职。然而，其表现令人不满，且因克拉克办公室失窃两支手枪而加速了其被解雇的过程。布罗有重大盗窃嫌疑，但未能提供证据。
1932年以后，布罗与臭名昭著的A.罗森鲍姆发生冲突。据信，两人在某件勾当中存在的欺诈行为是导致他们之间产生强烈敌意的原因。
1934年底，布罗声称只要给予实际好处，他就能协助外国人进入美国。
1935年2月1日，他公开宣称发明了一种永动机，并将其命名为“R.A.E.”。该声称带有诈骗性质，最终不了了之。
1935年10月26日，布罗在上海第二特区地方法院因诈骗罪被判处监禁50天。
最后已知住址：梅神父路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）498号。

BRODSKY (Brodski or Brotchka), Rosa, Russian, born in 1898
C.R.C. 2347. Files: D.6496. D. 4911. D.2145.

This individual is the widow of the notorious BRODSKY,
Abram, who was murdered in Harbin on June :, 1933.

She was unsuccessfully prosecuted locally for shoplifting
on December 5, 1925, and again escaped punishment for similar offence
on November 5, 1927.

Her third prosecution before the Shanghai 1st Special
District Court on a charge of trafficking in women was equally
unsuccessful.

Last known address: 2/08 Route Vallon, French Concession.

BROQUE, Samuel Morris, American (unrecognized), born in 1904
C.R.O. F-374. File : C.870/35

Associate :
Bro, Maurice.

Broque is the step-brother of Maurice BRO. He claims
American citizenship, but is not recognized as such by the
American Authorities.

At the Shanghai 1st Special District Court on July 2,
1935, Broque was sentenced to 15 days imprisonment for obtaining
goods by false pretences. The goods were handed to Broque on
credit by Alexander Clark & Co. Ltd., Jewellery & Silver Ware Store,
Nanking Road, on the understanding that he was making the purchase .
on behalf of a well-known customer who had previously been seen in
the store in company with Broque.

Last known address: Savoy Hotel, Broadway.

BULYCHEFF, Gregory I., alias Vassilieff, alias Insaroff, alias

C.R.O. F-295. Files: C.160/35. C.166/35. C.279/35.

Shanghai 2nd Special District Court to pay a fine of $60 or to

布罗德斯基（BRODSKY）（亦作 Brodski 或 Brotchka），罗莎（Rosa），俄国人，生于1898年
中央登记处卡片号 2347。卷宗：D.6496. D. 4911. D.2145.

此人是臭名昭著的布罗德斯基（BRODSKY），阿布拉姆（Abram）的遗孀，后者于1933年6月:日在哈尔滨被谋杀。

她曾于1925年12月5日在当地因商店行窃被起诉但未成功，并于1927年11月5日再次因类似罪行逃脱惩罚。

她在上海第一特区地方法院第三次因贩卖妇女罪被起诉，同样未获定罪。

最后已知住址：法租界瓦隆路（Route Vallon）2/08号。

布罗克（BROQUE），塞缪尔·莫里斯（Samuel Morris），美国人（未获承认），生于1904年
中央登记处档案号 F-374。卷宗：C.870/35

关联人：
布罗（Bro），莫里斯（Maurice）。

布罗克是莫里斯·布罗（Maurice BRO）的继兄弟。他声称拥有美国国籍，但未得到美国当局的承认。

1935年7月2日，布罗克在上海第一特区地方法院因以虚假借口获取财物罪被判处监禁15天。这些货物是由南京路亚历山大·克拉克有限公司（Alexander Clark & Co. Ltd.）珠宝银器店赊销给布罗克的，前提是他是代表一位知名顾客进行购买，该顾客此前曾被看到与布罗克一同出现在店内。

最后已知住址：百老汇大厦萨伏伊酒店（Savoy Hotel, Broadway）。

布雷切夫（BULYCHEFF），格里戈里·I.（Gregory I.），别名瓦西里耶夫（Vassilieff），别名因萨罗夫（Insaroff），别名杰尼索夫（Denisoff），别名多布罗霍托夫（Dobrohotoff），俄籍犹太人，约生于1885年

布雷切夫于1933年9月8日在上海第二特区地方法院因诈骗罪被判处缴纳罚款60美元或监禁30天。

(19)

On March 1, 1935, at the Shanghai 1st Special
District Court he was sentenced to one year's imprisonment
for fraud (3 counts). In this connection he represented
himself as an employee of the Chinese Eastern Railway Agency,
selling goods on a commission basis. He obtained money
from the victims on the pretext that his firm would, on
his introduction, make direct contracts and he would thereby
lose his commission.

CATARAU, Julian, alias Kataran, alias Cataran, Roumanian
Files: I.O. 5202. I.O. 5601. I.O. 5740.
C.I.D. 9522/24. C.I.D. 8871/24.

Associates:
Adalson alias        Austrick, A.         Chuster, H.

There appears to be no report to hand covering the
arrival here of Catarau, Julian; it is known, however, that
prior to 1919 he was an anarchist and swindler. He left
Shanghai on October 25, 1919 by the s.s. Yamata Maru for Europe
and was next heard of in 1920 at Nice where he was convicted of
having stolen a large quantity of jewellery from a low class
woman and sentenced to 10 months imprisonment. He returned
to Shanghai in June 1923 and was seen on a number of occasions
in the company of one Dr. Kindler.

There is every indication that Catarau was in 1924
very anxious to keep on the right side of the Police; to effect
this he handed over various bits of information. In April
1924 he made a statement to the Police regarding the smuggling
of arms and it is believed brought about the arrest on April 6,
1924 of a German named Schilling, who at that time manager of
Frederick's Hotel. Catarau handed to the Police what he avowed
to be the plans for wholesale smuggling of arms by a large group,
page_data.zh:
(19)

1935年3月1日，他在上海第一特区地方法院因三项欺诈罪被判处监禁一年。在此案中，他自称是中东铁路局代理处的雇员，以佣金方式销售货物。他以他的公司在其引荐下将直接签订合同、从而致使他失去佣金为借口，从受害者处骗取钱财。

目前尚无关于朱利安·卡塔劳抵达此地的报告；但已知在1919年之前，他是一名无政府主义者和骗子。他于1919年10月25日乘“山田丸”号轮船（s.s. Yamata Maru）离开上海前往欧洲，下一次消息是在1920年于尼斯得知，他因从一名下层妇女处窃取大量珠宝而被定罪，并被判监禁10个月。他于1923年6月返回上海，并多次被人看到与一位金德勒博士（Dr. Kindler）在一起。

种种迹象表明，卡塔劳在1924年非常急于与警方保持良好关系；为此，他提供了各种情报。1924年4月，他就武器走私一事向警方作出陈述，据信这导致了名为席林（Schilling）的德国人于1924年4月6日被捕，此人当时是弗雷德里克酒店（Frederick's Hotel）的经理。卡塔劳向警方提交了他声称是一个大型团伙大规模走私武器的计划，

page_data.en:
(20)

operating between Peking and Shanghai and claimed that the
various consignments on arrival here were landed with the
connivance of Customs officers.
On July 28, 1924, Catarau was arrested by the River
Police in the company of A. Caban or Adriano Corban who was found
in possession of a pistol and ammunition which he had just removed
from the Italian ship "Rosandia". Catarau was handed over to
the City Police and charged but was released "not guilty" and
immediately admitted to the General Hospital suffering from acute
appendicitis.
On September 26, 1918 he was arrested by the French
Consul (Shanghai) on a charge of espionage, but was later released.
On September 28, 1923 he was brought before the Mixed
Court on a charge of assault and battery. The case against him
was however dismissed.
Last known address:

CAMPANI, Otello (or Mario), alias Sangez, Italian, born in 1912
C.R.O. F-457. Files: C. (Misc.) 107/34. D.6616. E.163/55.
H. (Misc.) 11/34. H.2141/35.

Associates:
Chiyoko Tanaka Yui Nishida alias nangel, Anthony.
alias Yoshimura. Madame Louise.
Campani left the Italian Navy and took up residence in
Shanghai at the end of 1933.
In January 1934, whilst he was cohabiting with a
Japanese female named Chiyoko Tanaka alias Yoshimura, he was found
to have an unlicensed pistol and ammunition. This was duly
confiscated by the Italian Consul-General.
During September 1934 Campani became manager of the
Marseillais Bar on Broadway. The embezzlement of a substantial
sum of his employer's money coupled with his inability to keep his
fingers out of the petty cash cost him his job. At the Italian
Consular Court on January 4, 1935, he was found not guilty on the
charge of embezzlement, but was sentenced to two months
page_data.zh:
(20)

该团伙在北京和上海之间活动，并声称各批货物抵达此地时是在海关官员的默许下卸货的。
1924年7月28日，卡塔劳与A.卡班（A. Caban）或阿德里亚诺·科尔班（Adriano Corban）一同被水警逮捕，后者被发现持有一支手枪和弹药，这些物品是他刚从意大利船只“罗桑迪亚”号（"Rosandia"）上取下的。卡塔劳被移交给市警察局并被指控，但因“无罪”被释放，并随即因患急性阑尾炎被收入广慈医院（General Hospital）。
1918年9月26日，他因间谍罪被法国驻上海领事逮捕，但随后获释。
1923年9月28日，他因殴打罪被提审至会审公廨。然而，针对他的案件被驳回。
最后已知住址：

坎帕尼（CAMPANI），奥泰洛（Otello）（或马里奥 Mario），别名桑盖兹（Sangez），意大利人，生于1912年
中央登记处档案号 F-457。卷宗：C. (杂项) 107/34. D.6616. E.163/55.
H. (杂项) 11/34. H.2141/35.

别名吉村（Yoshimura）。 路易丝夫人（Madame Louise）。
坎帕尼于1933年底离开意大利海军并在上海定居。
1934年1月，当他与一名名叫田中千代子（别名吉村）的日本女子同居时，被发现持有无照手枪和弹药。这些物品随即被意大利总领事没收。
1934年9月期间，坎帕尼成为百老汇大道马赛酒吧（Marseillais Bar）的经理。他侵吞雇主巨额资金，加上无法克制窃取零用现金的行为，导致他丢了工作。1935年1月4日，在意大利领事法庭，他被判侵吞罪名不成立，但因盗窃罪被判处

page_data.en:
(21)

imprisonment and fined 300 Liras and costs on the count of
larceny, the sentence being suspended for two months.
During February 1935 a person masquerading under the
name of Sangez, who was believed to have been identical with
WILLIAM JOHN NOON, JAPANESE EUROPEAN
Campani, defrauded Anthony Rengel, Portuguese, of $25 by selling
him tickets for
/a bogus indecent cinema show.
Last known address: 9 Tsongchow Road.

CHAVEZ, Juan, Brazilian
Files: A.3704. C.I.D.2131.
On April 15, 1915, the gambling at Mount Pleasant, No.24
North Honan Road, was recommenced; on the door was a plate bearing
the name of J. Chavez. The place was watched for three months
by the Police but very little was found out about Chavez.
On March 26, 1926, a raid was carried out by the Police
at No.61 Bubuling Well Road and Chavez among others was taken
into custody. His person was searched and the result proved
beyond doubt that he was the operator of the establishment.
He was released on bail and brought before the Brazilian
Assessor, but the outcome of the case is not known.
Last known address:

He was sentenced in the U.S.A. Consular Court on

监禁两个月，罚款300里拉并承担诉讼费用，刑期缓期两个月执行。

He was employed as sports editor of the Shanghai Times
for 2 or 3 years, and apparently resigned from the post about
May 1931. He then associated himself with S.P. Balanovsky in
conducting public gambling at No.7 Route de Grouchy.
In January 1933 he claimed Chilean protection and became
the secretary of the now defunct Club Chileno, 837 Bubbling Well
Road, wherein roulette was conducted. Cheney has also been
connected with other gaming houses.
After the Club Chileno closed, Cheney again registered
himself at the American Consulate-General.
Last known address: 41/80 Carter Road.

Christie served in the Navy as a warrant officer and
obtained his discharge in Hongkong in 1905, when he became a
professional boxing tutor and opened a gymnasium. The venture
was a financial failure and he was declared a bankrupt in 1906.
He absconded from Hongkong in 1907 after misappropriating a
quantity of jewellery for which offence a warrant was issued for
his arrest. He went to the F.M.S. in 1907 where he remained
until 1914, as a bookmaker. Whilst in the F.M.S. he came under
Police notice on account of the activities of his mistress a
Russian woman named "Trixie" alias Mrs. Campbell who was suspected
of espionage. At the outbreak of war, Christie joined His
Majesty's forces, serving with distinction. He rose to command a
battalion of the Scottish Rifles, being awarded the D.S.O., and
O.B.E. (military). After the war Christie returned to the F.M.S.
but proceeded to Shanghai in 1923. In Shanghai he attempted to
deal in arms on a large scale, firstly for Sun Yat Sen and later
on behalf of Chang Tso Lin, the Manchurian War Lord. During
the negotiations, he succeeded in defrauding a credulous Chinese
of a large sum of money, and left for the interior of China.
He later travelled through Japan, Java and Singapore, leaving
behind a trail of dishonoured cheques. He returned later to
Shanghai and in 1925 was convicted before His Majesty's Consular
Court on a charge of entering into negotiations for the sale of
arms and ammunition contrary to the Order-in-Council. He was
sentenced to 3 months' H.L. additional to a fine of $200. After
release from jail he went to Hongkong where on November 16, 1927,
he was convicted on a charge of obtaining money by false pretences
and sentenced to four months' H.L. An accomplice named C.
Bluhm, a Latvian, was at the same time sentenced to three months'
H.L. After release he came back to Shanghai and lived by his
wits. On February 16, 1933, at Shanghai he was convicted on
three charges of larceny and sentenced to seven months' imprisonment

Velichkin.              Weizovitch.             Widler, Elly 别名
Worthington.                                    Barton 博士。

克里斯蒂（Christie）曾在海军担任准尉，并于1905年在香港退役，随后成为职业拳击教练并开设了一家健身房。该企业经营失败，他于1906年被宣告破产。1907年，他在侵吞大量珠宝后从香港潜逃，当局因此签发逮捕令。他于1907年前往海峡殖民地（F.M.S.），在那里以赌注登记人（bookmaker）为业直至1914年。在海峡殖民地期间，因其情妇——一名名为“Trixie”、别名坎贝尔夫人（Mrs. Campbell）的俄罗斯妇女涉嫌从事间谍活动——的行为，他引起了警方的注意。战争爆发时，克里斯蒂加入英王陛下部队，服役表现杰出。他晋升至苏格兰来福枪团（Scottish Rifles）的一个营的指挥官，并被授予杰出服务勋章（D.S.O.）和大英帝国官佐勋章（O.B.E.，军事类）。战后克里斯蒂返回海峡殖民地，但于1923年前往上海。在上海，他试图大规模进行军火交易，起初是为孙中山，后来是代表满洲军阀张作霖。在谈判过程中，他成功诈骗了一名轻信的中国人一大笔钱，随后前往中国内地。此后他途经日本、爪哇和新加坡，留下了一串空头支票。他后来回到上海，并于1925年在英王陛下领事法庭被裁定犯有违反《枢密院令》就军火和弹药销售进行谈判的罪名。他被判处监禁3个月（H.L.），并罚款200元。出狱后他前往香港，1927年11月16日因以虚假借口获取钱财罪被定罪，判处监禁4个月（H.L.）。一名名叫C. Bluhm的拉脱维亚籍同伙同时被判处监禁3个月（H.L.）。获释后他回到上海，靠耍小聪明为生。1933年2月16日，他在上海因三项盗窃罪被定罪，每项罪名判处

page_data.en:
(24)

on each charge concurrently. On completion of his sentence he
was banished from China to England, sailing from Shanghai on October
10, 1933. He is now in Europe and in April 1935, successfully
passed off a number of worthless cheques at Antwerp, Belgium.

COHEN, Joseph, Greek (Russian by birth), born in 1872
C.R.O. 51. Files: S.145/31. E.1168.

Associates:
Bass, Isamor. Cohen, Fanny.

Cohen is a shoplifter and a pick-pocket. In December
1929 he was arrested for pocket-picking, but there was insufficient
evidence on which to prefer a charge against him.

He was sentenced on February 2, 1931, to 40 days detention
for attempted pocket-picking, Shanghai First Special District Court.

Cohen travelled to Europe and returned to Shanghai in June/
July, 1935. On his return he was in possession of a Greek passport.
Last known address: 576 Route Pere Froc.

CORTES, Arthur, alias Arthur Phillips, alias Arika Kawashima,
claims to be Chilean, born in 1908 of a British father and Japanese
mother. Height about 5'11", slim build, pale face, clean shaven,
dark hair, married to a Eurasian of American extraction nee Minford
File : G.F. 55/28.

Cortes is a recognized Japanese subject, having come under
the notice of the local Japanese Consular Authorities some years ago
in connection with military conscription. However, he now claims
Chilean citizenship and, according to reliable information, paid a
large sum of money in order to secure the protection of the Chilean
Authorities.

Cortes was educated in Shanghai under the name of Arthur
Phillips. English is the only language he speaks. A
stenographer by profession, he has been employed with such firms as:
F. Heath & Co., 31 Peking Road, Tobacco Products Corporation, 200
Yulin Road, Hugo Reiss & Co., 15 Museum Road, and the Shanghai
Waterworks Co. Ltd., 484 Kiangse Road. He has been unemployed
for about four years and consequently has been in straitened
page_data.zh:
(24)

七个月监禁，同期执行。服刑期满后，他被驱逐出中国前往英国，于1933年10月10日从上海乘船离开。他目前身在欧洲，并于1935年4月在比利时安特卫普成功兑现了多张无价值支票。

科恩（COHEN），约瑟夫（Joseph），希腊人（出生于俄罗斯），生于1872年。
中央注册处档案号（C.R.O.）51。卷宗：S.145/31. E.1168。

关联人员：
巴斯（Bass），伊萨莫尔（Isamor）。科恩（Cohen），范妮（Fanny）。

科恩是一名商店窃贼和扒手。1929年12月，他因扒窃被捕，但证据不足，无法对他提起诉讼。

1931年2月2日，上海第一特区地方法院以企图扒窃罪判处他拘留40天。

科恩前往欧洲，并于1935年6月/7月返回上海。回国时他持有一本希腊护照。
最后已知地址：神父路（Route Pere Froc）576号。

科尔特斯（CORTES），阿瑟（Arthur），别名阿瑟·菲利普斯（Arthur Phillips），别名川岛亚里卡（Arika Kawashima），自称是智利人，1908年出生，父亲为英国人，母亲为日本人。身高约5英尺11英寸，身材瘦削，面色苍白，面部无须，黑发，娶了一位美裔欧亚混血女子为妻，女方娘家姓明福德（Minford）。
卷宗：G.F. 55/28。

科尔特斯是被公认的日本臣民，几年前曾因兵役问题引起当地日本领事当局的注意。然而，他现在声称拥有智利国籍，并且据可靠消息，他支付了一大笔钱以获得智利当局的保护。

科尔特斯在上海以阿瑟·菲利普斯的名字接受教育。英语是他唯一使用的语言。他的职业是速记员，曾受雇于以下公司：F. Heath & Co.（北京路31号）、烟草产品公司（Tobacco Products Corporation，榆林路200号）、Hugo Reiss & Co.（博物馆路15号）以及上海自来水公司（Shanghai Waterworks Co. Ltd.，江西路484号）。他已经失业约四年，因此经济拮据，

page_data.en:
(25)
circumstances and is in the habit of moving about from place
to place in order to evade his creditors.
In December 1932 Cortes was connected with a gambling
den known as the "Pacific Club", No.56A Hart Road. He was
the tenant of the house and in filling up the Municipal
Registration form signed himself as the "Director" of the Club.
On January 7, 1933 Cortes called on the Deputy Commissioner
(Crime) and complained about the Police Party functioning outside
the Club, stating that the presence of the Police was causing
embarrassment to the members. However, the "Pacific Club"
closed down in April 1933 owing, it is said, to financial losses
sustained by the promoters.

CRANK, Thomas Reginald, alias Ch. S.Maitland, British
(Eurasian), born in 1888, Passport No.10500 issued by
H.B.M. Consul-General, Shanghai, 31.1.34.
C.R.C. 32. Files: D.6183. Central Registry 8274.
On June 2, 1908 at H.B.M. Consular Court, Shanghai,
on a charge of larceny, Crank was released under First Offenders
Act, being bound over to keep the peace for 12 months.
On November 15, 1909 at H.B.M. Consular Court on a charge
of obtaining money by False Pretences, he was sentenced to one
month's H. L.; on January 28, 1910 at H.B.M. Consular Court on
a charge of forgery, to 4 months H. L.; on November 1, 1914
at H.B.M. Consular Court on a charge of fraud and forgery, to
one year on each count, both sentences to run concurrently;
on August 6, 1917 at the Mixed Court on a charge of fraud (9
counts), to 7 years imprisonment (released after serving three
years).
On March 2, 1921 at the Mixed Court on a charge of fraud,
the case was dismissed on payment of $1,000.
After his fourth conviction he was struck off the
register and not recognized as a British subject.
On September 17, 1923, through the influence of
friends he was again registered as a British subject.
page_data.zh:
(25)
并且习惯于四处搬迁以躲避债权人。
1932年12月，科尔特斯与一家名为“太平洋俱乐部”（Pacific Club）的赌场有关联，该赌场位于哈同路（Hart Road）56A号。他是该房屋的租户，并在填写工部局登记表时将自己签名为俱乐部的“董事”。1933年1月7日，科尔特斯拜访了副警务总监（刑事），抱怨在俱乐部外执勤的警察小队，称警察的存在给会员带来了尴尬。然而，“太平洋俱乐部”于1933年4月关闭，据称是因为发起人遭受了经济损失。

克兰克（CRANK），托马斯·雷金纳德（Thomas Reginald），别名 Ch. S. Maitland，英国人（欧亚混血），生于1888年，护照号码10500，由英王陛下驻上海总领事于1934年1月31日签发。
中央注册处卡片号（C.R.C.）32。卷宗：D.6183. 中央注册处 8274。
1908年6月2日，在上海英王陛下领事法庭，克兰克因盗窃罪根据《初犯法》被释放，具结保持和平行为12个月。
1909年11月15日，在上海英王陛下领事法庭，因以虚假借口获取钱财罪，他被判处监禁1个月（H. L.）；1910年1月28日，在上海英王陛下领事法庭，因伪造罪，被判处监禁4个月（H. L.）；1914年11月1日，在上海英王陛下领事法庭，因欺诈和伪造罪，每项罪名判处监禁一年，两项刑期同期执行；1917年8月6日，在会审公廨，因欺诈罪（9项指控），被判处监禁7年（服刑三年后获释）。
1921年3月2日，在会审公廨，因欺诈罪，案件在支付1,000元后被撤销。
第四次定罪后，他被从名册中除名，不再被承认为英国臣民。
1923年9月17日，通过朋友的影响，他再次被注册为英国臣民。

page_data.en:
(26)

In 1933/34 Crank became connected with the Oriental
Construction Company and undertook large contracts in Tientsin.
Last known address: 920 North Szechuen Road.

CRAWLEY, Paul S., American
Files: B. 1219. B. 1353. E. 528. 3727.
8279. 9522. 9824. 10212.

Associates:
Bozello, S. Cartarau, J. Crawley, K.M.
Litsaridi, N. Tessier, A.H. Widler, E.

In 1927 Widler, Elly and Crawley, Knight M. (brother of
Paul S) perpetrated a swindle in arms amounting to $73,000 on an
agent of General Yang Sun, Tuchun of Szechuen Province. The
introduction was effected by A.H. Tessier who at that time was
representative of the Yangtsze Rapid Co. Inc. at Chungking.
Crawley left town soon after the final payment was made and took
with him the nine year old son of his brother Paul S. who claimed
that the boy had been kidnapped, a story that should not be given
credence as Paul S. is strongly suspected of complicity in the
swindle and not only knew but arranged that Knight should take the
boy, in case, he, Paul S, should be arrested. The case against
Widler and K.M. Crawley never came to Court.

Paul S. Crawley was again heard of on Wednesday, February
20, 1929, when he advertised in the China Press that he had roulette
wheels for sale.

During the foregoing incidents Paul S. was operating the
Velvet Ice Cream Co. at No.101 Szechuen Road and residing at various
addresses in the Settlement and the French Concession.

In 1932 he was apprehended by the American Authorities on
a charge of smuggling opium into the U.S.A. and sentenced to two
years imprisonment on McNeil Island.

In 1934 he returned to Shanghai as a passenger on the s.s.
Shanghai Maru but was refused permission to land as he had no valid
passport. He was detained on a River Police hulk and eventually
deported after transferring his business interests to Elly Widler
and Harrington of Franklin & Harrington, legal practitioners.
page_data.zh:
(26)

1933/34年间，克兰克与东方建筑公司（Oriental Construction Company）建立联系，并在天津承接大型合同。
最后已知地址：北四川路920号。

克劳利（CRAWLEY），保罗·S.（Paul S.），美国人
卷宗：B. 1219. B. 1353. E. 528. 3727.
8279. 9522. 9824. 10212.

关联人员：
博泽洛（Bozello），S. 卡尔塔劳（Cartarau），J. 克劳利（Crawley），K.M.
利察里迪（Litsaridi），N. 泰西耶（Tessier），A.H. 维德勒（Widler），E.

1927年，维德勒（Elly Widler）和克劳利（Knight M. Crawley，保罗·S.的兄弟）对四川省督军杨森将军的一名代理人实施了一起金额达73,000元的军火诈骗案。引荐是由当时在重庆担任扬子快速轮船公司（Yangtsze Rapid Co. Inc.）代表的A.H. 泰西耶完成的。在支付最后一笔款项后不久，克劳利离开了上海，并带走了他兄弟保罗·S.九岁的儿子。保罗·S.声称孩子被绑架，但这一说法不应采信，因为保罗·S.强烈涉嫌参与该诈骗案，他不仅知情，还安排奈特（Knight）带走孩子，以防他自己（保罗·S.）被捕。针对维德勒和K.M. 克劳利的案件从未进入法庭审理。

保罗·S. 克劳利再次出现是在1929年2月20日星期三，当时他在《字林西报》（China Press）上刊登广告出售轮盘赌具。

在上述事件期间，保罗·S. 经营着位于四川路101号的天鹅绒冰淇淋公司（Velvet Ice Cream Co.），并居住在公共租界和法租界的多个地址。

1932年，他因向美国走私鸦片罪被美国当局逮捕，并在麦克尼尔岛（McNeil Island）被判处两年监禁。

1934年，他作为乘客乘坐“上海丸”号（s.s. Shanghai Maru）返回上海，但因没有有效护照而被拒绝登陆。他被拘押在一艘水上警察的趸船上，最终在将其商业利益转让给埃莉·维德勒（Elly Widler）以及富兰克林与哈林顿律师事务所（Franklin & Harrington, legal practitioners）的哈林顿（Harrington）后，被驱逐出境。

page_data.en:
(27)

DEL VALLE FIGUEROA, Mexican, age 40 in 1934, Export Merchant
C.R.C. 1369. Files: G.F.55/23. D.281. D.346. B.1666.
C.R. A.9398.

Associates:
Alvarez. Fournier. Garcia.
Lefuente (or Santos.
La Fuente).

F. Del Valle arrived in Shanghai from Los Angeles in
August 1928. Nothing is known of his antecedents. On
October 17, 1928 he signed an antedated lease (the date being
31.7.28) for 151C Bubbling Well Road, which premises were owned
by La Fuente, a very intimate friend of the notorious gambler
Carlos Garcia. These premises were also leased to C. Garcia on
July 31, 1928.

No.151C Bubbling Well Road was well known as a gambling
house conducted by an employee of Garcia, one Alvarez. The
place was raided on April 2, 1928. Alvarez was arrested, tried in
the Mexican Consular Court, found guilty and fined 500 Pesos.

Undoubtedly the newly arrived Del Valle was the successor
of Alvarez, also only an employee and a scapegoat for the real owner
Garcia. F. Del Valle lived on the premises, and had his name
plate on the door, but Garcia paid the bills for two telephones,
supply of electricity and the supply of a large quantity of wines,
cigars, cigarettes and eatables. Gambling was conducted on a
large scale, three wheels being operated, about 100 or more persons
being generally present.

On May 26, 1929 the Police raided 151C Bubbling Well Road
and found about 200 gamblers on the premises. F. Del Valle met
the Police and informed them that he was the owner of the place.
The whole gambling paraphernalia, wheels, chips, etc. were seized.

As a Mexican citizen F. Del Valle appeared before the
Mexican Consul on June 22 and was released on bail. Subsequent
successful application by the Police Advocate resulted in the Consul
refusing him jurisdiction. On June 27, F. Del Valle was again
arrested and taken before the Provisional Court with Garcia, Santos
and Fournier. Bail being refused, the defendants were held in
custody. During the whole process F. Del Valle maintained his
page_data.zh:
(27)

德尔瓦莱·菲格罗亚（DEL VALLE FIGUEROA），墨西哥人，1934年时40岁，出口商人。
中央注册处卡片号（C.R.C.）1369。卷宗：G.F.55/23. D.281. D.346. B.1666.
中央注册处档案号（C.R.）A.9398。

关联人员：
阿尔瓦雷斯（Alvarez）。富尼耶（Fournier）。加西亚（Garcia）。
莱丰特（Lefuente）（或桑托斯 Santos.
拉丰特 La Fuente）。

F. 德尔瓦莱（F. Del Valle）于1928年8月从洛杉矶抵达上海。关于他的背景一无所知。1928年10月17日，他签署了一份倒签日期（日期为1928年7月31日）的租赁合同，承租静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）151C号，该房产由拉丰特（La Fuente）所有，拉丰特是臭名昭著的赌徒卡洛斯·加西亚（Carlos Garcia）的密友。该房产也于1928年7月31日出租给了C. 加西亚。

静安寺路151C号是一家众所周知的赌场，由加西亚的一名雇员阿尔瓦雷斯经营。该场所于1928年4月2日遭到突击搜查。阿尔瓦雷斯被捕，在墨西哥领事法庭受审，被判有罪并罚款500比索。

毫无疑问，新近抵达的德尔瓦莱是阿尔瓦雷斯的继任者，他也仅仅是一名雇员，是真正老板加西亚的替罪羊。F. 德尔瓦莱住在该处所，门上挂有他的名牌，但加西亚支付了两部电话的费用、电力供应以及大量葡萄酒、雪茄、香烟和食品的费用。赌博活动规模很大，运营着三个轮盘，通常有一百多人到场。

1929年5月26日，警方突击搜查了静安寺路151C号，发现现场约有200名赌徒。F. 德尔瓦莱迎接警方并告知他们他是该场所的所有者。所有赌博用具，包括轮盘、筹码等，均被没收。

作为墨西哥公民，F. 德尔瓦莱于6月22日出庭面对墨西哥领事，并获保释。随后警方检察官的成功申请导致领事拒绝行使管辖权。6月27日，F. 德尔瓦莱再次被捕，并与加西亚、桑托斯和富尼耶一同被提审至临时法院。由于保释被拒，被告被羁押。在整个过程中，F. 德尔瓦莱坚持其

page_data.en:
(28)

statement that he was the owner and that Garcia only visited the
place occasionally. F. Del Valle was prepared to bear the whole
brunt of the charge in order to allow Garcia to evade punishment,
undoubtedly for a consideration.

On July 5, 1929 F. Del Valle was found guilty and sentenced
to one year's imprisonment and fined $2,000.
Last known address: 404 Yu Yuen Road.

DEMENTZEFF (or DEMENTSEFF or DEMINTZEFF or DIOMENTSEFF), Herman P.
(or Yerman G.P.), Russian, born in 1902.
C.R.C. 2007. Files: C.(Misc.)217/34. C.324/34. C.(Misc.)109/35.
E. 582. French Police.

Associates:
Sponopoulos, P.E., alias Vasiliev, P.E.

Dementzeff came to Shanghai from Harbin in 1931, having
left Harbin, it is believed, after perpetrating a fraud.

On February 31, 1932 at the Shanghai Second Special
District Court, Dementzeff was sentenced to 30 days imprisonment,
suspended for two years, for causing bodily harm.

On May 6, 1934 he was apprehended by the Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau for being in possession of two pistols and a quantity
of ammunition. In August of that year, he was unconfirmedly
reported to have turned his attention to trading in narcotics, and
is said to have endeavoured to negotiate the purchase of a large
quantity of heroin for which he intended to pass a bundle of
worthless currency notes.

Later in 1934, Dementzeff in association with P.E.
Sponopoulos, opened up a shady concern known as the International
Supply Corporation, 149 Yuen Ming Yuen Road. They subsequently
caused goods to be delivered against post-dated cheques bearing
their joint signatures which subsequently led to their appearance
in the Shanghai Second Special District Court for fraud.
Dementzeff was sentenced on November 14, 1934 to a fine of $40 or
20 days imprisonment. Sponopoulos was fined $120 or 60 days
imprisonment. The latter was summoned to appear at the First
Shanghai Special District Court in connection with the issue of
page_data.zh:
(28)

陈述，称他是所有者，而加西亚只是偶尔访问该场所。F. 德尔瓦莱准备独自承担全部指控，以便让加西亚逃避惩罚，这无疑是有报酬的。

1929年7月5日，F. 德尔瓦莱被判有罪，判处监禁一年并罚款2,000元。
最后已知地址：愚园路404号。

德门采夫（DEMENTZEFF）（或 DEMENTSEFF 或 DEMINTZEFF 或 DIOMENTSEFF），赫尔曼·P.（Herman P.）（或 Yerman G.P.），俄罗斯人，生于1902年。
中央注册处卡片号（C.R.C.）2007。卷宗：C.(Misc.)217/34. C.324/34. C.(Misc.)109/35.
E. 582. 法国警察。

关联人员：
斯波诺普洛斯（Sponopoulos），P.E.，别名瓦西里耶夫（Vasiliev），P.E.

德门采夫于1931年从哈尔滨来到上海，据信他在实施诈骗后离开了哈尔滨。

1932年2月31日（原文如此，应为笔误），在上海第二特区地方法院，德门采夫因造成身体伤害被判处监禁30天，缓刑两年。

1934年5月6日，他因持有两支手枪和大量弹药被上海公安局逮捕。同年8月，有未经证实的报告称他将注意力转向毒品交易，据说他试图洽谈购买大量海洛因，并打算用一捆无价值的钞票支付。

1934年晚些时候，德门采夫与P.E. 斯波诺普洛斯合伙开办了一家名为国际供应公司（International Supply Corporation）的可疑企业，地址位于圆明园路149号。他们随后导致货物依据带有他们联合签名的远期支票交付，这最终导致他们因欺诈罪出现在上海第二特区地方法院。1934年11月14日，德门采夫被判处罚款40元或监禁20天。斯波诺普洛斯被罚款120元或监禁60天。后者因涉及发行

page_data.en:
(29)

a worthless cheque by these two persons, for which he was sentenced
on March 23, 1935 to pay a fine of $20 or 10 days detention.
Last known address: 256/3 Avenue Dubail, French Concession.

DENISOFF, Vasily Nicolaivich, Russian, born in 1905 at Moscow,
Mechanic, Holds Chinese Passport No.76279 issued at Manila on
15.9.33.
C.R.O. F-300. Files: E.1014. H.1099/32. H.480/35.

Associates:
Baranoff, V.V.

Denisoff was arrested in Bangkok on January 16, 1935 and
deported to China together with V.V. Baranoff as an undesirable,
arriving in Shanghai on 11.2.35.

Denisoff was sentenced on March 7, 1935 at the Shanghai
First Special District Court to 50 days detention for stealing a
motor cycle on June 21, 1932. He speaks Cantonese fluently.
Last known address: 56 Wayside Road.

DENISOFF, Constantine J., Russian, born about 1884
C.R.C. 1717. Files: French Police.

Associate :
Lakomkin, Afanasy.

Remanded sine die on a charge of larceny, Shanghai Second
Special District Court, June 1, 1931 (case not re-heard).

Sentenced to 40 days imprisonment for forgery, attempted
fraud, usurping the power of a public officer, assault and malicious
damage - Shanghai Second Special District Court, 29.8.35.

Last known address:

DOLAN (or DOYLAN), James Stephan, American, born in Boston,
Massachusetts, U.S.A., in 1888.
Files: D.4806. B.256. B.458.

Associates:
Barton, Fred, alias Kottermeier. Felgate, R.H.
Gmehling, G. Sinclair, Betty.
Widler, Elly.
page_data.zh:
(29)

此二人开具的一张空头支票，他因此于1935年3月23日被判处罚款20元或拘留10天。
最后已知地址：法租界杜美路（Avenue Dubail）256/3号。

DENISOFF, Vasily Nicolaivich，俄国人，1905年生于莫斯科，机械师，持有1933年9月15日在马尼拉签发的中国护照第76279号。
刑事登记处卡片 F-300。档案编号：E.1014. H.1099/32. H.480/35。

关联人：
Baranoff, V.V.

Denisoff 于1935年1月16日在曼谷被捕，并与 V.V. Baranoff 作为不受欢迎分子被驱逐至中国，于1935年2月11日抵达上海。

Denisoff 因在1932年6月21日盗窃一辆摩托车，于1935年3月7日在上海第一特区地方法院被判处拘留50天。他能说流利的广东话。
最后已知地址：韦思德路（Wayside Road）56号。

DENISOFF, Constantine J.，俄国人，约生于1884年
刑事登记处卡片 1717。档案编号：法国警察档案。

关联人：
Lakomkin, Afanasy。

1931年6月1日，在上海第二特区地方法院，因盗窃罪被无限期还押候审（案件未重审）。

因伪造、企图诈骗、冒充公职人员职权、袭击及恶意破坏财物，于1935年8月29日在上海第二特区地方法院被判处监禁40天。

最后已知地址：

DOLAN（或 DOYLAN）, James Stephan，美国人，1888年生于美国马萨诸塞州波士顿。
档案编号：D.4806. B.256. B.458。

关联人：
Barton, Fred，化名 Kottermeier。Felgate, R.H.
Gmehling, G. Sinclair, Betty.
Widler, Elly.

page_data.en:
(30)

Dolan arrived in Shanghai in 1916 and was employed for a
a number of years with the China-Java Export Company, a somewhat
shady concern reported to be engaged in the smuggling of drugs and
arms into Yunnan and the Western Provinces. This firm went out
of business about 1925.

In 1925 Dolan left Shanghai for the United States. He
was next heard of in June 1926, when he was arrested in Hamburg,
Germany, in connection with the seizure of 457 tins of morphia
concealed in a cargo of tombstones consigned to Messrs Marshall
& Co., Shanghai. Dolan admitted that he endeavoured to smuggle
the drug to Shanghai, and at the Hamburg District Court on June 23,
1926, was fined 5,000 Reich Marks and costs. An American woman
named Betty Sinclair, who was living with Dolan at the time of his
arrest, was also detained by the Police but was later released.

Dolan resided in Paris for the next two or three years
and very little is known regarding his subsequent movements and
activities until April 5, 1933, when he arrived in Shanghai from the
U.S.A. He is known to have been accompanied by Fred Barton,
suspected drug smuggler, and to have brought with him a cargo of
eighty coffins which had been shipped by the National Casket Co.,
Boston, U.S.A. On arrival here, he resided with Elly Widler,
notorious arms smuggler. Shortly afterwards Dolan associated
himself with the Shanghai Casket Co. and later with the Universal
Funeral Co., located at 999 Bubbling Well Road and at 41 Moulmien
Road, respectively. The lease of these premises was terminated
and judgment was
by the landlords in June 1935, subsequently given against Dolan
in the American Court for recovery of $2,625 representing unpaid
rent.

Last known address:

DOLL, Michael, alias Dolt, alias Rath HARLAND, British, born in 1989
File : D. 4822.

Associate :
Wilson, A.F.
page_data.zh:
(30)

Dolan 于1916年抵达上海，并在“中爪哇出口公司”（China-Java Export Company）任职数年，这是一家声誉不佳的公司，据报从事向云南及西部省份走私毒品和军火的活动。该公司约于1925年停业。

1925年，Dolan 离开上海前往美国。下一次听到他的消息是在1926年6月，当时他在德国汉堡因涉嫌在一批运往上海 Marshall & Co. 公司的墓碑货物中藏匿的457罐吗啡被查获而被捕。Dolan 承认他企图将毒品走私至上海，并于1926年6月23日在汉堡地方法院被罚款5,000帝国马克及承担诉讼费用。一名名叫 Betty Sinclair 的美国女子，在 Dolan 被捕时与其同居，也被警方拘留，但随后获释。

Dolan 随后在巴黎居住了两三年，关于他随后的行踪和活动知之甚少，直到1933年4月5日他从美国抵达上海。已知他与涉嫌毒品走私的 Fred Barton 同行，并带来了一批由美国波士顿国家棺材公司（National Casket Co.）装运的八十具棺材。抵达此处后，他与臭名昭著的军火走私者 Elly Widler 同住。不久后，Dolan 与上海棺材公司（Shanghai Casket Co.）发生关联，后来又与位于静安寺路999号和莫尔缅路（Moulmien Road）41号的环球殡仪馆（Universal Funeral Co.）发生关联。这些房屋的租赁契约被终止，房东于1935年6月胜诉，随后美国法院判决 Dolan 偿还代表欠租的2,625美元。

最后已知地址：

DOLL, Michael，化名 Dolt，化名 Rath HARLAND，英国人，生于1989年（原文如此，疑为1889或1899之误）
档案编号：D. 4822。

关联人：
Wilson, A.F.

page_data.en:
(31)

Doll is a naturalized Canadian of Russian extraction.
He came to China prior to 1917 and joined the Chinese Maritime
Customs service in Canton, from which he was dismissed. He
came to Shanghai in 1917 and joined the Customs River Police under
the name of Dolt. He was dismissed from this post after a
few months service. He then travelled around ports north of
Shanghai, and was suspected of opium smuggling.
On November 19, 1917 at H.B.M. Consular Court, Shanghai,
to serve
Doll was sentenced to pay a fine of $10 or/7 days imprisonment for
being concerned with one A.F. Wilson (American) in assaulting a
Sikh watchman.
On October 30, 1918 at H.B.M. Consular Court, Shanghai,
he was sentenced to two years H. L. for manufacturing false rouble
currency notes.
He arrived in Shanghai from Hongkong on April 28, 19c3
under the assumed name of Kath HARLAND and claimed to be an American
citizen. The only identification paper he had at that time
was a seaman's certificate, issued at New York and bearing the name
of Kath HARLAND. It bore no photograph.
He has been employed occasionally at Jimmy's Restaurant,
Szechuen Road, and was last known to be residing at No.

DOUBROVSKY, Gleb Alexandrovitch, alias Vasilieff-Doubrovsky, G.A.,
Russian, born in 1908
C.R.C. 2462. File : D.1639
Doubrovsky was educated in Shanghai, and speaks English
fluently.
At the Shanghai Second Special District Court on
August 12, 1935, he was sentenced to 10 days imprisonment or
a fine of $10 for obtaining goods by false pretences (issuing
a worthless cheque).
Last known address: House 11, Passage 1248, Rue Lafayette.
page_data.zh:
(31)

Doll 是归化加拿大的俄裔人士。
他于1917年前来到中国，并在广州加入中国海关税务司服务，后被解职。他于1917年来到上海，以 Dolt 之名加入海关水警队。在服务数月后，他被从此职位上解职。随后他在上海以北的各港口游荡，并被怀疑从事鸦片走私。
1917年11月19日，在上海英国驻华领事法庭，
Doll 被判处罚款10元或/及监禁7天，罪名是与 A.F. Wilson（美国人）共同袭击一名锡克教看守。
1918年10月30日，在上海英国驻华领事法庭，
他因制造假卢布纸币被判处两年苦役（H. L.）。
他于19c3年（原文不清，疑似1923或1933）4月28日从香港抵达上海，使用 Kath HARLAND 的假名，并声称是美国公民。当时他唯一的身份证明文件是一份在纽约签发、名为 Kath HARLAND 的海员证书。该证书上没有照片。
他偶尔在四川路吉米餐馆（Jimmy's Restaurant）受雇，最后已知居住在 No.（原文中断）

DOUBROVSKY, Gleb Alexandrovitch，化名 Vasilieff-Doubrovsky, G.A.，俄国人，生于1908年
刑事登记处卡片 2462。档案编号：D.1639
Doubrovsky 在上海受教育，能说流利的英语。
1935年8月12日，在上海第二特区地方法院，他因通过虚假借口获取货物（开具空头支票）被判处监禁10天或罚款10元。
最后已知地址：拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）1248弄11号。

page_data.en:
(32)

DROOS, Naum (Norman) Mikhailvitch, Russian, born in 1897, Broker
C.R.C. 2099. Files: P.Rd.210/33. C.(Misc.)186/34.

Associates :
Ackerman, V.A. MacBain,C. Rojinsky, J.
Tergregorian, G. Zasorin, C.

On July 21, 1933 at the Shanghai First Special District
Court, Droos was sentenced to three months imprisonment for
fraudilently altering currency notes and for fraud. Droos, in
company with C. Zasorin and C. Tergregorian, attempted to convince
a Chinese of their ability to produce perfect counterfeit notes by
a process which depended upon the credulity of the intended victim.

In 1934, Droos, in association with J. Rojinsky, V.A.
Ackerman and C. MacBain, opened a concern known as the Shanghai
Produce Trading Company at 149 Yuen Ming Yuen Road. They obtained
piece goods from J.E. Turner & Co., 128 Museum Road, to the value
of approximately $400 and subsequently attempted to evade payment.
Only a threat of prosecution against C. MacBain, who had been foolish
enough to sign his name to certain papers, brought forth the money.
The company, which savoured of a bogus concern, closed down after
three months existence.

Last known address : 427 Yu Yuen Road.

ELLIOTT, Victor S., alias V. Lorraine, alias Gary, alias A. Smith,
Eurasian, born in Shanghai in 1900.
C.R.C. 755. Files: E.202/1-2-3-4. H.1270.

Associates:
Souza. Tobsen.

Elliott came under Police notice in 1923, when he was
apprehended by the U.S.Authorities in Shanghai for forgery and
embezzlement. He left for the United States in April 1925, and
on arrival there was arrested as an alien, sentenced to 60 days
imprisonment, and deported to Shanghai, arriving here in October
1925. Shortly after his return here, he was arrested by the
U.S. Authorities for forging his mother's name to a cheque.
page_data.zh:
(32)

DROOS, Naum (Norman) Mikhailvitch，俄国人，生于1897年，经纪人
刑事登记处卡片 2099。档案编号：P.Rd.210/33. C.(Misc.)186/34。

关联人：
Ackerman, V.A. MacBain,C. Rojinsky, J.
Tergregorian, G. Zasorin, C.

1933年7月21日，在上海第一特区地方法院，Droos 因欺诈性篡改钞票及诈骗罪被判处监禁三个月。Droos 与 C. Zasorin 和 C. Tergregorian 一起，试图通过一种依赖预期受害者轻信的程序，让一名中国人相信他们有能力制造完美的假钞。

1934年，Droos 与 J. Rojinsky、V.A. Ackerman 和 C. MacBain 合作，在圆明园路149号开设了一家名为“上海土产贸易公司”（Shanghai Produce Trading Company）的商号。他们从博物馆路128号的 J.E. Turner & Co. 公司获取了价值约400元的匹头货物，随后企图逃避付款。只有通过对愚蠢地在某些文件上签名的 C. MacBain 提出起诉威胁，才追回了款项。这家带有虚假性质的公司在存在三个月后关闭。

最后已知地址：愚园路427号。

ELLIOTT, Victor S.，化名 V. Lorraine，化名 Gary，化名 A. Smith，欧亚混血儿，1900年生于上海。
刑事登记处卡片 755。档案编号：E.202/1-2-3-4. H.1270。

关联人：
Souza. Tobsen.

Elliott 于1923年引起警方注意，当时他在上海因伪造和侵吞公款被美国当局逮捕。他于1925年4月前往美国，抵达后即作为外侨被捕，被判处监禁60天，并被驱逐回上海，于1925年10月抵达此处。返回此处后不久，他因在其母亲的支票上伪造签名而被美国当局逮捕。

page_data.en:
(1)

1.—AGOSTINI, PIERRE.
French subject, born in Indo-China in 1906. Very undesirable character with previous conviction at Saigon. Has been mixed up in very shady business transactions and leaves a trail of unpaid bills wherever he goes. Arrived in Hong Kong from Shanghai by the s.s. "Katori Maru" on 23rd December, 1932 and was met by Police to whom he stated that he was en route to Canton to try and get some information concerning one HARRY GOLDENBERG, his former partner (and for whose arrest warrant has been issued in Hong Kong). He left again for Shanghai by s.s. "Conte Verde" on 1st January, 1933. French Consul in Hong Kong has expressed the opinion that the passport on which AGOSTINI travels is no longer valid.

2.✓AKSMAN-GLOTZ, JOHN. (Paras. 42, 52 and 59 of 1934).
Born in 1893 in Rumania, served with the Rumanian Army during the war as a field officer and was a prisoner of war in Russia until 1920. He then proceeded to Shanghai where he was employed as an assistant manager. Married with four children. He arrived in Singapore from Shanghai on 16th June, 1925 and entered the employ of Raffles Hotel as an assistant manager. In 1927 he proceeded to India and later to Ceylon where he issued several worthless cheques. Warrants were issued against him and he absconded to Singapore arriving here in 1930. On 8th October, 1930, he was convicted in Singapore and fined $200 for breaches of the Aliens Ordinance.
On 12th June, 1931, he was sentenced to one month's R.I. after conviction on a charge of criminal breach of trust, also in Singapore. On 4th April, 1932, he was sentenced to one year's R.I. in Singapore after conviction on several charges of cheating. He was released from jail on 22nd February, 1933, and left for Hong Kong per s.s. "Kulmerland". On 19th March, 1934, he was ordered to be deported from the Colony by the Hong Kong Police and left for Canton on 21st March, 1934. His wife
page_data.zh:
(1)

1.—AGOSTINI，PIERRE。
法国籍，1906年生于印度支那。品行极劣，曾在西贡有前科。卷入诸多可疑的商业交易，所到之处均留下未付账单。1932年12月23日乘“香取丸”号（s.s. "Katori Maru"）轮船从上海抵达香港，警方予以接洽，其声称正前往广州，试图获取有关其前合伙人 HARRY GOLDENBERG 的情报（香港已签发对后者的逮捕令）。1933年1月1日，其乘“绿伯爵”号（s.s. "Conte Verde"）轮船再次离开前往上海。驻港法国领事认为，AGOSTINI 所持护照已不再有效。

2.✓AKSMAN-GLOTZ，JOHN。（参见1934年第42、52及59段）。
1893年生于罗马尼亚，战期间在罗马尼亚军队服役，任野战军官，并在俄罗斯作为战俘被关押至1920年。随后前往上海，受聘担任副经理。已婚，育有四名子女。1925年6月16日从上海抵达新加坡，受雇于莱佛士酒店（Raffles Hotel）担任副经理。1927年前往印度，后赴锡兰，期间签发多张空头支票。当局对其签发逮捕令，其潜逃至新加坡，于1930年抵达此地。1930年10月8日，其在新加坡因违反《外侨条例》被判罪，罚款200元。
1931年6月12日，其在新加坡因刑事背信罪被判罪，判处一个月苦役（R.I.）。1932年4月4日，其在新加坡因多项诈骗罪名被判罪，判处一年苦役（R.I.）。1933年2月22日获释出狱，乘“库尔默兰”号（s.s. "Kulmerland"）轮船前往香港。1934年3月19日，香港警方下令将其驱逐出境，其于1934年3月21日前往广州。其妻

page_data.en:
(2)
is an inmate of the General Hospital, Singapore and his four
children having been a charge on a local charitable insti-
tution for some time.
He is a clever scoundrel who should not be permitted
to re-enter Malaya. He professes to have a considerable
knowledge of undesirable political intrigue but this is
merely a ruse adopted by him to endeavour to keep on the
right side of the authorities.
The latest report concerning this man is that he left
Yunnan Fu on horseback in July 1934 travelling in a westerly
direction without paying his hotel bill of $630. The Govern-
ment of Burma has been notified of his movements.
He arrived in Katho, Upper Burma in September 1934 hav-
ing travelled overland from Yunnanfu. He was accompanied
by M. Sokoloff, a Letvian, who was in possession of a pass-
port No. 049628 issued by the Special Delegation at Yunnanfu.
Sokoloff was formerly a pilot in the Chinese Air Force.
They were both expelled from Burmese territory into Chinese
territory. Neither should be allowed to land in the Colony.
3./ALBINSKI, VICTOR. (Para. 4/34).
Native of Bosnia, Jugo-Slavia, aged 30 years, holder of
Polish Passport No. 32/30, Serial No. 161925, issued by the
Polish Legation, Shanghai, on 6th May, 1930, and valid till
1935.
This man left Shanghai at the end of August, 1933, with
the intention of making the journey to Poland overland by
bicycle. On reaching Changsha he was arrested by the Chinese
authorities who cancelled his Chinese visa on the grounds that
he had passed through prohibited, i.e., communist territory.
He was sent to Canton and after spending some weeks in prison
there, was sent to Hong Kong. The fact that the Chinese had
cancelled his visa obsessed him and his behaviour necessitated
his removal to hospital for observation. Meanwhile, the
Polish Minister in Shanghai, with whom he had communicated,
page_data.zh:
(2)
系新加坡综合医院住院病人，其四名子女
长期以来由当地一家慈善机构负担供养。
此人是个狡猾的无赖，不应允许其
再次进入马来亚。他自称对不良政治阴谋
颇有了解，但这不过是他为求取当局好感
而采取的伎俩。
关于此人的最新报告称，他于1934年7月
骑马离开云南府，向西行进，未支付
630元的酒店账单。缅甸政府已获知
其行踪。
他于1934年9月抵达上缅甸的卡托
（Katho），系从云南府陆路前来。同行者
为拉脱维亚人 M. Sokoloff，持有云南府
特别代表团签发的第049628号护照。
Sokoloff 曾是中国空军飞行员。
两人均被从缅甸领土驱逐至中国领土。
二人均不应允许在殖民地登陆。
3./ALBINSKI，VICTOR。（参见1934年第4段）。
南斯拉夫波斯尼亚人，现年30岁，持
有波兰驻华公使馆于1930年5月6日在上海
签发的波兰护照，号码32/30，序列号
161925，有效期至1935年。
此人于1933年8月底离开上海，打算
骑自行车陆路前往波兰。抵达长沙时，被
中国当局逮捕，以其经过禁止区域（即共
产党控制区）为由注销其中国签证。
其被送往广州，在当地监狱服刑数周
后，被送往香港。中国方面注销其签证一
事使其耿耿于怀，其行为导致其被送入医
院观察。其间，与其有过联系的驻上海波
兰公使，

page_data.en:
(3)
made representations to H.B.M. Consul-General, Shanghai, who
cabled saying that Albinski was an honest and harmless
individual but weak minded. An expulsion order was made
against Albinski who left Hong Kong by road on his bicycle
on 5th January, 1934, bound for Poland via China and Indo-
China. It is not suspected that this man is undesirable
politically but on account of his peculiar mentality is a
most difficult character to deal with. He should be made
the subject of a report in the event of his passing through
Malaya.
4. GEORGES ASSAISSO alias DON JUAN BAEZA alias MOULAY MUSTAFA
EL RAISUNI alias DR. M.E. RAISUNI. (Paras. 16, 28/35).
An international swindler with 20 convictions recorded
against him for fraud and larceny in Madrid, Paris, Denmark
and Northern Africa. His last conviction was at Copenhagen on
20th December, 1933, when he was sentenced to 10 months'
imprisonment for theft from a woman's flat. He poses as a
palmist and faith healer and commits theft from women whom
he visits when "faith healing". He is in possession of a
Spanish passport in the name of Don Juan Baeza issued in
London on 11th July, 1933. On 26th December, 1934, he arrived
in Bombay from Europe and posed as a brother-in-law of Amir
Abdul Kerim of Riff fame in an endeavour to obtain financial
assistance from leading Indian Mohammedan princes. He
journied to Calcutta where he got into trouble with the Police
over a brawl with a woman and was ordered to leave India. He
went to Colombo and sailed for Penang by the s.s. "Antenor"
on 14th April, 1935, en route for Manila. He passed through
Singapore on 5th May, 1935, and is now in Manila. He should
be refused permission to land in Malaya. His photograph
is filed in the Detective Branch, Singapore.
He has left Manila and is now in Shanghai.
+ 5. BAHR, HENRY (German).
See Alfred Rauh, page 30.
page_data.zh:
(3)
向英国驻上海总领事提出交涉，后者
发电报称，Albinski 是一个诚实无害但
意志薄弱的人。当局对 Albinski 作出驱
逐令，其于1934年1月5日骑自行车经陆路
离开香港，途经中国和印度支那前往波兰。
并不怀疑此人在政治上有不良倾向，但由
于其精神状况特殊，是极难对付的人物。
若其途经马来亚，应就此提交报告。
4. GEORGES ASSAISSO，别名 DON JUAN BAEZA，别名 MOULAY MUSTAFA
EL RAISUNI，别名 DR. M.E. RAISUNI。（参见1935年第16、28段）。
国际骗子，在马德里、巴黎、丹麦和北非
共有20次欺诈和盗窃定罪记录。最近一次
定罪是在1933年12月20日于哥本哈根，因
盗窃一名妇女公寓内财物被判监禁10个月。
他冒充看手相者和信仰治疗师，在对妇女
进行“信仰治疗”拜访时实施盗窃。他持
有一本以 Don Juan Baeza 名义于1933年7月
11日在伦敦签发的西班牙护照。1934年12月
26日，他从欧洲抵达孟买，冒充著名的里
夫（Riff）阿米爾 Abdul Kerim 的妹夫，试
图从印度主要穆斯林王公处获取经济资助。
他前往加尔各答，因与一名妇女发生斗殴
而与警方发生冲突，并被勒令离开印度。
他前往科伦坡，并于1935年4月14日乘“安
特诺尔”号（s.s. "Antenor"）轮船驶往槟
城，途中前往马尼拉。他于1935年5月5日途
经新加坡，目前身在马尼拉。应拒绝其在
马来亚登陆。其照片存档于新加坡警队侦
缉部门。
他已离开马尼拉，目前身处上海。
+ 5. BAHR，HENRY（德国人）。
参见 Alfred Rauh，第30页。

(4)
6. ✓(1) BECKER, KARL (German) }
   (2) HOPNER, IRINGARD (German) } (Para. 36/34).

Becker, described as a photographer and Hopner as a
teacher, and both of whom are globe-trotters arrived in
Singapore on 19th May, 1934, from Rangoon and proceeded
to reside at the Yoshino Hotel in Anson Road. They sailed
on 25th May, 1934, for Java. Neither had very much money
and security should be demanded if and when they return
to the Colony.

7. BERGH, MRS. EMMI. (Paras. 1/34 & 5/34).

German Jewess, married to a Norwegian from whom she is
now divorced but retains Norwegian status. Arrived in
Singapore from Colombo on 2nd January, 1934, per the s.s.
"Le Conte De Lisle". She was practically destitute and
proceeded to reside at the "Lanka" Hotel, Trafalgar Street,
a Ceylonese boarding-house, and consorted for immoral
purposes with all nationalities. She was arrested on a
vagrancy charge but her board has been guaranteed in the
Y.W.C.A. until such time as arrangements are made to
repatriate her to Europe.

This woman was repatriated to France at Government
expense per the s.s. "D'Artagnan" on 5th February, 1934.
She should not be allowed to re-enter the Colony.

✓8. BOLKART, JOSEPH. (Para. 6/32).

A German subject. Arrested in Singapore on an ex-
tradition warrant applied for by the Consul-General for
the Netherlands. On 2nd September, 1932, was ordered to
be sent back to Java on charges of obtaining goods by false
pretences. He twice escaped from legal custody in Java
and should be noted for exclusion from the Colony should
he be released from Jail in Java.

No. † 9. BUMBA, WILLIAM. (Para. 18/34).

Aged 26 years, born at Ostrava, Czecho-Slovakia.
page_data.zh:
(4)
6. ✓(1) BECKER，KARL（德国人） }
   (2) HOPNER，IRINGARD（德国人） } （参见1934年第36段）。

Becker 被称为摄影师，Hopner 被称为
教师，两人均为环球旅行者，于1934年5月
19日从仰光抵达新加坡，并入住安森路
（Anson Road）的吉野酒店（Yoshino Hotel）。
他们于1934年5月25日乘船前往爪哇。两人
均无多少钱财，若其返回殖民地，应要求
提供担保。

7. BERGH，EMMI 夫人。（参见1934年第1及5段）。

德国犹太女性，嫁给一名挪威人，现
已离婚，但仍保留挪威人身份。1934年1月
2日乘“勒孔特·德·利尔”号（s.s. "Le
Conte De Lisle"）轮船从科伦坡抵达新加
坡。她几乎身无分文，遂入住特拉法加街
（Trafalgar Street）的“兰卡”（Lanka）
酒店，这是一家锡兰人经营的寄宿公寓，
并与各国籍人士进行不道德交往。她曾因
流浪罪被捕，但其食宿费用由基督教女青
年会（Y.W.C.A.）担保，直至安排将其遣
返欧洲。

该女子于1934年2月5日由政府出资，
乘“达塔尼昂”号（s.s. "D'Artagnan"）轮
船被遣返法国。不应允许其再次进入殖民
地。

✓8. BOLKART，JOSEPH。（参见1932年第6段）。

德国籍。在新加坡根据荷兰总领事申
请的引渡令被捕。1932年9月2日，因其以
虚假借口获取货物之指控，被下令遣返爪
哇。他曾在爪哇两次从法律羁押中逃脱，
若在爪哇获释出狱，应注意将其排除在殖
民地之外。

编号 † 9. BUMBA，WILLIAM。（参见1934年第18段）。

现年26岁，生于捷克斯洛伐克奥斯特拉瓦。
