(5)
(C.I.D. 2/1670/34) This man arrived in Hong Kong as a
stowaway from Singapore in the s.s. "Lima Maru" on 17th
February, 1934. His story was that he boarded the s.s.
"Ouderkirk" at Port Said as a stowaway and that on being
discovered was put to work by the captain who agreed to
take him to Shanghai where he expected to find friends.
On arrival at Singapore on 7th February, 1934, the captain
of s.s. "Ouderkirk" found that he would have to call at
Manila, and telling Bumba that he could take him no further
as he feared trouble with the Manila Police, told him to
go ashore. The captain did not tell Singapore authorities
of his action, and Bumba came to Hong Kong as stated.
Bumba is at present in the House of Detention, Hong Kong,
and when the s.s. "Ouderkirk" calls in Hong Kong on or about
30th March, 1934 enquiries will be made regarding his story.
10. (1) BURTON, MISS PAULA. }
(2) HALEY, MISS ALBERTINA. } (Para. 47/34).
(1) Twenty-three years of age, born in Washington,
U.S.A. She arrived at Hong Kong from Manila on 8th June,
1934, and described herself as a stenographer. She was
found to be prostituting herself and was expelled on 23rd
June, 1934 from Hong Kong to Manila.
(2) Age 20 years, native of Nicaragua. A companion
of the above named also found to be a prostitute and was
similarly expelled to Manila on the same date.
Neither shall be allowed to land in the Colony.
11✓ (1) CARSON, JOHN alias MATSON, JOHN LESLIE alias CARTMAN,
JOHN ALBERT. (Canadian). }
(2) RYAN, MRS. I.J. (Australian). } (Paras. 53 & 54/34).
(3) GRAY, WILLIAM (Australian). }
They arrived in Singapore by the s.s. "Hakone Maru"
on 22nd August, 1934, from Colombo and are staying in
Malaya for a short visit before proceeding to Hong Kong
and Vancouver. Carson claims to be an amusement manager
page_data.zh:
(5)
(C.I.D. 2/1670/34) 此人于1934年2月17日作为偷渡者，从新加坡乘“Lima Maru”号轮船抵达香港。他的说法是，他在塞得港（Port Said）作为偷渡者登上“Ouderkirk”号轮船，被发现后，船长安排他做工，并同意带他去上海，他指望在那里找到朋友。1934年2月7日抵达新加坡时，“Ouderkirk”号船长发现该船必须停靠马尼拉，并告诉Bumba，因担心与马尼拉警方发生麻烦，无法再载他前行，令其上岸。船长未向新加坡当局通报此举，Bumba遂如上述抵达香港。Bumba目前被拘押于香港拘留所，待“Ouderkirk”号轮船于1934年3月30日左右抵港时，将对其说法进行调查。

10. (1) BURTON, PAULA小姐。 }
(2) HALEY, ALBERTINA小姐。 } （第47/34段）。
(1) 二十三岁，出生于美国华盛顿。她于1934年6月8日从马尼拉抵达香港，自称是速记员。经查实其从事卖淫活动，并于1934年6月23日从香港被驱逐至马尼拉。
(2) 二十岁，尼加拉瓜人。系上述人员的同伴，亦被查实为妓女，并于同日以同样方式被驱逐至马尼拉。
二人均不准在本殖民地登陆。

11✓ (1) CARSON, JOHN，化名 MATSON, JOHN LESLIE，又化名 CARTMAN, JOHN ALBERT。（加拿大人）。 }
(2) RYAN, I.J.夫人。（澳大利亚人）。 } （第53及54/34段）。
(3) GRAY, WILLIAM（澳大利亚人）。 }
他们于1934年8月22日乘“Hakone Maru”号轮船从科伦坡抵达新加坡，在前往香港和温哥华之前，将在马来亚作短暂停留。Carson自称是娱乐业经理，

page_data.en:
(6)
and is stated to be wanted in the U.S.A. on numerous
charges of uttering worthless cheques. They are also
stated to be interested in the traffic in narcotics.
Little is known about Nos. 2 and 3. They all left
Singapore by train for Kuala Lumpur on 24th August, 1934,
and a discreet report is requested regarding their move-
ments.
Information has now been received that Jo. Car-
son is wanted on warrants for forgery and uttering
worthless cheque in the State of Georgia, U.S.A. He
is also known under the names of Robert Barkon and
Charles Thompson. He is an international swindler with
convictions in England, Canada and the U.S.A. He left
Singapore for the F.M.S. on 24th August, 1934, accompanied
by a Mrs. Ryan and one William Grey. Every effort is
requested in an endeavour to locate these people, and
discreet observations kept on their movements pending
further instructions.
12. CHITTAN, MAX. (German).
See Ernest Gruinfeld, page 15.
✓13. CROSS, GEORGE alias SAWA SLIVE N. alias SOTO POTO.
(Para. 63/34).
Believed to be an Assyrian subject. Poses as a
priest collecting funds in the name of Assyrian refugees
for churches which do not exist. He is a confirmed
swindler and two years ago he escaped from the U.S. and
Canada after having collected twenty-five thousand
dollars. Possesses passports written different nationali-
ties. This man should be prevented from landing in
Malaya and should he pass through on some vessel an early
report to the Detective Branch, Singapore is requested.
✓14. CURT, HIPPOLYTE. (Para. 29/35).
Age 35 years, native of France. He is known to the
page_data.zh:
(6)
并称在美国因多次签发空头支票而被通缉。据称他们还涉及毒品贩卖活动。
关于第2和第3号人员的情况知之甚少。他们三人于1934年8月24日乘火车离开新加坡前往吉隆坡，现请求对其行踪进行秘密报告。
现已收到情报，Jo. Carson在美国佐治亚州因伪造及签发空头支票的逮捕令而被通缉。他还使用Robert Barkon和Charles Thompson的名字。他是一名国际诈骗犯，在英国、加拿大和美国均有定罪记录。他于1934年8月24日离开新加坡前往海峡殖民地（F.M.S.），随行有一名Ryan夫人和一名William Grey。请尽力查找这些人的下落，并在进一步指示下达前，对其行踪保持秘密监视。

12. CHITTAN, MAX.（德国人）。
参见第15页的Ernest Gruinfeld。

✓13. CROSS, GEORGE，化名 SAWA SLIVE N.，又化名 SOTO POTO。（第63/34段）。
据信为亚述籍臣民。冒充牧师，以不存在的教堂名义为亚述难民募集资金。他是一个惯骗，两年前在美国和加拿大骗取二万五千美元后潜逃。持有填写不同国籍的护照。应阻止此人在马来亚登陆，若其乘船过境，请尽早向新加坡刑事侦缉处报告。

✓14. CURT, HIPPOLYTE.（第29/35段）。
三十五岁，法国人。上海警方知晓其为皮条客，并怀疑其为远东“白奴”贸易招募妇女。他于1935年7月23日经香港和新加坡离开上海前往法国，不应允许其在新加坡登陆。

15.✓(1) CURYLO, VLADISLAV PETER.（波兰人）。       }
   ✓(2) KOMLENKO, VASSILI JOHN.（波斯人）。     } （第9、27、28、
   ✓(3) OGLI, LOLA.                            } 39/34段及第4、5与
                                               } 7/35段）。

Curylo携妻子于1934年2月7日乘“Haruna Maru”号轮船从香港抵达新加坡。他持有一本在上海签发的波兰护照，自称是商人。

Komlenko携妻子乘同一艘轮船也从香港抵达新加坡。他持有一本在上海签发的中国护照，自称是商人。

Curylo和Komlenko与Ribiero（见第31页）及V.A. Ogli（警务处期刊第73/33段）曾于1933年11月16日一同从上海抵达香港。Ogli直接前往曼谷，因为他此前曾被拒绝在马来亚登陆。其余人员如上述抵达新加坡。在上海，Curylo与Komlenko合伙经营位于霞飞路774号的“黑眼睛”餐厅，声誉不佳。在新加坡，他们先住在阿德菲酒店（Adelphi Hotel），后搬到大都会酒店（Metropole Hotel），现住在海滩路的一家中国旅馆。Komlenko抵达后不久便接触了一位当地知名华人，声称掌握一种通过化学手段制造假钞的秘密工艺。他希望该华人出资五万元作为资本，并保证在短时间内使资金翻倍。显然他试图实施一起高明的诈骗，整个团伙极其不良。正在对他们进行进一步调查。

(7)
Shanghai Police as a pimp and is suspected of being a pro-
curer of women for the Far Eastern "White Slave" traffic.
He left Shanghai for France via Hong Kong and Singapore on
23rd July, 1935, and should not be permitted to land in
Singapore.
15.✓(1) CURYLO, VLADISLAV PETER. (Pole).       }
   ✓(2) KOMLENKO, VASSILI JOHN. (Persian).     } (Paras. 9, 27, 28,
   ✓(3) OGLI, LOLA.                            } 39/34 & 4, 5 &
                                               } 7/35).

Curylo, accompanied by his wife, arrived in Singapore
by the s.s. "Haruna Maru" on 7th February, 1934, from Hong
Kong. He was in possession of a Polish passport issued in
Shanghai, and described himself as a merchant.

Komlenko, accompanied by his wife arrived in Singapore
by the same vessel and also from Hong Kong. He was in
possession of a Chinese passport issued in Shanghai and
described himself as a merchant.

Curylo and Komlenko, together with Ribiero (page 31 )
and V.A. Ogli (P.J. para. 73/33) had arrived together in
Hong Kong from Shanghai on 16th November, 1933. Ogli pro-
ceeded direct to Bangkok as he had previously been refused
permission to land in Malaya. The remainder came on to
Singapore as stated. In Shanghai Curylo was in partnership
with Komlenko in the "Black Eyes" Restaurant of 774, Avenue
Joffre, and of doubtful reputation. In Singapore they
stayed at the Adelphi Hotel, then moved to the Metropole
Hotel and are now staying at a Chinese Hotel in Beach Road.
Komlenko approached a well known local Chinese shortly after
his arrival and stated that he was in possession of a
secret process for manufacturing counterfeit currency notes
by chemical means. He wanted the Chinese to put up a sum
of $50,000 as capital and guaranteed that the money would
be doubled within a short space of time. It is quite appar-
ent that he was attempting a clever confidence trick and
the whole gang is extremely undesirable. Further enquiries

(8)
are being made regarding them.
Vladislav Peter Curylo and Vassili John Komlenko,
accompanied by their families, left Singapore by train for
Penang on 22nd April, 1934. Mrs. Ogli, wife of Ogli who
was convicted in Penang in 1933 for entering the Colony
without a valid passport, was also in their party. A dis-
creet report on their movements is requested.
Vladislav Peter Curylo, Vassili John Komlenko and
Lola Ogli arrived in Kuala Lumpur from Singapore on 1st
May, 1934, and proceeded to reside at the Yashmoya Hotel,
163, Batu Road. Nos. 2 and 3 left Kuala Lumpur on 2nd May,
1934, ostensibly for Seremban but did not arrive there. On
4th May, 1934, they returned to Kuala Lumpur and when
interviewed stated they had got out of the train near
Seremban and went off by a hired car to inspect rubber
estates with a view to purchase. They were unable to say
what estates were visited and their conduct appeared highly
suspicious. They then stated they were contemplating taking
over the Victoria Bakery, Kuala Lumpur, as a going concern.
This apparently fell through and they all left for Penang on
10th May, 1934. They are obviously a shady lot and require
careful surveillance.
The above named are now resident in Penang awaiting
permission to proceed to British India. A watch is being
kept on their movements but nothing suspicious has been noted
up to the present.
Curylo, P.V. and family left for Hong Kong by s.s.
"Katori Maru" on the 26th February, 1935.
Komlenko, V.J. left for Hong Kong by s.s. "Hong Peng"
on 7th February, 1935.
Komlenko, V.J. left Hong Kong on 19th February for
Canton, his wife went to Swatow.
16. DA ROSA, RECARDO alias REGO, F. alias CAMPELL, R. (Para.67/34).
page_data.zh:
(8)
Vladislav Peter Curylo和Vassili John Komlenko携家属于1934年4月22日乘火车离开新加坡前往槟城。Ogli的妻子Ogli夫人也在同行之列，她曾于1933年因无有效护照进入殖民地而在槟城被判罪。现请求对其行踪进行秘密报告。

Vladislav Peter Curylo、Vassili John Komlenko和Lola Ogli于1934年5月1日从新加坡抵达吉隆坡，并入住巴都路163号的Yashmoya酒店。第2和第3号人员于1934年5月2日离开吉隆坡， ostensibly（表面上）前往Seremban，但并未抵达。1934年5月4日，他们返回吉隆坡，在接受询问时称他们在Seremban附近下了火车，并租了一辆汽车去视察橡胶园，有意购买。他们说不出视察了哪些庄园，其行为显得高度可疑。随后他们表示正考虑接管吉隆坡的Victoria Bakery面包店，作为持续经营的生意接手。此事显然未果，他们全体于1934年5月10日前往槟城。他们显然是一伙可疑分子，需要严密监视。

上述人员现居住在槟城，等待前往英属印度的许可。目前正在监视他们的行踪，但截至目前未发现可疑情况。

Curylo, P.V.及其家人于1935年2月26日乘“Katori Maru”号轮船前往香港。
Komlenko, V.J.于1935年2月7日乘“Hong Peng”号轮船前往香港。
Komlenko, V.J.于2月19日离开香港前往广州，其妻子前往汕头。

16. DA ROSA, RECARDO，化名 REGO, F.，又化名 CAMPELL, R.（第67/34段）。

page_data.en:
(9)
A Portuguese subject, believed to have been in the employ-
ment of the Macau Police some years ago. During June, 1933,
in Shanghai, he engaged a Chinese representative for a bogus
directory entitled the "World Wide Traders' Directory (1934)",
with head offices in the British Concession, Shameen, Canton.
Having collected a large sum in prepayments he disappeared
from Shanghai in August, 1933, upon which the facts of this
fraud were discovered. Information received shews that he
was practising a similar fraud in Canton and Hong Kong
during January, 1934, under the name of R. Campell.
17.✓ DECLERCK, MDLE. SUZANNE (Para.11/34).
Native of Rosendall, France, aged 22 years. A pros-
titute and an associate of Antoin Poli referred to in page 13
who is suspected of having lived on her immoral earnings
whilst she was resident in Hong Kong. She was ordered to
quit Hong Kong and sailed for Canton on 12th February, 1934.
She should not be allowed to land in the Colony.
18. DE GORTER, MRS. VAN alias PUGH. (Paras. 18 & 26/35).
A confirmed drink and drug addict. Born in Holland
and married one H. Pugh, of the Asiatic Petroleum Co. in
Batavia. He divorced her in 1934 but pays her a monthly
allowance.
She arrived in Singapore on 27th November, 1934, by the
s.s. "Conte Verde" from Venice and commenced to reside at
Raffles Hotel. She travels on a British passport. She was
admitted to a local nursing home on 5th December, 1934, but
escaped twice and was picked up drunk in the streets. She
returned to Raffles Hotel but left there for a boarding house.
She has been a source of considerable annoyance to other
residents and to the Police and on several occasions has
had to be taken home in an ambulance. She consorts promis-
cuously with men of all nationalities. On 29th July, 1935,
she made a report of having been robbed of her handbag by a
page_data.zh:
(9)
葡萄牙籍臣民，据信数年前曾在澳门警队任职。1933年6月在上海，他为一家名为《世界贸易商名录（1934）》（World Wide Traders' Directory (1934)）的虚假名录聘请了一名中方代表，总部设在广州沙面英租界。在收取大量预付款后，他于1933年8月从上海失踪，此时该欺诈事实才被揭露。收到的情报显示，1934年1月期间，他在广州和香港以R. Campell之名实施类似的欺诈行为。

17.✓ DECLERCK, SUZANNE小姐（第11/34段）。
法国Rosendall人，二十二岁。妓女，系第13页提到的Antoin Poli的同伙，Poli涉嫌在她居住香港期间依靠她的不道德收入生活。她被勒令离开香港，并于1934年2月12日乘船前往广州。不应允许其在本殖民地登陆。

18. DE GORTER, VAN夫人，化名 PUGH。（第18及26/35段）。
确凿的酒瘾和毒瘾患者。出生于荷兰，嫁给了巴达维亚亚细亚火油公司（Asiatic Petroleum Co.）的H. Pugh。他于1934年与其离婚，但每月支付给她津贴。
她于1934年11月27日乘“Conte Verde”号轮船从威尼斯抵达新加坡，开始居住在莱佛士酒店。她持英国护照旅行。1934年12月5日，她被送入当地一家疗养院，但两次逃脱，并因醉酒在街上被抓获。她返回莱佛士酒店，但随后离开那里住进了一家寄宿公寓。她给其他居民和警方带来了相当大的困扰，并曾多次不得不被救护车送回家。她与各种国籍的男子滥交。1935年7月29日，她报案称凌晨2点30分被一名泰米尔人抢走了手提包（警察总监参考号 73/35）。目前正安排将其送往爪哇，不应允许其返回马来亚。
她目前因涉嫌扰乱治安和企图自杀而被捕，并被送去观察。她因藐视法庭被即决罚款25元。

19. DE VILLA, EDWARD MANSO，化名 DI VILLA, VISCOUNT。（第64/34段）。
比利时籍臣民，1888年7月18日出生于比利时鲁汶。持1934年11月2日在河内签发的法国身份证明书旅行。1934年11月13日乘“Kut Sang”号轮船从香港抵达新加坡，被拒绝登陆。他于1934年11月13日乘“Hai Heng”号轮船被遣返香港。
此人曾于1932年8月3日在上海因挪用公款罪被起诉。他是一个不良分子，不应允许其在马来亚登陆。

20. DIAKOFF, NICHOLAS ANDREW.（第35及40/34段）。
俄罗斯人，被称为记者。1934年5月17日抵达新加坡，住在格罗夫纳酒店（Grosvenor Hotel）320室。他一直走访马来亚、暹罗和苏门答腊的学校及其他教育机构，推销中国地图和书籍。他是哈尔滨北方贸易出版公司（Northern Trading and Publishing Co.）的代表。他向马尼拉英国总领事馆申请过境签证进入马来亚，借口是前往瑞士。他于1934年1月13日抵达新加坡，但未向护照官员报到。1934年1月20日他在槟城，当时告诉警方他要去瑞士，但却去了曼谷。他于1934年3月1日返回槟城，随后前往棉兰。他于1934年3月26日左右返回新加坡，然后前往上海和哈尔滨。他在上海的地址是霞飞路5号Harmoney Terrace

page_data.en:
(10)
Tamil at 2.30 a.m. (I.G.P. ref. 73/35). Arrangements are
now being made to send her to Java and she should not be
permitted to return to Malaya.
She is now under arrest on charges of disorderly
conduct and attempted suicide and has been sent for observation.
She was summarily fined $25 for contempt of Court.
19. DE VILLA, EDWARD MANSO alias DI VILLA, VISCOUNT. (Para.64/34).
Belgian subject born at Louvain, Belgium, 18th July, 1888.
Travelling on French certificate d'identite issued at Hanoi,
2nd November, 1934, Arrived in Singapore from Hong Kong per
s.s. "Kut Sang" 13th November, 1934, and refused landing.
He was returned to Hong Kong per s.s. "Hai Heng" sailing
on 13th November, 1934.
This man was prosecuted on 3rd August, 1932, in Shanghai
on a charge of embezzlement. He is an undesirable character
who should not be permitted to land in Malaya.
20. DIAKOFF, NICHOLAS ANDREW. (Paras. 35 & 40/34).
Russian described as a journalist. Arrived in Singapore
on 17th May, 1934, and is staying at room 320, Grosvenor
Hotel. He has been visiting schools and other educational
institutions through Malaya, Siam and Sumatra, offering for
sale maps of China and books. He is a representative of
the Northern Trading and Publishing Co. of Harbin. He
obtained a transit visa to enter Malaya from the British
Consul-General, Manila on the pretence that he was journeying
to Switzerland. He arrived in Singapore on 13th January,
1934, but failed to report to the Passport Officer. He
was in Penang on 20th January, 1934, when he told the Police
that he was going to Switzerland, but went to Bangkok ins-
tead. He returned to Penang on 1st March, 1934, and then
proceeded to Medan. He returned to Singapore about 26th
March, 1934, and then proceeded to Shanghai and Harbin. His
Shanghai address is 5, Harmoney Terrace, Avenue Joffre
page_data.zh:
(10)
泰米尔女子于凌晨2时30分（印度总督警务处参考号 73/35）。现正安排将其送往爪哇，且不应允许其返回马来亚。
她目前因行为不检及企图自杀罪名被逮捕，并已被送去接受观察。
她因藐视法庭罪被即席罚款25元。

19. DE VILLA, EDWARD MANSO，别名 DI VILLA, VISCOUNT。（第64/34段）。
比利时籍人士，1888年7月18日出生于比利时鲁汶。
持1934年11月2日在河内签发的法国身份证明书旅行。1934年11月13日乘“Kut Sang”号轮船从香港抵达新加坡，但被拒绝入境。
他于1934年11月13日乘“Hai Heng”号轮船被遣返香港。
此人曾于1932年8月3日在上海因侵吞公款罪被起诉。他是一个不受欢迎的人物，不应允许其在马来亚登陆。

20. DIAKOFF, NICHOLAS ANDREW。（第35及40/34段）。
俄罗斯人，自称记者。1934年5月17日抵达新加坡，现住格罗夫纳酒店（Grosvenor Hotel）320室。他一直在马来亚、暹罗和苏门答腊各地的学校及其他教育机构走访，兜售中国地图和书籍。他是哈尔滨北方贸易出版公司（Northern Trading and Publishing Co. of Harbin）的代表。他向英国驻马尼拉总领事谎称前往瑞士，从而获得了进入马来亚的过境签证。他于1934年1月13日抵达新加坡，但未向护照官员报到。1934年1月20日他在槟城时告诉警方他将前往瑞士，但却去了曼谷。他于1934年3月1日返回槟城，随后前往棉兰。他于1934年3月26日左右返回新加坡，随后前往上海和哈尔滨。他在上海的地址是霞飞路哈莫尼台5号（5, Harmoney Terrace, Avenue Joffre）

page_data.en:
(11)
and in Harbin the Hotel Moderne. He returned to Singapore
as stated on 17th May, 1934, to sell more maps and books.
Although there is nothing criminal against him, his move-
ments have been extremely suspicious, and he should be
made the subject of a discreet report if encountered.
He proceeded to the Federated Malay States for the
purpose of selling maps and returned to Singapore from
Kuala Lumpur on 21st June, 1934. He is staying at the
Grosvenor Hotel. He appears to be short of funds and had
to approach certain persons in Singapore, to pay Bank charges
amounting to $180 on a further consignment of maps and
books received from China.
21. DIMOFF, DMITRY. (Para. 12/35).
Age 39 years, native of Irkutsk This person des-
cribes himself as a "Balalaika Virtuoso" and was at one
time a member of Dick Norton's theatrical company which
toured China and Malaya.
Dimoff was permitted to enter Hong Kong for one month
to carry out engagements prior to going to Singapore where,
he stated, he had an engagement at Raffles Hotel. This
engagement was cancelled and as Dimoff seemed to be on
the verge of destitution, he was instructed to leave
Hong Kong. He left for Swatow on 9th June, 1935.
✓22. DOAH, MRS. GLADYS alias MADAM LYS alias MADAME EVE.
(Para. 62/34).
She arrived in Singapore from Colombo on 30th October,
1934, per the s.s. "Conte Rosso" and describes herself
as a clairvoyant. She is about 30 years of age and of
attractive appearance. She is at present residing in
Raffles Hotel. She has applied for permission to
establish herself in Singapore as a clairvoyant but she
has been refused permission by the Chief Police Officer.
Nothing else is known against her at present but this
page_data.zh:
(11)
以及在哈尔滨的莫德恩酒店（Hotel Moderne）。如前所述，他于1934年5月17日返回新加坡，以出售更多地图和书籍。虽然目前并无针对他的刑事指控，但其行踪极为可疑，若与其相遇，应将其作为秘密报告的对象。

他前往马来亚联合邦（Federated Malay States）旨在销售地图，并于1934年6月21日从吉隆坡返回新加坡。他现居格罗夫纳酒店（Grosvenor Hotel）。他似乎资金短缺，不得不向新加坡的某些人士求助，以支付从中国运抵的另一批地图和书籍所产生的180元银行费用。

21. 季米特里·迪莫夫（DIMOFF, DMITRY）。（第12/35段）。
39岁，伊尔库茨克人。此人自称是“巴拉莱卡琴演奏大师”，曾是迪克·诺顿（Dick Norton）戏剧团的成员，该团曾在中国和马来亚巡回演出。

迪莫夫获准进入香港一个月以履行演出合约，随后前往新加坡，他声称在莱佛士酒店（Raffles Hotel）有演出安排。该合约被取消，鉴于迪莫夫似乎濒临赤贫，当局指令其离开香港。他于1935年6月9日前往汕头。

✓22. 格拉迪斯·多阿夫人（DOAH, MRS. GLADYS），又名莱斯夫人（MADAM LYS），又名夏娃夫人（MADAME EVE）。（第62/34段）。
她于1934年10月30日乘坐“孔特·罗索”号轮船（s.s. "Conte Rosso"）从科伦坡抵达新加坡，自称是通灵者。她约30岁，容貌迷人。她目前居住在莱佛士酒店。她已申请获准在新加坡以通灵者身份执业，但已被警察总监拒绝。目前对她没有其他不利记录，但发布此

page_data.en:
(12)
warning note is issued in case she travels to other parts
of Malaya.
23. DROUTH OR DROUT, ALEXANDRE. (Paras. 7 & 14/34).
Believed to be a Russian, now holding French identity
papers. Maintains an office in the premises of the Port-
ugese firm of Botelho Brothers of Alexandra Building,
Hong Kong, and charters steamers. He is stated to be the
owner of the s.s. "Sagres" which has made at least one
trip from Bushire with a cargo of Persian opium. He
arrived in Singapore from Hong Kong on 21st February,
1934, and stayed at the "Sea View" Hotel. He sailed
for Batavia per the s.s. "Ophir" on 23rd February, 1934.
He is suspected to be engaged in the illicit opium and arms
traffic and should be made the subject of a discreet
report in the event of his re-visiting Malaya.
This man sailed from Batavia direct for Hong Kong
per the s.s. "Tjisa Dane" on 28th February, 1934.
24. FAKTUROVITCH, MIHAIL GEORGEVITCH. (Para. 69/34).
A Pole, aged 26 years, a native of Warsaw, holder of
Passport No. 55, issued by the Bureau of Public Safety,
Canton, on 6th June, 1934, and valid for one year from
that date. Describes himself as a merchant but is strongly
suspected of being engaged in trafficking in women. He
was responsible for the arrival in Hong Kong on 27th May,
1933, of twelve Russian females en route to a shady
cabaret in Macau. He declares himself to be husband of
Annette Klur, a Russian prostitute who runs the "Del
Monte" Bar in Canton and who is connected with B.E. Perlos
(page 26). Fakturovitch arrived in Hong Kong together
with Perlos on 17th October, 1934, as a through passenger
to Canton from Shanghai. He was ordered out of the Colony
and left Canton on the same date. Should this man seek
facilities here to enter Hong Kong, he should be refused.
page_data.zh:
(12)
警告通知，以防她前往马来亚其他地区。

23. 亚历山大·德鲁斯或德鲁特（DROUTH OR DROUT, ALEXANDRE）。（第7及14/34段）。
据信为俄国人，现持有法国身份证明文件。他在香港亚历山大大厦（Alexandra Building）内葡萄牙商号博特略兄弟公司（Botelho Brothers）的办公地点设有办事处，并租赁蒸汽船。据称他是“萨格里什”号轮船（s.s. "Sagres"）的所有者，该船至少曾从布什尔（Bushire）运载一批波斯鸦片航行一次。他于1934年2月21日从香港抵达新加坡，入住“海景”酒店（"Sea View" Hotel）。他于1934年2月23日乘坐“奥菲尔”号轮船（s.s. "Ophir"）驶往巴达维亚。

此人涉嫌从事非法鸦片和军火交易，若其再次访问马来亚，应将其作为秘密报告的对象。

此人于1934年2月28日乘坐“芝萨·达内”号轮船（s.s. "Tjisa Dane"）从巴达维亚直接驶往香港。

24. 米哈伊尔·格奥尔格维奇·法克图罗维奇（FAKTUROVITCH, MIHAIL GEORGEVITCH）。（第69/34段）。
波兰人，26岁，华沙人，持有1934年6月6日由广州公安局签发的第55号护照，自签发之日起有效期为一年。自称商人，但被强烈怀疑从事贩卖妇女活动。他导致十二名俄罗斯女性于1933年5月27日抵达香港，这些女性正前往澳门一家名声不佳的歌舞厅。他自称是安妮特·克卢尔（Annette Klur）的丈夫，克卢尔是一名俄罗斯妓女，在广州经营“德尔蒙特”酒吧（"Del Monte" Bar），并与B.E.佩洛斯（B.E. Perlos）（见第26页）有关联。法克图罗维奇与佩洛斯一同于1934年10月17日作为从上海前往广州的过境乘客抵达香港。他被勒令离开该殖民地，并于同日离开广州。若此人寻求在此获得进入香港的便利，应予以拒绝。

page_data.en:
(13)
25. FIFIELD, MISS A. (British).
See Dick Norton, page 25.
26. FINKELSON, MISS BETTY. (Para. 34/34).
Russian, born at Odessa on 22nd May, 1908. She
has been resident in Paris for the last eight years.
In November, 1933, the British Passport Central Office,
Paris, granted her a visa for Hong Kong to visit the An-
namite Secretary of the Hong Kong French Consulate whom
she claimed to have met in Paris. This gentleman did not
know her and states he has never been in Paris. Inform-
ation is that she is an associate of Annamite Communists
in Paris and that her object in visiting Hong Kong was
to join an Annamite named Felix Yung, well known to the
Hong Kong Police and whose mistress she had been in Paris.
She arrived in Hong Kong from France as a third class
passenger on the s.s. "D'Artagnan" on 22nd April, 1934,
having been refused permission to land at Saigon by the
Police. She was joined in Hong Kong by Nguyen Binh Nam
alias Felix Yung who wished to marry her. They left
together for Shanghai on 27th April, 1934, as she was
refused permission to stay in Hong Kong.
27. GARRONSTI, MADAME M. (Para. 5/32).
A Russian woman of French nationality by marriage.
Formerly a brothel keeper in Calcutta, Indo-China and
Shanghai. Prostituted herself in Singapore and also is
a drug addict. Deported from Singapore to Shanghai on
21st August, 1932, and will be refused permission to
land in the Colony in future.
28. (1) GEROMINI, JEAN (French). } (Paras. 10 & 48/34).
(2) POLI, ANTOIN (French). }
They are aged 35 and 40 years respectively and were
born in France. The Hong Kong Police searched a room
occupied by Poli at the Savarin Hotel on 30th December,
page_data.zh:
(13)
25. A·菲菲尔德小姐（FIFIELD, MISS A.）（英国籍）。
参见第25页迪克·诺顿（Dick Norton）。

26. 贝蒂·芬克尔森小姐（FINKELSON, MISS BETTY）。（第34/34段）。
俄罗斯人，1908年5月22日出生于敖德萨。过去八年一直居住在巴黎。1933年11月，位于巴黎的英国护照中央办公室向她签发了前往香港的签证，理由是探访她声称在巴黎结识的香港法国领事馆安南籍秘书。这位先生并不认识她，并表示从未去过巴黎。情报显示，她是巴黎安南共产党人的同伙，其访问香港的目的是加入一名名叫费利克斯·荣（Felix Yung）的安南人，此人为香港警方所熟知，且她在巴黎时曾是此人的情妇。她于1934年4月22日乘坐“达塔尼昂”号轮船（s.s. "D'Artagnan"）作为三等舱乘客从法国抵达香港，此前曾被警方拒绝在西贡登陆。阮平南（Nguyen Binh Nam），又名费利克斯·荣，在香港与她汇合，并希望与她结婚。由于她被拒绝留在香港，两人于1934年4月27日一同前往上海。

27. M·加龙斯蒂夫人（GARRONSTI, MADAME M.）。（第5/32段）。
因婚姻取得法国国籍的俄罗斯妇女。曾在加尔各答、印度支那和上海经营妓院。在新加坡从事卖淫活动，且吸毒成瘾。于1932年8月21日从新加坡被驱逐至上海，今后将被拒绝在该殖民地登陆。

28. (1) 让·杰罗米尼（GEROMINI, JEAN）（法国籍）。} （第10及48/34段）。
    (2) 安托万·波利（POLI, ANTOIN）（法国籍）。}
两人年龄分别为35岁和40岁，均出生于法国。1933年12月30日，香港警方搜查了波利在萨瓦林酒店（Savarin Hotel）占用的房间，在一个上锁的箱子里发现了一支装有子弹的手枪，后证实该手枪为杰罗米尼所有，杰罗米尼因此被判罪并被罚款250元。

1933, and found a loaded pistol in a locked box which was
later proved to be the property of Geromini and who was
convicted and fined $250.
Geromini paid the fine and left shortly afterwards
for Shanghai. He is expected to pass through Singapore
shortly on his way to France and should not be allowed to
land. Poli has been ordered to quit Hong Kong and should
not be allowed to land. Both these men are suspected
traffickers in women and narcotics and in Hong Kong Poli
was suspected of living on the earnings of a French
prostitute named Suzanne Declerck, referred to in page 9.
Geromini passed through Singapore on or about 29th
June, 1934, per the s.s. "Andre Lebon" en route for
France. He should not be allowed to land in the Colony.
29. GERRIT, VELDHUIS. (Para. 56/34).
A Netherlands subject, born at the Hague 1899, a
vagabond, unwilling to work and has been a constant nuisance
to the Netherlands Indian Police. He has been ordered to
be banished from Semarang to Holland by order of the
Netherlands Indian authorities. He should not be permitted
to land in Malaya.
30. GOUREVIDIS, DAVID SAVVA alias GOURIEVIDIS, DAVID alias
GOURIVITCH. (Para. 70/34).
Russian Jew, aged 46 years, returned to Shanghai from
Europe on s.s. "Conte Verde" on May 7th, 1934. He travelled
on a Greek Passport No.2627 granted in Paris on April 10th,
1934, and was accompanied by his wife Louise Etienot Gour-
evidis aged 30 years, who travelled on French Passport No.
13409, issued in Paris on April 10th, 1934. D.S. Goure-
vidis is now resident in Tientsin and is actively engaged
in smuggling narcotics to Europe with the assistance of
Isidore Rubock (ref. page 32 ). In February, 1932, he was
arrested in Paris and extradited to Germany at the request
page_data.zh:
(14)
杰罗米尼缴纳了罚款，随后不久前往上海。预计他将在前往法国途中短期内经过新加坡，不应允许其登陆。波利已被勒令离开香港，不应允许其登陆。这两人均被怀疑从事贩卖妇女和毒品活动，在香港，波利还被怀疑依靠一名名为苏珊娜·德克莱克（Suzanne Declerck）的法国妓女的收入生活，此人见于第9页。

杰罗米尼于1934年6月29日左右乘坐“安德烈·勒邦”号轮船（s.s. "Andre Lebon"）途经新加坡前往法国。不应允许其在该殖民地登陆。

29. 维尔德胡伊斯·赫里特（GERRIT, VELDHUIS）。（第56/34段）。
荷兰臣民，1899年出生于海牙，是个流浪汉，不愿工作，一直是荷属东印度警方的麻烦人物。根据荷属东印度当局的命令，他已被勒令从三宝垄驱逐至荷兰。不应允许其在马来亚登陆。

30. 大卫·萨瓦·古雷维迪斯（GOUREVIDIS, DAVID SAVVA），又名大卫·古里维迪斯（GOURIEVIDIS, DAVID），又名古里维奇（GOURIVITCH）。（第70/34段）。
俄罗斯犹太人，46岁，于1934年5月7日乘坐“孔特·韦尔德”号轮船（s.s. "Conte Verde"）从欧洲返回上海。他持有一本1934年4月10日在巴黎签发的希腊护照（第2627号），由其妻子路易丝·艾蒂诺·古雷维迪斯（Louise Etienot Gourevidis）陪同，其妻30岁，持有一本1934年4月10日在巴黎签发的法国护照（第13409号）。D.S.古雷维迪斯现居天津，并在伊西多尔·鲁博克（Isidore Rubock）（参见第32页）的协助下，积极从事向欧洲走私毒品的活动。1932年2月，他在巴黎被捕，并应汉堡预审法官的要求被引渡至德国，在被拘留期间，他承认自己在远东从事毒品交易。

of the Hamburg Examining Magistrate and whilst in custody,

the Far East.

31. GRAY, WILLIAM (Australian).
    See John Carson, page 5.

✓32. (1) GRUINFELD, ERNEST (Austrian). } (Paras. 2 & 66/34).
     (2) CHITTAN, MAX (German).       }

    The above persons arrived in Singapore on 20th January,
1934, in a small sailing boat "Satan" now anchored near
the Yacht Club. They are practically destitute and have
reached Singapore largely through the charity of others
and by journalism. Apart from their begging proclivities
No they have given no cause for complaint. (Ref. P.J. pages
58, 66, 73 and 78 of 1933). They sailed for Batavia on
30th January, 1934.

    Gruinfeld arrived in Singapore on 21st November,
1934, together with an Austrian named Walter Temmel.
They came from Batavia in their yacht "Satan III". They
sailed for Europe via Penang on 2nd December, 1934. Max
Chitten left Gruinfeld on 30th January, 1934, and proceeded
to Siam via F.M.S.

33. GUILLARMOD, LOUIS CHARLES JACOT. (Para. 22/35).
    A Swiss, aged 35 years in possession of Swiss Pass-
port No.080998/51, dated 2nd December, 1934. Last known
address 7, Studley Avenue, Shanghai. He is wanted by
the Shanghai Municipal Police on a Swiss Consular warrant
for theft and embezzlement. His photograph is filed in
the Detective Branch.

34. GUTIERREZ, J.A. or J.M.L. (Para. 55/34).
    British subject, born 1900 in Hong Kong of Portuguese
parents. In July, 1921, absconded after giving false
particulars in a hotel register and leaving without paying
his bill. In 1927 was reported to be touring the N.E.I.
accompanied by a Swatow Chinese named G. Garding collecting

31. 威廉·格雷（GRAY, WILLIAM）（澳大利亚籍）。
参见第5页约翰·卡森（John Carson）。

✓32. (1) 欧内斯特·格鲁因费尔德（GRUINFELD, ERNEST）（奥地利籍）。} （第2及66/34段）。
     (2) 马克斯·奇坦（CHITTAN, MAX）（德国籍）。       }

上述人员于1934年1月20日乘坐一艘名为“撒旦”号（"Satan"）的小型帆船抵达新加坡，该船现锚泊在游艇俱乐部附近。他们几乎身无分文，主要依靠他人的慈善救济和新闻工作才得以抵达新加坡。除了乞讨倾向外，他们没有引起任何投诉的理由。（参见1933年P.J.第58、66、73和78页）。他们于1934年1月30日驶往巴达维亚。

格鲁因费尔德于1934年11月21日与一名名为沃尔特·特梅尔（Walter Temmel）的奥地利人一同抵达新加坡。他们乘坐自己的游艇“撒旦三号”（"Satan III"）从巴达维亚而来。他们于1934年12月2日经槟城驶往欧洲。马克斯·奇坦于1934年1月30日离开格鲁因费尔德，经马来亚联合邦前往暹罗。

33. 路易·查尔斯·雅科·吉亚尔莫德（GUILLARMOD, LOUIS CHARLES JACOT）。（第22/35段）。
瑞士人，35岁，持有1934年12月2日签发的瑞士护照（第080998/51号）。最后已知地址为上海斯塔德利大道7号（7, Studley Avenue）。上海公共租界工部局警务处正依据瑞士领事馆的逮捕令通缉其盗窃和挪用公款罪行。其照片存档于侦探股。

34. J.A.或J.M.L.古铁雷斯（GUTIERREZ, J.A. or J.M.L.）。（第55/34段）。
英国臣民，1900年出生于香港，父母为葡萄牙人。1921年7月，他在酒店登记簿中提供虚假信息并未付账单便溜之大吉。据报道，1927年他在荷属东印度群岛巡回活动，伴同一位名为G·加丁（G. Garding）的汕头华人，为一家名为上海“远东传记公司”（"The Far Eastern Biographical Co."）的空壳公司募集捐款和收集个人传记资料。两人于1927年11月返回香港，并成立了一家名为“贝迪克顿宣传公司”（"Bedikton Publicity Co."）的诈骗机构，旨在出版一本《香港及华南名人录》。他们在中国沿海许多小港口巡回，从许多人那里收取钱财。1929年，香港对他发出了以欺诈手段盗窃罪名的逮捕令。1934年6月，他抵达马来亚，自称是德国贸易顾问，并开始为一份德国商业刊物募集订阅费。

"The Far Eastern Biographical Co." of Shanghai. The two
returned to Hong Kong in November, 1927, and started a
swindle called the "Bedikton Publicity Co." with the
object of publishing a "Who's Who in Hong Kong and South
China". They toured many outports along the China coast
collecting money from numerous people. In 1929 a warrant
was issued in Hong Kong against him on a charge of larceny
by a trick. In June, 1934, he arrived in Malaya representing
himself to be a German Trade Counsellor and commenced to
collect subscriptions for a German commercial paper.

He was located Malacca on 6th July, 1934, but left on
17th July, 1934, for Seremban. There is no trace of his
present whereabouts. The German Consulate are very anxious
to put a stop to his activities and a report is requested

35. HALEY, MISS ALBERTINA.
See Miss Paula Burton, page 5.

36. HARDIE, FRED. (Para. 17/35).
Arrived in Singapore in April last from Hong Kong
accompanied by his wife. Resided at the Capitol Flats
and posed as a psycho-analyst. He soon obtained a large
clientele by his very persuasive manners. Is an Australian
by birth. On 26th July, 1935, left for Java by the s.s.
"Plancius". His return should be reported to the Detective
Branch, Singapore.

37. HOPNER, IRINGARD (German).
See Karl Becker, page 4.

38. HORNSTEIN, LUDWIG VON.
See Mrs. Margaret Foutsma, Page 27.

39. HUND, JEAN. (Para. 51/34).
French subject, male, born at Strasburg, 3rd November, 1902.
page_data.zh:
(16)
他于1934年7月6日在马六甲被发现，但于1934年7月17日离开前往芙蓉（Seremban）。目前其下落不明。德国领事馆非常希望制止其活动，若发现其踪迹，请提交报告。

35. 阿尔贝蒂娜·哈利小姐（HALEY, MISS ALBERTINA）。
参见第5页葆拉·伯顿小姐（Miss Paula Burton）。

36. 弗雷德·哈迪（HARDIE, FRED）。（第17/35段）。
去年四月与其妻子一同从香港抵达新加坡。居住在国会公寓（Capitol Flats），伪装成精神分析师。他凭借极具说服力的举止很快获得了大量客户。出生地为澳大利亚。1935年7月26日，他乘坐“普兰修斯”号轮船（s.s. "Plancius"）前往爪哇。若其返回，应向新加坡侦探股报告。

37. 伊林加德·霍普纳（HOPNER, IRINGARD）（德国籍）。
参见第4页卡尔·贝克尔（Karl Becker）。

38. 路德维希·冯·霍恩斯坦（HORNSTEIN, LUDWIG VON）。
参见第27页玛格丽特·福茨马夫人（Mrs. Margaret Foutsma）。

39. 让·亨德（HUND, JEAN）。（第51/34段）。
法国臣民，男性，1902年11月3日出生于斯特拉斯堡。

page_data.en:
(17)
Travels on French passport No.68, issued in Hong Kong on
23rd August, 1930, renewed valid until 3rd December, 1934.
In 1928 was manager of the International Country
Club in Shanghai. In 1929 he arrived in Hong Kong and
became manager of the St. Francis Hotel. In August, 1932,
he departed to avoid pressure from a number of creditors.
A large sum of money was deposited to him for safe keeping
by a lady resident of the Hotel which he repaid by a
cheque which was subsequently dishonoured. He has issued
many worthless cheques.
He arrived in Singapore in January, 1933, and became
an assistant manager in Raffles Hotel. On 11th March,
and
1933, he was convicted/fined for offences under the Regis-
tration of Aliens Ordinance. He was dismissed from his
position in Raffles Hotel on 11th June, 1934, for inefficien-
cy. He left for Kuala Lumpur by train on 14th June, 1934.
On 18th June, 1934, he left for Ipoh ostensibly bound
for Siam. His present whereabouts are unknown.
40. IORIOFILI, GIOVANNI.
See Mrs. Dora Strzeszak, page 35.
41. KAMINSKI, STANISLAU. (Paras. 21, 46 & 61/34).
Pole, born at Warsaw, 1892, describes himself as a
merchant. Married, wife named Maria Kaminski. In possess-
ion of a joint passport issued by the Polish Consulate,
Harbin, on 20th December, 1932, valid until 20th December,
1934, No.2523, Serial No. 31252.
Kaminski lives on his wits and requires watching. In
August, 1933, he was arrested by the Hong Kong Police on two
counts of cheating but on 25th August, 1933, was discharged
owing to insufficient evidence.
He arrived in Singapore from Bangkok by train on
6th March, 1934, and left on the evening of 7th March,
1934, by train for Penang. The reasons for his visit to
page_data.zh:
(17)
持1930年8月23日在香港签发的法国护照（第68号），续期有效期至1934年12月3日。

1928年，他担任上海国际乡村俱乐部（International Country Club）经理。1929年抵达香港，成为圣弗朗西斯酒店（St. Francis Hotel）经理。1932年8月，他为躲避多名债权人的追讨而离去。一位居住在该酒店的女士曾存入一大笔钱款由其保管，他开具了一张支票偿还，但该支票随后被拒付。他曾开具多张空头支票。

他于1933年1月抵达新加坡，成为莱佛士酒店的副经理。1933年3月11日，他因违反《外人登记条例》被判罪/罚款。1934年6月11日，他因工作效率低下被莱佛士酒店解职。1934年6月14日，他乘火车前往吉隆坡。1934年6月18日，他离开前往怡保，表面上是前往暹罗。目前其下落不明。

40. 乔瓦尼·约里奥菲利（IORIOFILI, GIOVANNI）。
参见第35页多拉·斯特热扎克夫人（Mrs. Dora Strzeszak）。

41. 斯坦尼斯劳·卡明斯基（KAMINSKI, STANISLAU）。（第21、46及61/34段）。
波兰人，1892年出生于华沙，自称商人。已婚，妻子名为玛丽亚·卡明斯基（Maria Kaminski）。持有1932年12月20日由波兰驻哈尔滨领事馆签发的联合护照，有效期至1934年12月20日，号码为2523，序列号为31252。

卡明斯基靠耍小聪明过活，需要监视。1933年8月，他因两项欺诈罪被香港警方逮捕，但因证据不足，于1933年8月25日被释放。

他于1934年3月6日乘火车从曼谷抵达新加坡，并于1934年3月7日晚乘火车离开前往槟城。他此次访问的原因

page_data.en:
(18)
Singapore are not known. He should be made the subject of
a discreet report if encountered in Malaya.
On 27th June, 1934, was arrested at Allahabad, United
Provinces, India, on instructions from the Cawnpore
(U.P.) Police in connection with the theft of Rs. 61,000
from the Karachi Currency Office. He was found in possess-
ion of approximately Rs. 34,000 believed to be part of the
stolen property. He is in custody in Cawnpore awaiting
trial. The Indian Police have been requested to furnish a
full report on his activities.
He was convicted on 10th September, 1934, at Karachi,
India, under section 380, I.P.C. and was sentenced to 12
months'R.I. plus a fine of Rs. 200 or in default of payment
of the fine to a further 3 months' R.I. His finger prints
disclose that he is well known to the Shanghai Police
under the names of Burto Mikai alias Korolich alias Shoorka
Tzygan alias Grishia, a Rumanian subject. He first came
under the notice of the Shanghai Municipal Police on 13th
May, 1921, when he was convicted on a charge of attempted
theft from the person and was sentenced to two months'
R.I. On 10th April, 1922, he was again convicted on a
similar charge and was sentenced to 3 months' R.I. to be
followed by deportation to Vladivostok. In April, 1928, he
returned to Shanghai and was convicted on a charge of
assaulting the Police and was fined $50.
He next came under notice of the Police during 1929 when
he arrived in Alexandria, Egypt. He was arrested on 14th
February, 1929, by the Alexandria City Police on suspicion
of being a pick-pocket. No Court proceedings followed but
he was ordered to leave Egypt forthwith. He journeyed to
Japan and in October, 1929, was arrested by the Tokyo
Metropolitan Police and was sentenced to two years' R.I.
on a charge of larceny by a trick. He left Japan for
page_data.zh:
(18)
在新加坡的情况不详。如果在马来亚遇到此人，应将其作为秘密报告的对象。
1934年6月27日，根据印度联合省坎普尔（Cawnpore, U.P.）警方的指示，他在印度联合省阿拉哈巴德（Allahabad）被捕，涉嫌从卡拉奇货币办公室盗窃61,000卢比。被发现持有约34,000卢比，据信是赃款的一部分。他目前被羁押在坎普尔等待审判。已要求印度警方提供其活动情况的完整报告。
1934年9月10日，他在印度卡拉奇根据《印度刑法典》第380条被判有罪，判处12个月苦役（R.I.），并处罚金200卢比，若无力缴纳罚金，则追加3个月苦役。他的指纹显示，上海警方以Burto Mikai之名（别名Korolich、别名Shoorka Tzygan、别名Grishia）对其十分熟悉，系罗马尼亚籍臣民。他首次引起上海公共租界工部局警务处注意是在1921年5月13日，当时他因企图扒窃罪名成立，被判处两个月苦役。1922年4月10日，他再次因类似罪名被判有罪，被判处3个月苦役，随后驱逐至符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostok）。1928年4月，他返回上海，因袭击警察罪名成立，被罚款50元。
1929年间，他抵达埃及亚历山大港时再次引起警方注意。1929年2月14日，他因涉嫌扒窃被亚历山大市警察局逮捕。未进行法庭诉讼，但被勒令立即离开埃及。他前往日本，并于1929年10月被东京警视厅逮捕，因诈骗盗窃罪被判处两年苦役。服刑期满后，他离开日本前往

Shanghai after serving his sentence and on 6th January,
1933, was sentenced to six months' R.I. on a charge of
shop-lifting. The sentence was reduced to two months'
R.I. on appeal. He was released on April 6th, 1933, when
he proceeded to Hong Kong. In August, 1933, he was
charged before the Hong Kong Police Court on a charge of
larceny by a trick but was released owing to insufficient
evidence being forthcoming. He was then in possession of
a Polish passport No.2523 issued at Harbin on 20th Decem-
ber, 1932.
He should not be allowed to land in the Colony.
42. KARP, JACQUES (Latvian). (Paras. 37, 41 & 60/34).
The above named who describes himself as a manufac-
turer's representative, arrived in Singapore from Genoa
on 23rd May, 1934, and stayed at the Y.M.C.A. He was
in possession of a passport issued in Paris on 23rd
January, 1929, and intends leaving for Hong Kong on 6th
June, 1934, where his address is 8th floor, Pedder Build-
ings. He was born at Riga on 26th November, 1908. He
was the subject of a report by the British Consul-General,
Shanghai in 1932, as being a suspected dealer in arms
and ammunition. In Singapore he received four parcels
through the Netherlands Trading Society consigned to him
by a firm in Switzerland and in view of certain suspicious
circumstances connected with their receipt a search of
the parcels was made but were found to contain nothing but
watches. A search of his correspondence shewed however,
that he was in communication with a certain person in
France interested in the drug traffic. He should be made
the subject of a discreet report if he re-visits Malaya.
He sailed for Hong Kong on 6th June, 1934.
He arrived in Singapore from Hong Kong per s.s.
"Conte Verde" on 15th October, 1934. He stated it was
page_data.zh:
(19)
上海，并于1933年1月6日因商店行窃罪被判处六个月苦役。上诉后刑期减为两个月苦役。他于1933年4月6日获释，随即前往香港。1933年8月，他在香港警署法庭被控诈骗盗窃，但因证据不足而被释放。当时他持有一本波兰护照，号码为2523，于1932年12月20日在哈尔滨签发。
不应允许其在殖民地登陆。
42. KARP, JACQUES（拉脱维亚人）。（参见第37、41及60/34段）。
上述自称为制造商代表的人，于1934年5月23日从热那亚抵达新加坡，入住基督教青年会（Y.M.C.A.）。他持有一本1929年1月23日在巴黎签发的护照，并打算于1934年6月6日前往香港，其在港地址为毕打街大楼（Pedder Buildings）八楼。他于1908年11月26日出生于里加。1932年，英国驻上海总领事曾提交关于他的报告，怀疑其为军火弹药贩子。在新加坡期间，他通过荷兰贸易公司（Netherlands Trading Society）收到了由一家瑞士公司寄给他的四个包裹，鉴于接收过程中存在某些可疑情况，对包裹进行了搜查，但发现内仅装有手表。然而，对其信件的搜查显示，他与法国一名从事毒品交易的人士有联系。如果他再次访问马来亚，应将其作为秘密报告的对象。
他于1934年6月6日乘船前往香港。
他于1934年10月15日乘坐“康特·韦尔德”号（s.s. "Conte Verde"）轮船从香港抵达新加坡。他表示

page_data.en:
(20)
his intention to proceed to Europe per the s.s. "Conte
Rosso" on 19th October, 1934, to attend the Trade Fair at
Olympia in 1935. He changed his mind however, and returned
to Hong Kong on 27th October, 1934, by the s.s. "Carthage".
43. KEHL, PAUL (Swiss). (Para. 38/34).
The above named aged 22 years was deported from Japan
to Switzerland at the instance of the Tokyo Police in
February last passing through Singapore on the s.s.
"Katori Maru" 22nd February, 1934. In Switzerland he was
committed to a reformatory from whence he has now escaped
and is believed to be on his way again to the Far East.
He should be prevented from landing in Malaya and a report
made to the Immigration Office.
44. KELLY, FREDERICK A.
See Charles Ernest Vickers, page 38.
45. KING, WILLIAM GEORGE HENRY. (Para. 9/35).
Is said to have partly financed the London Musical
Comedy Co. He remained in Rangoon where an application
by him for a passport to Singapore was held up. He is
a drug smuggler. He has not yet visited Singapore.
46. KOMLENKO, VASSILI JOHN (Persian).
See Vladislav Peter Curylo, page 7.
47. KUHNLE, HERDMAN.
See Mrs. Margaret Poutsma, page 27.
48. (1) KUTRON, JULES.
(2) KUTRON, JOSEPH AND HIS WIFE JULIA KUTRON. } (Paras. 50/34 &
10/35).
Hungarian dancers of the semi-destitute type. They
were found living in a Chinese hotel in Hong Kong having
arrived there from Shanghai in March last. Both the men
admit having been expelled from England as undesirable
aliens and have been the subject of Foreign Office Cir-
culars. They left Hong Kong for Manila per the s.s.
"President Hoover" on 7th June, 1934, and should not be
page_data.zh:
(20)
他打算于1934年10月19日乘坐“康特·罗索”号（s.s. "Conte Rosso"）轮船前往欧洲，参加1935年在奥林匹亚举办的贸易博览会。但他改变了主意，并于1934年10月27日乘坐“迦太基”号（s.s. "Carthage"）轮船返回香港。
43. KEHL, PAUL（瑞士人）。（参见第38/34段）。
上述人士，现年22岁，去年二月在东京警方的要求下从日本被驱逐至瑞士，途经新加坡，于1934年2月22日乘坐“香取丸”号（s.s. "Katori Maru"）轮船。在瑞士，他被送入感化院，现已从该院逃脱，据信正再次前往远东。应阻止其在马来亚登陆，并向移民局报告。
44. KELLY, FREDERICK A.
参见Charles Ernest Vickers，第38页。
45. KING, WILLIAM GEORGE HENRY。（参见第9/35段）。
据称部分资助了伦敦音乐喜剧团（London Musical Comedy Co.）。他留在仰光，其申请前往新加坡的护照被扣留。他是毒品走私犯。他尚未访问过新加坡。
46. KOMLENKO, VASSILI JOHN（波斯人）。
参见Vladislav Peter Curylo，第7页。
47. KUHNLE, HERDMAN。
参见Mrs. Margaret Poutsma，第27页。
48. (1) KUTRON, JULES。
(2) KUTRON, JOSEPH及其妻子JULIA KUTRON。 } （参见第50/34及
10/35段）。
匈牙利舞者，生活半贫困状态。他们于今年三月从上海抵达香港后，被发现居住在一家华人旅馆中。两名男子均承认曾因不受欢迎的外国人身份被英国驱逐，并成为英国外交部通函的对象。他们于1934年6月7日乘坐“胡佛总统”号（s.s. "President Hoover"）轮船离开香港前往马尼拉，且不应

page_data.en:
(21)
allowed to land in the Colony.
Jose Kutron and Julia Kutron, Hungarian dancers (of
semi-destitute type) arrived on the 29th April, 1935.
They made a deposit and were then allowed to land. They
travelled from Sarawak on a letter from the Chief Police
Officer, Kuching in lieu of passport. Jose admits to
having been expelled from England.
44. LANDQUIST, AUSTIN W. (Para.14/35).
American, arrived in Singapore, 16th December, 1934,
from New York as agent of a concern known as the British
American Holding Co., formed for the purpose of exploiting
a method of packing durian fruit in tins for export from
Malaya to the U.S.A. He was accompanied by an assistant
named Arthur S. Flowers. On 18th July, 1935, Landquist
absconded to America per the s.s. "Thurland Castle"
leaving Flowers stranded and with heavy bills to meet.
Landquist is stated to be an undischarged bankrupt in
New York and his return to Malaya should be immediately
reported to the Detective Branch, Singapore, where his
photograph is filed.
45. LAPIN, FRITZ. (Para. 20/34).
Aged 35 years, height about 5 ft. 10 ins. He has
prominent cheek bones, is clean shaven and heavily built.
This man is a Latvian. He has a criminal record in Shang-
hai for dealing in drugs and is strongly suspected of
being engaged in the white slave traffic. This man came
to Hong Kong in April, 1932 accompanied by an attractive
young Russian actress named Nadedja N. Sintsina profess-
ionally known as "Astrova" and the pair joined a ship
bound for South America. Lapin said that the woman was
his wife but there is a doubt about this. Recently Hong
Kong Police received an enquiry from the British Consul-
General, Shanghai, which had originated from some Russian
page_data.zh:
(21)
被允许在殖民地登陆。
Jose Kutron和Julia Kutron，匈牙利舞者（生活半贫困状态），于1935年4月29日抵达。他们缴纳了保证金，随后获准登陆。他们凭古晋警察局长出具的介绍信代替护照，从砂拉越旅行至此。Jose承认曾被英国驱逐。
44. LANDQUIST, AUSTIN W.（参见第14/35段）。
美国人，于1934年12月16日从纽约抵达新加坡，作为一家名为英美控股公司（British American Holding Co.）的机构的代理人，该公司成立的目的是开发一种将榴莲装入罐头以便从马来亚出口到美国的方法。随行有一名名为Arthur S. Flowers的助手。1935年7月18日，Landquist乘坐“瑟兰城堡”号（s.s. "Thurland Castle"）轮船潜逃至美国，留下Flowers身陷困境并面临巨额账单。据称Landquist在纽约是未解除破产状态的破产者，一旦其返回马来亚，应立即向新加坡刑事侦缉处报告，该处存有他的照片档案。
45. LAPIN, FRITZ。（参见第20/34段）。
现年35岁，身高约5英尺10英寸。颧骨突出，面部无须，体格魁梧。此人为拉脱维亚人。他在上海有贩卖毒品的犯罪记录，并强烈涉嫌参与白奴贸易。此人于1932年4月来到香港，随行的有一位名叫Nadedja N. Sintsina的年轻迷人的俄罗斯女演员，艺名“Astrova”，两人登上了一艘开往南美洲的船只。Lapin称该女子为其妻子，但此事存疑。最近，香港警方收到来自英国驻上海总领事的查询，该查询源于上海的一些俄罗斯

page_data.en:
(22)
residents of Shanghai, regarding a rumour which they had heard
about a Russian woman named Astrova said to be undergoing
a ten years prison sentence in Hong Kong. There is no such
prisoner in Hong Kong, and it is suspected that the person
for whom the Russians are enquiring is the woman who
accompanied Lapin to South America. If such is the case
it is possible that Lapin has disposed of her there and
has started the rumour that she is in Hong Kong prison
to account for her disappearance. Enquiries are being
made. He should not be allowed to land in the Colony.
46. LUND, F.O. (Para. 2/32) (P.J. ref. para. 61/32).
A Norwegian married to a Russian woman left Penang
for Bangkok on 15th August, 1932, after being interrogated
by the Detective Branch, Penang.
This man is a swindler who poses to deal in counter-
feit notes for the purposes of cheating. Steps have
been taken to prevent this re-entry into Malaya. He
also came under notice of Police in Kuala Lumpur and
Singapore.
One of his associates and accomplices is a Singapore
born Hokkien named Tan Hood Leong who poses as a salesman.
This Chinese is known as a business fraud.
47. (1) MACDONALD, DONALD G. }
(2) PATTISON, WILLIAM J. } (Para. 20/35).
Americans, arrived in Singapore from Manila on 9th
July, 1935, stayed at the Metropole Hotel and later moved
to 610, Serangoon Road where they are now living. They
claim to be representatives of the International Distri-
bution Company, a concern formed for the purpose of
canvassing orders for portrait (photographic) enlarge-
ments. Experience has proved that similar previous
ventures have been fraudulent and discreet observation
page_data.zh:
(22)
居民，关于他们听到的一则谣言，称一名名为Astrova的俄罗斯女子正在香港服刑十年。香港并无此类囚犯，怀疑俄罗斯人所查询的对象即是陪同Lapin前往南美洲的那名女子。如果情况属实，Lapin可能已在当地处置了她，并散布她在香港监狱的谣言以解释其失踪。正在进行调查。不应允许其在殖民地登陆。
46. LUND, F.O.（参见第2/32段）（P.J. 参考第61/32段）。
一名挪威人，娶了一名俄罗斯女子，在接受槟城刑事侦缉处讯问后，于1932年8月15日离开槟城前往曼谷。
此人是一名骗子，假装从事假钞交易以实施诈骗。已采取措施防止其再次进入马来亚。他也曾引起吉隆坡和新加坡警方的注意。
其同伙之一是一名生于新加坡的福建人，名为Tan Hood Leong，伪装成推销员。这名华人 known as a business fraud（已知为商业欺诈者）。
47. (1) MACDONALD, DONALD G. }
(2) PATTISON, WILLIAM J. } （参见第20/35段）。
美国人，于1935年7月9日从马尼拉抵达新加坡，入住大都会酒店（Metropole Hotel），后搬至实笼岗路610号，现居住于此。他们声称是国际分销公司（International Distribution Company）的代表，该公司成立的目的是招揽肖像（摄影）放大订单。经验表明，类似的先前 ventures（企业/尝试）均为欺诈行为，应对其行动保持秘密监视。要求向新加坡刑事侦缉处提交报告。
48. (1) MAIER, KARL, A. )
             } （参见第1/35段）。
    (2) WANDRES, F.   )
        德国人。于1934年10月10日从香港抵达新加坡。Wandres自称为商人，Maier自称为销售经理，为美国纽约联合发行公司（Union Circulation Company）销售期刊。已收到投诉，称这两人试图通过重复收取订阅费进行诈骗。
        两人均为不受欢迎的人物，目前在槟城，均不应再被允许在马来亚登陆。
49. MARINO, MDLE. EMELIE MARIE。（参见第12/34段）。
        现年28岁，法国马赛人。妓女，与第13页提到的Jean Geromini有关联。她目前居住在香港，但已被勒令离境。不应允许其在殖民地登陆。
50. MICHEL, MDLE. MARIE LOUISE。（参见第49/34段）。
        法国人，妓女。她最近从西贡前往上海，于1934年6月29日乘坐“费利克斯·鲁塞尔”号（s.s. "Felix Roussell"）轮船途经香港。她是Poli团伙的另一名成员。（参见第13页）不应允许其在殖民地登陆。
✓51. MOTZ, VICTOR E.
        俄罗斯人，现年33岁，出生于俄罗斯苏瓦乌基（Suvalk），持中国护照第21号旅行，该护照由广州市公安局于1932年11月14日签发。Motz最近与Katie Ackerman小姐结婚，Katie是九龙Katie美容院的俄罗斯老板娘，婚礼在广州举行。随后，Motz获准持有效期仅为14天的签证前往香港，并于1932年12月12日抵达此地。后续调查显示

page_data.en:
(23)
should be kept on their movements. Reports are requested
to the Detective Branch, Singapore.
48. (1) MAIER, KARL, A. )
             } (Para. 1/35).
    (2) WANDRES, F.   )
        Germans. Arrived Singapore from Hong Kong on 10th
October, 1934. Wandres describes himself as a Merchant and
Maier as a Sales manager, selling periodicals for the Union
Circulation Company of New York, U.S.A. Complaints have
been received that these two men attempt to cheat by collec-
ting subscriptions twice over.
        Both are undesirable characters and are now in Penang,
neither should be allowed to land in Malaya again.
49. MARINO, MDLE. EMELIE MARIE. (Para. 12/34).
        Aged 28 years and native of Marseille, France. A
prostitute and an associate of Jean Geromini referred to
in page 13. She is now resident in Hong Kong but has
been ordered to quit. She should not be allowed to land
in the Colony.
50. MICHEL, MDLE. MARIE LOUISE. (Para. 49/34).
        French, a prostitute. She left Saigon for Shanghai
recently passing through Hong Kong per the s.s. "Felix
Roussell" on 29th June, 1934. She is another member of the
Poli gang. (See page 13) She should not be allowed to land
in the Colony.
✓51. MOTZ, VICTOR E.
        Russian aged 33 years, born at Suvalk, Russia, and
travelling on Chinese Passport No. 21 issued by the Bureau
of Public Safety, Canton, on 14th November, 1932. Motz
recently married Miss Katie Ackerman, Russian proprietress
of Katie's Beauty Parlour, Kowloon, the ceremony taking
place in Canton. Motz was subsequently permitted to come
to Hong Kong on a visa limited to 14 days and arrived
here on 12th December, 1932. Subsequent enquiries revealed
page_data.zh:
(23)
应对其行踪保持监控。现请求向新加坡警探科提交报告。

48. (1) 迈尔，卡尔 (MAIER, KARL, A.) )
             } （第 1/35 段）。
    (2) 万德雷斯，F. (WANDRES, F.)   )
        德国人。于 1934 年 10 月 10 日从香港抵达新加坡。万德雷斯自称是商人，并称迈尔为销售经理，二人负责推销美国纽约联合发行公司（Union Circulation Company）的期刊。已收到投诉，称此二人企图通过重复收取订阅费进行诈骗。
        二人均为不受欢迎人物，目前身在槟城，均不应再获准在马来亚登陆。

49. 马里诺，埃梅莉·玛丽小姐 (MARINO, MDLE. EMELIE MARIE)。（第 12/34 段）。
        28 岁，法国马赛人。妓女，系第 13 页所述让·杰罗米尼（Jean Geromini）的同伙。她目前居住在香港，但已被勒令离境。不应允许其在本殖民地登陆。

50. 米歇尔，玛丽·路易丝小姐 (MICHEL, MDLE. MARIE LOUISE)。（第 49/34 段）。
        法国人，妓女。她最近离开西贡前往上海，于 1934 年 6 月 29 日乘坐“费利克斯·鲁塞尔”号（s.s. "Felix Roussell"）轮船途经香港。她是波利团伙（Poli gang）的另一名成员。（见第 13 页）不应允许其在本殖民地登陆。

✓51. 莫茨，维克多·E. (MOTZ, VICTOR E.)。
        俄罗斯人，33 岁，生于俄罗斯苏瓦乌基（Suvalk），持中国护照第 21 号旅行，该护照由广州市公安局于 1932 年 11 月 14 日签发。莫茨最近与凯蒂·阿克曼小姐（Miss Katie Ackerman）结婚，阿克曼系俄罗斯人，为九龙“凯蒂美容院”（Katie's Beauty Parlour）的业主，婚礼在广州举行。随后，莫茨获发有效期仅为 14 天的签证来港，并于 1932 年 12 月 12 日抵达此处。后续调查显示

page_data.en:
(24)
that Motz had served one year in prison in Shanghai for
larceny being released on 15th June, 1932. His "Modus
Operandi" is given as follows:- "Frequents banks.
Waits for some one to place money on the counter, approaches
in such a way as to be within reach of the money, and
engages them in conversation and then steals the money.
Works with an accomplice. Motz was ordered to quit Hong
Kong and sailed for Canton by the s. s. "Taishan" on 30th
December, 1932.
52. "PRINCE" MOULAY MOHAMED SAID EL JIBAVI EL HASSANI,
(Paras. 19 & 27/35).
Poses as a Moorish prince and is now travelling the
Far East in an endeavour to obtain financial assistance
from rich Mohammedans. Visited India in 1925, 1933 and
1934, where he came under notice of the Police on complaints
from leading Mohammedan merchants. He again visited India
from France on 6th April, 1935, and later left for Malaya.
He arrived in Singapore on 9th July, 1935, and is now stay-
ing at the Lanka Hotel, Trafalgar Street. His movements
are being watched as he may become a charge on the author-
ities. His name has been included on the Indian list of
suspects to whom passport facilities should not be granted
without prior reference to Delhi. His photograph is filed
in the Detective Branch.
He has left Singapore for Manila.
53. NEIMAN, ISAAC ARONOFF. (Para. 21/35).
A Russian Jew profession chemist who has a criminal
record in Shanghai. With his mistress was concerned in
a night club swindle in the French Concession, Shameen;
Canton in August, 1932. Neiman evaded arrest by abscond-
ing leaving his three children destitute in Hong Kong.
The children are now in the care of the French Convent,
page_data.zh:
(24)
Motz曾因盗窃罪在上海服刑一年，于1932年6月15日获释。其“作案手法”如下：“经常光顾银行。等待某人在柜台放置钱款，以能够触及钱款的方式靠近，与其攀谈，然后窃取钱款。与同伙一起作案。” Motz被勒令离开香港，并于1932年12月30日乘坐“泰山”号（s. s. "Taishan"）轮船前往广州。
52. “王子” MOULAY MOHAMED SAID EL JIBAVI EL HASSANI，
（参见第19及27/35段）。
伪装成摩尔人王子，目前在远东游历，试图从富有的穆斯林那里获得经济援助。曾于1925年、1933年和1934年访问印度，因主要穆斯林商人的投诉而引起警方注意。他于1935年4月6日再次从法国访问印度，随后前往马来亚。他于1935年7月9日抵达新加坡，目前住在特拉法加街（Trafalgar Street）的兰卡酒店（Lanka Hotel）。由于其可能成为当局的负担，其行动正受到监视。他的名字已被列入印度嫌疑人名单，未经事先请示德里，不得向其提供护照便利。其照片存档于刑事侦缉处。
他已离开新加坡前往马尼拉。
53. NEIMAN, ISAAC ARONOFF。（参见第21/35段）。
俄罗斯犹太裔职业化学家，在上海有犯罪记录。1932年8月，他与情妇在法租界、沙面（Shameen）；广州的一家夜总会诈骗案中有关联。Neiman通过潜逃躲避逮捕，留下三个孩子在香港陷入贫困。孩子们目前由法国修道院照顾，

page_data.en:
(25)
Hong Kong. Neiman is now reported to be in Bangkok and
should not be permitted to land in Malaya.
54. 1. NORTON, DICK. (British). } (Paras. 3, 6, 13 & 23/34).
2. FIFIELD, MISS A. (British). }
They arrived in Penang from Rangoon on 21st January, 1934,
and left on 24th January, 1934, for Kuala Lumpur and Sing-
apore. Whilst in Penang they endeavoured to obtain en-
gagements at hotels as entertainers but without success.
Norton left Penang without paying his hotel bill and
attempted to borrow money from various people but was
only successful on one occasion when he succeeded in
borrowing $80 from a South African acquaintance. He is
destitute and living on his wits and should be noted for
discreet observation. He formerly toured India in charge
of a concert party known as the "Globe Trotters" and passed
off several worthless cheques.
This couple are now in Singapore and staying at
the Raffles Hotel. They are giving theatrical performances
at cinemas and appear to be in funds.
It has been ascertained that Norton's real name is
Richard Goatcher and that he is a native of London.
They left Singapore for Shanghai by the s.s. "Takada"
on 15th March, 1934, with the intention of recruiting a
troupe of dancing girls and are expected to return shortly.
He has written from Hong Kong stating that he
proposes to re-visit Malaya shortly bringing with him
two Russian dancers named Dmitry Dimoff and Miss Tamara
Chumakoff. He has been granted permission to bring them
to Malaya provided he can furnish security.
55. OGLI, LOLA.
See Vladislav Peter Curylo, page 7.
56. OGLY, LAZO AHMED. (Para. 4/32) (P.J. ref. para. 53/32).
A suspected trafficker in drugs. Arrived in Penang
page_data.zh:
(25)
香港。据报奈曼（Neiman）现身处曼谷，不应获准在马来亚登陆。
54. 1. 诺顿，迪克（NORTON, DICK）。（英国籍）。} （第3、6、13及23/34段）。
2. 菲菲尔德小姐（FIFIELD, MISS A.）。（英国籍）。}
他们于1934年1月21日从仰光抵达槟城，并于1934年1月24日离开前往吉隆坡和新加坡。在槟城期间，他们试图在酒店谋得艺人职位，但未成功。
诺顿未付酒店账单便离开槟城，并试图向多人借款，但仅在一次成功从一位南非熟人处借得80元。他身无分文，靠小聪明度日，应予以 discreet observation（谨慎监视/暗中观察）。他此前曾负责一个名为“环球旅行者”（Globe Trotters）的音乐团在印度巡回演出，并兑现了数张空头支票。
这对男女目前在新加坡，住在莱佛士酒店（Raffles Hotel）。他们在电影院进行戏剧表演，看似资金充裕。
经查实，诺顿的真名是理查德·戈彻（Richard Goatcher），系伦敦人。
他们于1934年3月15日乘“高田丸”号（s.s. "Takada"）轮船从新加坡前往上海，意图招募一批舞女，预计不久后返回。
他从香港来信称，他计划不久后重访马来亚，并带来两名俄罗斯舞者，分别是德米特里·季莫夫（Dmitry Dimoff）和塔玛拉·楚马科娃小姐（Miss Tamara Chumakoff）。已获准将他们带往马来亚，前提是他能提供担保。
55. 奥格利，洛拉（OGLI, LOLA）。
参见弗拉迪斯拉夫·彼得·库里洛（Vladislav Peter Curylo），第7页。
56. 奥格利，拉佐·艾哈迈德（OGLY, LAZO AHMED）。（第4/32段）（警务杂志参考第53/32段）。
涉嫌毒品贩运者。于1932年8月25日

page_data.en:
.(26)
from Moulmein on 25th August, 1932, accompanied by a
woman. He had been previously refused permission to
land in the Colony but on this occasion evaded the
Passport Officers and succeeded in landing. He has been
arrested and convicted. The steamship company concerned
was also prosecuted. He has now left Malaya and should
not be permitted to return.
57. PATTISON, WILLIAM J.
See Donald G. MacDonald, page 22.
58. PERLOS, BORIS ESAKOVICH. (Para. 68/34).
Russian Jew, aged 41 years, native of Odessa. At
present holding Chinese Passport No.178899, issued by
the Bureau of Public Safety, Shanghai, on 4th January,
1934, and valid for 1 year; describes himself as a mer-
chant.
In 1929 he was refused a British visa by H.B.M.
Consul-General, Shanghai, to travel to Canton via Hong
Kong with a Russian woman as he was suspected to be en-
gaged in the white slave traffic and to be disposing of
women to certain Russian brothels in Canton. On 6th
April, 1931, he arrived in Hong Kong with a transit visa
but was sent to Canton under Police orders on 10th April,
1931. On 17th October, 1934, Perlos was arrested in
Hong Kong and fined $100 for a breach of the passport
regulations and expelled to Canton on 18th October, 1934,
by order of the Police Magistrate. On this occasion he
was accompanied by one M.G. Fakturovitch (see page 13),
another bad character, suspected to be engaged in illicit
traffic in women. Perlos should not be permitted to land
in the Colony.
59. POLI, ANTOIN. (French).
See Jean Geromini, page 13.
page_data.zh:
.(26)
由毛淡棉（Moulmein）抵达槟城，随同一名女子。他此前曾被拒绝在该殖民地登陆，但此次他避开了护照官员并成功登陆。他已被逮捕并定罪。涉事轮船公司亦被起诉。他现已离开马来亚，不应获准返回。
57. 帕蒂森，威廉·J.（PATTISON, WILLIAM J.）。
参见唐纳德·G. 麦克唐纳（Donald G. MacDonald），第22页。
58. 佩尔洛斯，鲍里斯·埃萨科维奇（PERLOS, BORIS ESAKOVICH）。（第68/34段）。
俄籍犹太人，41岁，敖德萨人。目前持有上海市公安局于1934年1月4日签发的中国护照第178899号，有效期1年；自称商人。
1929年，英国驻上海总领事馆拒绝向其签发前往广州（经香港）的英国签证，因其随行有一名俄罗斯女子，且怀疑其从事白奴贸易，并将妇女卖予广州的某些俄罗斯妓院。1931年4月6日，他持过境签证抵达香港，但于1931年4月10日奉警方命令被送往广州。1934年10月17日，佩尔洛斯在香港因违反护照条例被捕并被罚款100元，并于1934年10月18日奉警司命令被驱逐至广州。此次他由M.G. 法克图罗维奇（M.G. Fakturovitch）（见第13页）陪同，后者也是一名不良分子，涉嫌从事非法妇女交易。不应允许佩尔洛斯在该殖民地登陆。
59. 波利，安托万（POLI, ANTOIN）。（法国籍）。
参见让·杰罗米尼（Jean Geromini），第13页。

60. (1) POUTSMA, MRS. MARGARET. }
    (2) KUHNLE, HERDMAN.         } (Para. 58/34).
    (3) VON HORNSTEIN, LUDWIG.   }

    Mrs. Poutsma, Dutch, born at Riga, 1892, Stenographer, Pass
port No. 1489, issued at Batavia on 29th June, 1934, arrived
in Singapore on 6th July, 1934, accompanied by Herman
Kuhnle, a male German, born 1903 at Mannheim, an engineer
by profession. They proceeded to reside at the Grosvenor
Hotel and later at 4, Eu Court registering as Mr. and Mrs.
Kuhnle. They became friendly with Ludwig Von Hornstein,
German globe-trotter. Mrs. Poutsma had a considerable sum
of money in her possession and the others were living on
her. She reported to the Police the theft of $200 from
her bag and Von Hornstein, who was suspected, was searched.
None of the stolen money was recovered but he was found
in possession of an unlicensed automatic pistol and was
convicted and fined $25. Kuhnle bought a small motor
launch called the s.s. "Ribut" on which he paid a deposit
of $700 and promise to pay the balance of $1,300 later.
He stated it was his intention to go on a prospecting
expedition to New Guinea. On 18th September, 1934, the
s.s. "Ribut" was burnt out as the result of a most suspicious
fire and it is suspected that this was an attempt to de-
fraud an insurance company as the launch had just been
insured for $4,300.

    Mrs. Poutsma left for Hong Kong on 9th September,
1934, per the "Hakusan Maru" being followed on 25th
September, 1934, by Kuhnle who sailed on the s.s. "Conte
Verde".
                                    15/35
61. PRIOR, CHARLES LAWRENCE. (Paras. 43/34/& 25/35).

    In 1900 was gazetted to the 17th Lancers and left
this Regiment in 1906 on being transferred to the Reserve

(27)
60. (1) 波茨马夫人（POUTSMA, MRS. MARGARET）。}
    (2) 库恩勒，赫德曼（KUHNLE, HERDMAN）。         } （第58/34段）。
    (3) 冯·霍恩斯坦，路德维希（VON HORNSTEIN, LUDWIG）。   }

    波茨马夫人，荷兰籍，1892年生于里加，速记员，护照第1489号，1934年6月29日签发于巴达维亚，于1934年7月6日抵达新加坡，随行者为德国男子赫尔曼·库恩勒（Herman Kuhnle），1903年生于曼海姆，职业工程师。他们先住进格罗夫纳酒店（Grosvenor Hotel），后搬至欧苑4号（4, Eu Court），登记为库恩勒先生和夫人。他们与德国环球旅行者路德维希·冯·霍恩斯坦（Ludwig Von Hornstein）成为朋友。波茨马夫人手头有一大笔钱，其他人靠她生活。她向警方报告其手提包内200元被盗，受嫌疑的冯·霍恩斯坦被搜查。虽未找回失窃款项，但发现其持有一支无执照的自动手枪，因而被定罪并罚款25元。库恩勒购买了一艘名为“里布特”号（s.s. "Ribut"）的小型摩托艇，支付了700元定金，并承诺稍后支付余款1,300元。他声称打算前往新几内亚进行勘探探险。1934年9月18日，“里布特”号因一起极为可疑的火灾被烧毁，怀疑这是企图诈骗保险公司，因为该艇刚刚投保了4,300元。

    波茨马夫人于1934年9月9日乘“白山丸”号（"Hakusan Maru"）前往香港，库恩勒随后于1934年9月25日乘“孔特·韦尔德”号（s.s. "Conte Verde"）轮船离开。
                                    15/35
61. 普赖尔，查尔斯·劳伦斯（PRIOR, CHARLES LAWRENCE）。（第43/34及25/35段）。

    1900年被委任至第17枪骑兵团，1906年转入军官预备役时离开该团。1914年被召回军队，1919年以中校军衔退役，但仍保留在军官预备役中。战后，他曾在一段时间内以半佣金制受雇于伦敦的股票经纪公司，并担任处理地产和建筑公司的董事。他生活极其奢侈，导致在家人多次资助后，最终被宣告破产。他于1925年5月7日被裁定破产，负债总额9,769英镑10先令0便士，资产为零。他尚未获得解除破产令。
    1927年7月13日，他在伦敦中央刑事法院因三项在未解除破产状态下非法获取信用的指控而被定罪。同时，他对另外四项指控其欺诈性挪用超过700英镑的起诉书 pleaded "not guilty"（认罪“无罪”）。后者未予起诉，而在前三项指控中，法官考虑到已安排囚犯出国，故对其予以具结保释。他也被从陆军名单中除名。他于1927年9月左右作为A.C.汽车公司的代理人抵达马来亚。1929年和1930年，他在霹雳州因担任经理的霹雳运输公司（Perak Transport Company）相关事务给当局带来不少麻烦。他于1933年回到新加坡，并在“大世界”（Great World）推广了一场牲畜展览。该展览在财务上失败，仍欠多位债权人款项。1934年，他在旧跑马场推广了一场马来亚牲畜展览。该展览启动资金极少，并因缺乏资金于1934年4月23日关闭。
    展览的一位债权人对普赖尔提起刑事诉讼，指控其诈骗，但该事件最终得以和解。还有许多其他类似的投诉

page_data.en:
(28)
of Officers. He was recalled to the Army in 1914 and re-
tired with the rank of Lt. Col. in 1919 but remained on the
Reserve of Officers. After the war he was for a time em-
ployed on a half commission basis with firms of stock
brokers in London and as Director of Companies dealing with
estates and buildings. He was of very extravagant habits
with the result that he was finally declared a bankrupt
after his people had repeatedly assisted him. He was adjud-
ged bankrupt on 7th May, 1925, with liabilities totalling
£9,769.10.0. and assets nil. He has not yet been discharged.
On 13th July, 1927, he was convicted before the Central
Criminal Court, London, on three charges of unlawfully
obtaining credit whilst an undischarged bankrupt. At the
same time he pleaded "not guilty" to four other indictments
charging him with fraudulent conversion of over £700.
The latter were not proceeded with and in the first
three charges he was bound over the Judge being influenced
by the fact that arrangements were made for the prisoner
to go abroad. He was also removed the Army List. He
arrived in Malaya about September, 1927, as agent for A.C.
Cars. In 1929 and 1930 he gave considerable trouble to the
authorities in Perak in connection with the Perak Transport
Company, of which he was manager. He arrived back in
Singapore in 1933 and promoted a livestock exhibition at
the "Great World". The show was a failure financially,
and money is still owed to various creditors. In 1934 he pro-
moted a Malayan Livestock Exhibition at the old Racecourse.
The exhibition commenced with very little capital, and
closed down on 23rd April, 1934, through lack of funds.
One of the creditors of the Exhibition took criminal
proceedings against Prior for cheating but the matter was
eventually settled. Numerous other similar complaints
page_data.zh:
(28)
军官名册。他于1914年被召回陆军服役，并于1919年以中校军衔退役，但仍保留在军官预备役名单中。战后，他曾一度以半佣金制受雇于伦敦的股票经纪公司，并担任处理地产与建筑事务的公司董事。他生活极为奢侈，尽管家人多次予以资助，最终仍被宣告破产。他于1925年5月7日被裁定破产，负债总额达9,769英镑10先令0便士，资产为零。他尚未获得解除破产令。1927年7月13日，他在伦敦中央刑事法院因三项在未解除破产期间非法获取信用的指控而被定罪。与此同时，他对另外四项指控其欺诈性挪用超过700英镑的起诉书 pleaded “not guilty”（辩称无罪）。后四项指控未予继续审理，而在前三项指控中，法官鉴于已作出安排让该囚犯出国，因而对其从轻处理（bound over）。他也被从陆军名册中除名。他于1927年9月左右抵达马来亚，担任A.C.汽车公司的代理。1929年和1930年，他在霹雳州（Perak）担任霹雳运输公司（Perak Transport Company）经理期间，给当局带来了不少麻烦。他于1933年返回新加坡，并在“大世界”（Great World）筹办了一场牲畜展览。该展览在财务上以失败告终，至今仍欠多位债权人款项。1934年，他在旧跑马地筹办了马来亚牲畜展览。该展览启动时资本极少，后因资金短缺于1934年4月23日关闭。展览的一位债权人对普赖尔（Prior）提起刑事诉讼，指控其诈骗，但该事最终得以和解。还有许多其他类似的投诉

page_data.en:
(29)
were made and it is possible that further proceedings
will be taken.
Col. Prior is now preparing to go to Canton to act
as Secretary of a Greyhound Racing Association but final
arrangements have not yet been made. He has issued many
worthless cheques in Singapore and should be kept under
observation.
Prior's scheme for promoting Greyhound racing in
Canton failed owing to the refusal by the Chinese Govern-
ment to grant a license to the Company. He is now pro-
moting a company known as the Malayan Building Society
which has for its model the well known and powerful
Halifax Building Society of England. He is handicapped
by lack of capital and his affairs are being closely
watched. He has also advertised himself as a house and
land agent for which business he possesses no license.
He has been summoned for a breach of Ordinance No.95
(Auctioneers' Licenses) and the case will be heard in
August.
He was convicted on 5th August, 1935, before the Dis-
trict Judge, Singapore, for a breach of Ordinance No.95
(Auctioneers' Licenses). In view of his record the Colonial
Secretary has refused to issue to him a licence to act as
an house agent.
62. PUSTINZOVA, MISS VALLIA. (Para. 23/35).
Russian woman, aged 23 years, born in Harbin, professes
to be a typist, in possession of Chinese Passport No. 4340,
dated 5th July, 1934. Arrived in Singapore on 21st January,
1935. She sailed for Manila by the s.s. "Postdam" on 8th
August, 1935. Her photograph is filed in the Detective
Branch. She appears to be of the prostitute class and
possibly politically undesirable and her return to Malaya
page_data.zh:
(29)
被提出，可能会采取进一步的法律行动。
普赖尔上校目前正准备前往广州，担任赛狗协会的秘书，但最终安排尚未敲定。他在新加坡开出了许多空头支票，应予以监视。
普赖尔在广州推广赛狗的计划因中国政府拒绝向该公司颁发执照而失败。他目前正在推广一家名为“马来亚建房互助协会”（Malayan Building Society）的公司，其模式效仿英国知名且实力雄厚的哈利法克斯建房互助协会（Halifax Building Society）。他因缺乏资本而受阻，其事务正受到密切监视。他还刊登广告自称房屋和土地代理人，但他并未拥有从事该业务的执照。
他因违反第95号条例（拍卖师执照）被传唤，案件将于8月审理。
他于1935年8月5日在新加坡地方法院法官面前因违反第95号条例（拍卖师执照）被定罪。鉴于其记录，殖民司已拒绝向他颁发房屋代理人执照。
62. 普斯廷佐娃小姐（PUSTINZOVA, MISS VALLIA）。（第23/35段）。
俄罗斯女子，23岁，生于哈尔滨，自称打字员，持有1934年7月5日签发的中国护照第4340号。于1935年1月21日抵达新加坡。她于1935年8月8日乘“波茨坦”号（s.s. "Postdam"）轮船前往马尼拉。她的照片存档于侦探部。她似乎属于妓女阶层，可能在政治上不受欢迎，若其返回马来亚

page_data.en:
(30)
should be reported to the Detective Branch.
63. (1) RAUH, ALFRED (German). }
    (2) BAHR, HENRY (German).   } (Para. 30/35).

Rauh visited Singapore from Shanghai on 22nd April,
1932, described himself as a merchant and stayed at the
Hotel Metropole. He returned to Shanghai after 5 days in
Singapore. He again visited Singapore on 15th May, 1932,
and left on 26th June, 1933, for Hong Kong. He was in
possession of a passport No. 126/32 issued at Berlin on
1st April, 1932.

Bahr arrived on 22nd April, 1932, from Manila and also
described himself as a merchant and stayed at the Hotel
Metropole. He left for Bangkok on 6th May, 1933, returned
to Singapore on 16th May, 1933, and finally left for
Hong Kong on 6th July, 1933. He was in possession of a
passport No. 185, issued at Shanghai on 10th September,
1929. Whilst in Singapore in 1933, Rauh posed as a wealthy
man and Bahr as his secretary. They demonstrated to
credulous Asiatics what they termed a secret process for
manufacturing currency notes by means of chemicals from
genuine notes and attempted to obtain large quantities of gen-
uine notes for duplication. They failed and left for Hong
Kong as stated. They are a pair of international confidence
tricksters. Information has been received that Alfred Rauh's
real name is Albert Rosenbaum and is known to have been in
direct contact with a "drug ring" in China. He obtained
by trickery a Canadian passport No. 72546 granted on 22nd
February, 1934, at Montreal.

Their return to Malaya should be immediately reported
to the Detective Branch, where their photographs are filed.
The Canadian passport No. 72546 should be immediately
impounded if presented.
page_data.zh:
(30)
应向侦探部报告。
63. (1) 劳，阿尔弗雷德（RAUH, ALFRED）（德国籍）。}
    (2) 巴尔，亨利（BAHR, HENRY）（德国籍）。   } （第30/35段）。

劳于1932年4月22日从上海访问新加坡，自称商人，住在大都会酒店（Hotel Metropole）。在新加坡停留5天后返回上海。他于1932年5月15日再次访问新加坡，并于1933年6月26日离开前往香港。他持有1932年4月1日签发于柏林的第126/32号护照。

巴尔于1932年4月22日从马尼拉抵达，也自称商人，住在大都会酒店。他于1933年5月6日离开前往曼谷，1933年5月16日返回新加坡，最后于1933年7月6日离开前往香港。他持有1929年9月10日签发于上海的第185号护照。1933年在新加坡期间，劳伪装成富人，巴尔则扮演其秘书。他们向轻信的亚洲人展示了一种他们称为利用化学药剂从真钞制造货币的秘密工艺，并试图获取大量真钞进行复制。他们未能得逞，并按所述离开前往香港。这是一对国际诈骗犯。收到情报称，阿尔弗雷德·劳的真名是阿尔伯特·罗森鲍姆（Albert Rosenbaum），已知与中国的一个“毒品集团”有直接接触。他通过欺骗手段获得了1934年2月22日在蒙特利尔签发的加拿大护照第72546号。

若他们返回马来亚，应立即向侦探部报告，他们的照片已存档于此。若出示加拿大护照第72546号，应立即扣押。

page_data.en:
(31)

64. RIBIERO, RODRIGO ALVARA VIERA, alias ROBERTS alias RICHARDSON,
alias MAURICE RILEY. (Paras. 8, 15 & 24/34).

Portugese, born in Hong Kong, 1894. He is in possession
of a British passport issued in Hong Kong. He was sentenced
in Hong Kong on 19th October, 1914, to two years' R.I.
concurrently on each of three counts of forgery after having
been extradited from Colombo. He was released on 2nd
February, 1916, and proceeded to Macao where he was con-
victed of a similar offence and banished to Timor for six
years. He returned to Hong Kong and in 1926 was strongly
suspected of being party to a conspiracy which resulted in
the Netherlands Indische Handelsbank being defrauded of
$30,000 by a clever cheque fraud. He was employed in the
bank as a clerk at the time and left under mysterious
circumstances. Sufficient evidence was not obtained to
justify prosecuting him.

He arrived in Singapore from Hong Kong per the s.s.
"Conte de Rosso" on 14th February, 1934, accompanied by a
Chinese girl described as his wife although he is stated to
have a legal wife in Shanghai. In Singapore he is now
staying at the Central Hotel and claims to be the repre-
sentative of the "Hong Kong Pictorial" and is canvassing
for advertisements. He is an associate of the persons
referred to in page 7 and the fact that they all arrived
in Singapore from Hong Kong about the same time appears
suspicious and their movements should be made the subject
of discreet reports.

He disappeared from the Central Hotel, Singapore, on
or about 26th March, 1934, together with his Chinese mistress
and his present whereabouts unknown. Enquiries are requested
in an effort to locate him.

There is still no trace of his whereabouts.
page_data.zh:
(31)

64. 里贝罗，罗德里戈·阿尔瓦拉·维埃拉（RIBIERO, RODRIGO ALVARA VIERA），别名罗伯茨（ROBERTS），别名理查森（RICHARDSON），别名莫里斯·莱利（MAURICE RILEY）。（第8、15及24/34段）。

葡萄牙人，1894年生于香港。他持有在香港签发的英国护照。1914年10月19日，他在香港因三项伪造罪每项被判两年苦役（R.I.），同期执行，此前他从科伦坡被引渡回来。他于1916年2月2日获释，随即前往澳门，在那里因类似罪行被定罪，并被流放至帝汶六年。他返回香港，1926年时被强烈怀疑参与了一起阴谋，通过巧妙的支票欺诈手段骗取荷兰印地商业银行（Netherlands Indische Handelsbank）30,000元。当时他在该银行任职职员，并在神秘情况下离职。未能获得足以起诉他的充分证据。

他于1934年2月14日乘“孔特·德·罗索”号（s.s. "Conte de Rosso"）轮船从香港抵达新加坡，随同一名被称为其妻子的中国女子，尽管据说他在上海有一位合法妻子。在新加坡，他目前住在中央酒店（Central Hotel），声称是《香港画报》（"Hong Kong Pictorial"）的代表，并正在招揽广告。他是第7页所述人员的同伙，且他们所有人都在大致相同的时间从香港抵达新加坡，这一情况显得可疑，应对他们的行踪进行谨慎报告。

他与其中国情妇于1934年3月26日左右从新加坡中央酒店失踪，目前下落不明。请求进行调查以 locating him（定位他/查明其下落）。

目前仍无其下落踪迹。

page_data.en:
(32)
65. RUBECK, SROUL alias RUBECK, ISIDORE. (Para. 71/34).
A Polish Jew born at Lodz, aged 49 years. He returned
from Europe to Shanghai with Gourividis (ref. page 14) on
the "Conte Verde" arriving on May 7th, 1934, travelling
on a Canadian Passport No. 34507, granted on February 10th,
1929. He is reported to be an expert safe blower and is
now believed to be living in Paris and directing the
European organisation for the traffic in narcotics on
behalf of Gourividis. He claims to be a British fur
merchant, from Montreal, Canada. Both Rubeck and Gouri-
vidis should be made the subject of discreet inquiries if
encountered in Malaya.
66. RYAN, MRS. I.J. (Australian).
See John Carson, page 5.
67. SCHMIDT, NICHOLAS.
Aged 19 years, of mixed German and Russian parentage.
Has 3 previous convictions in Hong Kong Courts for stowing
away on various ships. He was deported from Hong Kong for
10 years and left for Shanghai in s.s. "President Jefferson"
on 24th December, 1932.
68. SERBOUSEK, DR. JULIUS alias DR. FREDERICH LOEW alias
JULIUS BERNDT. (Paras. 16, 25, 30 & 44/34).
Austrian, born in Innsbruck, 1884. Holds an Austrian
passport issued at Constantinople 25th January, 1928.
He is suspected of illegal practices and of procuring
abortions. In August, 1925, a clinic conducted by him in
Resht, Persia, was closed by the Persian authorities on
account of unethical conduct. He was later expelled from
Abyssinia for similar conduct. From Abyssinia he went to
Baghdad and there to Bombay where he was moved on by the
Indian authorities. He next proceeded to Shanghai arriving
there in April, 1932. In September, 1933, he was charged in
page_data.zh:
(32)
65. 鲁贝克，斯罗尔（RUBECK, SROUL），又名鲁贝克，伊西多尔（RUBECK, ISIDORE）。（第71/34段）。
波兰犹太人，生于罗兹，现年49岁。他于1934年5月7日随古里维迪斯（Gourividis）（参见第14页）乘“孔特·韦尔德”号（Conte Verde）轮船从欧洲返回上海，持有一本1929年2月10日签发的加拿大护照，号码为34507。据报他是开启保险箱的专家，目前被认为居住在巴黎，代表古里维迪斯指挥欧洲的毒品贩运组织。他自称是来自加拿大蒙特利尔的英国皮草商人。如果在马来亚遇到鲁贝克和古里维迪斯，应对他们进行秘密调查。
66. 瑞安夫人（MRS. RYAN, I.J.）（澳大利亚人）。
参见约翰·卡森（John Carson），第5页。
67. 施密特，尼古拉斯（SCHMIDT, NICHOLAS）。
现年19岁，父母分别为德国人和俄罗斯人。此前在香港法院有三次因偷渡上船而被定罪的记录。他被香港驱逐出境十年，并于1932年12月24日乘“杰斐逊总统”号（President Jefferson）轮船前往上海。
68. 瑟博塞克博士（DR. SERBOUSEK, JULIUS），又名弗雷德里希·勒夫博士（DR. FREDERICH LOEW），又名朱利叶斯·伯恩特（JULIUS BERNDT）。（第16、25、30及44/34段）。
奥地利人，1884年生于因斯布鲁克。持有1928年1月25日在君士坦丁堡签发的奥地利护照。他涉嫌非法行医及实施堕胎手术。1925年8月，他在波斯雷什特（Resht）开设的一家诊所因行为不端被波斯当局关闭。后来他因类似行为被阿比西尼亚驱逐。离开阿比西尼亚后，他前往巴格达，随后又去孟买，并被印度当局驱离。他接着前往上海，于1932年4月抵达。1933年9月，他在

page_data.en:
(33)
Shanghai with obtaining $100,000 by fraud and was convicted.
He was ordered to pay a fine of $1,000 and to refund the
money fraudulently obtained. Fine paid. On 1st March,
1934, he was arrested by the Hong Kong Police having
in his possession a Chilian passport and was charged with
entering the Colony without having a valid passport. He
was fined $25 and ordered to leave the Colony as soon as
possible. He is still in Hong Kong but is leaving shortly
for either Beyrut or Bangkok. In Hong Kong he associated
with Elly Widler referred to in page 38.
Serbousek has the following criminal record:-
1913 - Sentenced to one month's R.I. in Munich for
forgery.
1922 - Arrested in Rotterdam for forging Dutch
Bank notes.
1922 - Sentenced to six months' R.I. in Vienna for
bigamy.
Warrants are still in existence against him in
Vienna on charges of indecent assault and abortion. He
should not be allowed to land in the Colony.
He arrived in Singapore on 17th April, 1934, from Bang-
kok en route for Java, accompanied by his wife and children,
and sailed for Batavia per the s.s. "Plancius" on 27th
April, 1934. He was in possession of a Chilian passport
issued in Yokohama on 3rd November, 1933.
Information has been received from H.B.M's. Consul-
General, Batavia, that the above named, now in Batavia,
is seeking permission to enter the Union South Africa.
The above named left Batavia for Manila early in
14th
June after defrauding a Dutch doctor of a sum of money.
He was ordered out of Java by the Dutch authorities.
69. SIWAK FAMILY OF POLISH GYPSIES.
Josef Siwak, Michal Siwak and Franciszek Siwak
accompanied by their wives and families, total party
page_data.zh:
(33)
上海被控诈骗10万美元并被判有罪。他被责令缴纳1,000美元罚款并退还诈骗所得。罚款已缴付。1934年3月1日，他因持有一本智利护照被香港警方逮捕，并被控在没有有效护照的情况下进入殖民地。他被罚款25美元，并被责令尽快离开殖民地。他目前仍在香港，但即将前往贝鲁特或曼谷。在香港期间，他与第38页提到的埃莉·威德勒（Elly Widler）有交往。
瑟博塞克的犯罪记录如下：
1913年 - 在慕尼黑因伪造罪被判处一个月监禁（R.I.）。
1922年 - 在鹿特丹因伪造荷兰银行券被捕。
1922年 - 在维也纳因重婚罪被判处六个月监禁（R.I.）。
维也纳方面仍有关于他猥亵袭击和堕胎指控的通缉令。不应允许他在殖民地登陆。
他于1934年4月17日从曼谷抵达新加坡，途经爪哇，由其妻子和子女陪同，并于1934年4月27日乘“普兰修斯”号（Plancius）轮船驶往巴达维亚。他持有一本1933年11月3日在横滨签发的智利护照。
已从巴达维亚的英国陛下总领事馆收到消息，上述人员目前在巴达维亚，正寻求获准进入南非联邦。
上述人员在骗取一名荷兰医生一笔钱财后，于6月14日早些时候离开巴达维亚前往马尼拉。他被荷兰当局勒令离开爪哇。
69. 波兰吉普赛人西瓦克家族（SIWAK FAMILY OF POLISH GYPSIES）。
约瑟夫·西瓦克（Josef Siwak）、米哈尔·西瓦克（Michal Siwak）和弗朗齐歇克·西瓦克（Franciszek Siwak）及其妻子和家属，一行共11人，于1932年12月16日乘“库昌”号（Kutsang）轮船从加尔各答抵达香港，并在警方监管下于同日转船前往广州——当晚乘“金山”号（Kin Shan）轮船启航。（刑事侦缉处档案号 C.I.D.790/32）。
该团伙属于1932年第10期《特别服务期刊》（S.S. Journal，1932年11月31日刊，第98页，第92段）中提到的同一部落。
70. 斯莫拉，弗兰蒂谢克（SMOLA, FRANTISEK）。（第33/34段）。
现年25岁，捷克斯洛伐克电工。一名品行可疑的外国人，曾于1933年8月在香港因偷渡上船被罚款50美元。他于1934年4月返回香港，被发现后被勒令离开。他于1934年4月17日前往广州。
71. 斯图尔特，C.E.（STEWART, C.E.）。（第21/35段）。
澳大利亚人，于1935年6月11日从西贡抵达新加坡。他偷渡登上前往科伦坡的“阿索斯”号（Athos）轮船，但被科伦坡警方遣返新加坡。他在未经许可的情况下在新加坡登陆，并于1935年8月9日被移民局驱逐至西贡。他身无分文，不应被允许返回马来亚。
72. 斯蒂里奥，斯蒂芬（STIRIO, STEPHEN），又名史蒂夫·菲利普斯（STEVE PHILIPS），又名斯蒂芬·米切尔（STEPHEN MITCHELL），又名乔治·斯特罗（GEORGE STEIRO），又名托马斯·米切尔（THOMAS MITCHELL），又名斯特里奥（STERIO），又名比尔·斯特里奥（BILL STERIO）。（第31/35段）。
他职业为演艺人员，1907年12月24日出生于澳大利亚维多利亚州奥斯波特（Osbort），父母为希腊人。他持有1927年10月27日在新南威尔士州悉尼签发的英国护照，号码为A65064。他于1934年10月21日访问新加坡。他是国际流窜扒手，在澳大利亚、利物浦、西萨塞克斯、卡迪夫、南罗德西亚和洛桑（瑞士）均有定罪记录。他

page_data.en:
(34)
numbering 11 persons, arrived in Hong Kong from Calcutta
by s.s. "Kutsang" on 16th December, 1932, and, under
Police supervision, transhipped for Canton the same day
-- sailing same night by s.s. "Kin Shan". (C.I.D.790/32).
This party belongs to the same tribe mentioned in S.S.
Journal, No.10 of 1932, dated 31st November, 1932, page
98, paragraph 92.
70. SMOLA, FRANTISEK. (Para. 33/34).
Age 25 years. electrician of Czecho-Slovakia. An
alien of doubtful character who was fined $50 in Hong
Kong in August, 1933, for stowing away on a ship. He
returned to Hong Kong in April, 1934, and when discovered
was ordered to leave. He left for Canton on 17th April,
1934.
71. STEWART, C.E. (Para. 21/35).
An Australian, arrived in Singapore from Saigon on
June 11th, 1935. He stowed away on the "Athos" for Colombo
but was returned to Singapore by the Colombo Police. He
landed in Singapore without permission and was deported by
the Immigration Department to Saigon on 9th August, 1935.
He is destitute and should not be permitted to return to
Malaya.
72. STIRIO, STEPHEN alias STEVE PHILIPS alias STEPHEN MITCHELL
alias GEORGE STEIRO alias THOMAS MITCHELL alias STERIO
alias BILL STERIO. (Para. 31/35).
He is a showman by profession and was born at Osbort,
Victoria, Australia of Greek parents on 24th December,
1907. He is in possession of British passport No.A65064,
issued at Sydney, N.S.W., on 27th October, 1927. He visited
Singapore on 21st October, 1934. He is an international
travelling pickpocket and has had convictions recorded
against him in Australia, Liverpool, West Sussex, Cardiff,
Southern Rhodesia, and Lausanne (Switzerland). He
page_data.zh:
(34)
共计11人，于1932年12月16日乘“Kutsang”号轮船从加尔各答抵达香港，并在警方监管下于同日转船前往广州——当夜乘“Kin Shan”号轮船启航。（刑事侦缉处档案 790/32）。
该团伙属于1932年《警务处日志》第10期（1932年11月31日，第98页，第92段）中提及的同一族群。

70. SMOLA, FRANTISEK.（见第33/34段）。
年龄25岁，捷克斯洛伐克电工。一名品行可疑的外侨，曾于1933年8月在香港因偷渡乘船被罚款50元。他于1934年4月返回香港，被发现后被勒令离境。他于1934年4月17日前往广州。

71. STEWART, C.E.（见第21/35段）。
澳大利亚人，于1935年6月11日从西贡抵达新加坡。他偷渡登上前往科伦坡的“Athos”号轮船，但被科伦坡警方遣返回新加坡。他在未经许可的情况下在新加坡登陆，并于1935年8月9日被移民局驱逐至西贡。他身无分文，不应获准返回马来亚。

72. STIRIO, STEPHEN，又名 STEVE PHILIPS，又名 STEPHEN MITCHELL，又名 GEORGE STEIRO，又名 THOMAS MITCHELL，又名 STERIO，又名 BILL STERIO。（见第31/35段）。
他职业为演艺人员，1907年12月24日出生于澳大利亚维多利亚州 Osbort（音译），父母为希腊人。他持有英国护照，号码A65064，于1927年10月27日在新南威尔士州悉尼签发。他于1934年10月21日访问新加坡。他是一名国际流窜扒手，在澳大利亚、利物浦、西萨塞克斯、卡迪夫、南罗得西亚和洛桑（瑞士）均有定罪记录。他

page_data.en:
(35)
arrived in Bombay from Australia on 11th May, 1935,
when he presented a passport issued by the British Consul,
Antwerp on 7th August, 1934, and numbered 6638. He
was deported from India by the s.s. "Maloja" for England
but when ashore in Malta he committed theft and is now in
prison in Malta. He is also a ship's thief and several
reports of theft have been made from passengers on ships
on which he has travelled.
He should not be permitted to land in Malaya.
73. (1) STRZESZAK, MRS. DORA. }
(2) IORIOFILI, GIOVANNI. } (Para. 45/34).
A Polish subject, widow, born at Warsaw, Poland,
in 1897. In possession of certificate of identity No.
131/34, issued at Singapore on 28th June, 1934, her
Polish passport No. 71/30 issued at Shanghai on 25th
August, 1930, having expired. She arrived in Singapore from
Hong Kong per the s.s. "Carthage" on 11th October, 1932,
and was found to be in possession of 1,362 tahils of
non-government chandu. She was convicted before the
District Judge, Singapore, on 17th October, 1932 and
sentenced to 2 years' R.I. in default of paying a fine of
$5,000. She is a close associate of an Italian named
Giovanni Ioriofili who was in Singapore in 1932 and whose
present address is 1002 Avenue Joffre, Shanghai. Ioriofili
is believed to have conspired with her in the importation
of opium but sufficient evidence was not obtained to have
justified charging him. Strzeszak leaves for Hong Kong
per the s.s. "Tilawa" on 5th July, 1934, and neither should
be allowed to re-enter the Colony.
74. SURETZ, JANKEL MOSES. (Para. 3/32).
Rumanian subject born in Reni in 1875. Merchant,
A suspected dealer in drugs and forged notes on
page_data.zh:
(35)
于1935年5月11日从澳大利亚抵达孟买，当时出示了一本由英国驻安特卫普领事于1934年8月7日签发、编号为6638的护照。他被印度当局通过“马洛贾”号（Maloja）轮船驱逐至英国，但在马耳他上岸时犯下盗窃罪，目前被关押在马耳他监狱。他也是船上窃贼，有多起乘客在他乘坐的轮船上被盗的报告。
不应允许他在马来亚登陆。
73. (1) 斯特热沙克夫人（STRZESZAK, MRS. DORA）。}
(2) 约里奥菲利，乔瓦尼（IORIOFILI, GIOVANNI）。} （第45/34段）。
波兰籍臣民，寡妇，1897年生于波兰华沙。持有1934年6月28日在新加坡签发的身份证明书，号码为131/34，因其1930年8月25日在上海签发的波兰护照（号码71/30）已过期。她于1932年10月11日乘“迦太基”号（Carthage）轮船从香港抵达新加坡，被发现持有1,362两非政府官营鸦片（chandu）。她于1932年10月17日在新加坡地方法院被判有罪，因未能缴纳5,000美元罚款，被判处两年监禁（R.I.）。她与一名叫乔瓦尼·约里奥菲利（Giovanni Ioriofili）的意大利人关系密切，此人1932年曾在新加坡，现住址为上海霞飞路1002号。据信约里奥菲利与她共谋进口鸦片，但未获得足以对他提起诉讼的证据。斯特热沙克于1934年7月5日乘“蒂拉瓦”号（Tilawa）轮船前往香港，两人均不应被允许重新进入殖民地。
74. 苏雷茨，扬克尔·摩西（SURETZ, JANKEL MOSES）。（第3/32段）。
罗马尼亚籍臣民，1875年生于雷尼（Reni）。商人，涉嫌从事毒品和伪造钞票交易，手法与第22页提到的伦德（Lund）大致相同。苏雷茨还与第22页提到的陈厚德（Tan Hood Leong）有关联。苏雷茨于1932年8月14日经曼谷从上海抵达槟城。他还与一名锡兰人唐·罗伯特·武拉普利（Don Robert Wurappli）有关联。苏雷茨于1932年8月30日从槟城前往新加坡，并即将立即前往中国。他将不再被允许在殖民地登陆。
75. 斯维翁特尼茨基，约瑟夫（SWIONTNIZKY, JOSEPH），又名萨科夫斯基（SAKOVSKI）。（第31/34段）。
波兰国籍，1934年4月24日在香港因持有伪造的法国护照被判处六个月苦役。他职业为商店扒手。他在香港的活动此前不为人知，其被捕完全归功于一名俄国侦探的精明工作。他声称以80美元的价格从天津的一名犹太人手中购买了这本伪造护照。幸运的是，此类伪造品较为罕见，这是近年来发现的首例案件，但鉴于华北地区显然存在此类伪造品，护照查验官员在处理身份可疑的外国人时应采取特别预防措施。
76. 斯维翁特尼茨基，玛丽（SWIONTNIZKY, MARIE），又名玛丽·亚辛斯卡娅（MARIE YASINSKAYA）。（第32/34段）。
上述人员的妻子，现年45岁，原籍波兰华沙。1934年5月19日，她因商店扒窃和违反《护照条例》在香港被判处一个月监禁。刑期届满后，她已被列入从香港驱逐出境的名单。
77. 坦纳，威廉·阿瑟（TANNER, WILLIAM ARTHUR）。（第19/34段）。
1902年生于美国芝加哥。持有1933年2月2日在华盛顿签发的美国护照，号码为19068，有效期两年。护照上贴有英国驻洛杉矶总领事于1933年2月3日签发的已过期的香港及海峡殖民地入境签证。坦纳自称是作家，但似乎没有固定的生计来源。他在香港名声不佳，因与已知的毒品贩子有交往而受到怀疑。1934年2月23日，香港警方以违反《护照条例》为由获得了对他的驱逐令，并正在安排将其遣返美国。坦纳最近在香港因以虚假借口获取钱财而被起诉，但案件被撤销。他在香港欠下许多债务。不应允许他在殖民地登陆。
78. 索恩利，约翰·威廉·帕特里克（THORNLEY, JOHN WILLIAM PATRICK）。刑事记录号 89608。（第22/34段）。
生于英国伦敦，现年约40岁。1915年9月3日，他在伦敦温布尔登简易法庭因以虚假借口获取信用罪被判有罪，并被判处两个月监禁（R.I.）。随后他在皇家炮兵队短暂服役担任炮手，但因健康原因退伍，于1916年来到马来亚，受雇为种植园主。但他很快惹上麻烦，1916年5月26日在怡保因触犯《刑法典》第417条诈骗罪被判有罪，并被判处两个月监禁（R.I.）。1924年3月10日，他在马六甲警察法庭因两项诈骗指控被判有罪，每项罪名并发判处两个月监禁（R.I.）。1931年6月6日，他在太平因诈骗指控被判有罪，并被判处一个月监禁（R.I.）。1934年2月5日，他在新加坡因诈骗指控被判有罪，并被判处一个月监禁（R.I.）。他的作案手法是编造关于其战争服役经历（虚假）的故事接近他人，以借款名义获取小额款项且从不偿还。他身无分文且四处流浪，应报告其行踪。他是新加坡
