Suretz is also associated with Tan Hood Leong referred
to in page 22 . Suretz arrived in Penang on 14th August,
1932, from Shanghai via Bangkok. He is also associated
with a Ceylonese known as Don Robert Wurappli. Suretz
proceeded from Penang to Singapore on 30th August, 1932,
and is leaving almost immediately for China. He will
not again be allowed to land in the Colony.
75. SWIONTNIZKY, JOSEPH alias SAKOVSKI. (Paras. 31/34).
Of Polish nationality, was sentenced on 24th April, 1934,
to 6 months' hard labour in Hong Kong for being in possess-
ion of a forged French passport. He is a shop lifter by
profession. His presence in Hong Kong was unknown and his
arrest was only effected as a result of a clever piece of
work on the part of a Russian detective. He stated that
he had purchased the forged passport from a Jew in Tient-
sin for the sum of $80. Fortunately, forgeries of this kind
are rare and this is the first case which has come to light
during recent years, but in view of the apparent existence
of such forgeries from North China, passport examination
officers should take special precautions when dealing with
aliens whose bona fides are doubtful.
76. SWIONTNIZKY, MARIE alias MARIE YASINSKAYA. (Para. 32/34).
Wife of the above named, aged 45 years, native of Warsaw,
Poland. On 19th May, 1934, was sentenced to one month's
imprisonment in Hong Kong for shop-lifting and breach of
the Passport Ordinance. She has been scheduled for de-
portation from Hong Kong on completion of her sentence.
77. TANNER, WILLIAM ARTHUR. (Para. 19/34).
Born in Chicago, U.S.A., 1902. Holds U.S. Passport
No.19068, issued at Washington on 2nd February, 1933
and valid for 2 years. Passport bears an expired entry
visa for Hong Kong and the Straits Settlements given by

75. 斯维翁特尼茨基，约瑟夫（SWIONTNIZKY, JOSEPH），又名萨科夫斯基（SAKOVSKI）。（见第31/34段）。波兰籍，因持有伪造的法国护照，于1934年4月24日在香港被判处六个月苦役。他以商店行窃为业。他在香港的活动此前不为人知，其被捕完全归功于一位俄国侦探的出色工作。他声称该伪造护照是以80元的价格从天津的一名犹太人处购得。幸运的是，此类伪造证件甚为罕见，这也是近年来发现的首例案件；但鉴于华北地区显然存在此类伪造证件，护照查验官员在处理身份可疑的外国人时，应特别谨慎。

76. 斯维翁特尼茨基，玛丽（SWIONTNIZKY, MARIE），又名玛丽·亚辛斯卡娅（MARIE YASINSKAYA）。（见第32/34段）。上述人员之妻，45岁，原籍波兰华沙。1934年5月19日，因商店行窃及违反《护照条例》，在香港被判处一个月监禁。刑期届满后，她已被列入从香港驱逐出境的名单。

the British Consul-General, Los Angeles on 3rd February,
1933. Tanner describes himself as a writer but seems
to have no definite means of support. He has earned a
bad reputation in Hong Kong and is regarded with suspicion
on account of his association with known drug traffickers.
On 23rd February, 1934 the Hong Kong Police obtained an
expulsion order against him for a breach of the Passport
Ordinance and arrangements are being made to send him
back to the U.S.A. Tanner was recently prosecuted in Hong
Kong for obtaining money by false pretences but the case
was discharged. He has incurred many debts in Hong Kong.
He should not be allowed to land in the Colony.
78. THORNLEY, JOHN WILLIAM PATRICK. C.R. 89608. (Para. 22/34).
Born in London, England, aged about 40 years. He
was convicted before the Wimbledon Petty Sessions, London,
on 3rd September, 1915, on a charge of obtaining credit by
false pretences and was sentenced to two months' R.I. He
then served for short time as a gunner in the Royal Artillery
but was discharged on medical grounds and came to Malaya in
1916, and obtained work as a planter. He soon got into
trouble however, and on 26th May, 1916, at Ipoh was sentenced
to two months' R.I. after conviction on a charge of cheating
section 417, P.C. On 10th March, 1924, he was convicted
before the Malacca Police Court on two charges of cheating
and sentenced to two months' R.I. on each, concurrently.
On 6th June, 1931, he was convicted at Taiping on a charge
of cheating and sentenced to one month's R.I. On 5th
February, 1934, he was convicted at Singapore on a charge
of cheating and was sentenced to one month's R.I. His
method is to approach person with a story about his war
services (false) and obtain small sums by way of loans
which he never repays. He is destitute and a vagrant and
his movements should be reported on. He is Singapore

78. 索恩利，约翰·威廉·帕特里克（THORNLEY, JOHN WILLIAM PATRICK）。刑事记录号 89608。（第22/34段）。出生于英国伦敦，年龄约40岁。1915年9月3日，他在伦敦温布尔登简易法庭因以虚假借口获取信贷罪被定罪，并被判处两个月苦役监禁（R.I.）。此后，他曾在皇家炮兵队短暂担任炮手，但因健康原因退伍，于1916年来到马来亚，受雇为种植园主。然而，他很快惹上麻烦，1916年5月26日，在怡保（Ipoh）因触犯《刑法典》第417条诈骗罪被定罪，判处两个月苦役监禁。1924年3月10日，他在马六甲警察法庭因两项诈骗指控被定罪，每项罪名均被判处两个月苦役监禁，同期执行。1931年6月6日，他在太平（Taiping）因诈骗罪被定罪，判处一个月苦役监禁。1934年2月5日，他在新加坡因诈骗罪被定罪，判处一个月苦役监禁。他的作案手法是编造虚假的战争服役经历接近他人，以借款名义骗取小额款项且从不偿还。他身无分文，四处流浪，应对其行踪进行报告。他是新加坡

79. /(1) VICKERS, CHARLES ERNEST. }

   /(2) KELLY, FREDERICK A.      }
    Kelly is a native of Australia, salesman, aged about 52
years. Vickers is also a native of Australia, company
promoter, age 50 years. They are members of an international
gang of share swindlers and are wanted on numerous charges
of obtaining money by false pretences by the New Zealand
Police. A third member of the gang, a New Zealander named
Ernest Mobin Gilmour /has been arrested in London and is
being extradited to New Zealand. Photographs of the above
named are filed for reference in the Detective Branch,
Singapore, and if located in Malaya a report is requested
on their movements pending further instructions.
    Information has been received from the Police Dept.
Wellington, New Zealand to the effect that Vickers has
been returned to New Zealand and that no further action is
necessary. Should Kelly be located in Malaya a report to
the Detective Branch, Singapore is requested.
80. WANDRES, F.
    See A. Maier Karl, page 23.
81. WIDLER, ELLY. (Paras. 17& 26/34).
    Swiss Jew aged 46 years, born in Shanghai, holding
Swiss Passport No. 1139/32, issued at the Swiss Consulate,
Shanghai on 5th August, 1932, and valid for three years.
This man is a well known smuggler of arms, ammunition and
drugs and has several convictions in North China. He
arrived in Hong Kong from Shanghai on 18th February, 1934,
in the s.s. "Tai Yuen" and on 22nd February, 1934, police
visited him at his room at the Y.M.C.A., Kowloon, and search-
ed his effects on warrant. He stated that he had come
to Hong Kong in order to try out a roulette "system" at
the Shum Chun (Chinese territory) gaming houses. This

   /(2) 凯利，弗雷德里克·A. (KELLY, FREDERICK A.)      }
    凯利系澳大利亚人，推销员，年龄约 52 岁。维克斯亦系澳大利亚人，公司发起人，年龄 50 岁。二人系一个国际股票诈骗团伙的成员，因多项以虚假借口骗取钱财的指控而被新西兰警方通缉。该团伙第三名成员，一名名为欧内斯特·莫宾·吉尔摩 (Ernest Mobin Gilmour) 的新西兰人，已在伦敦被捕，正被引渡至新西兰。上述人员的照片已存档于新加坡警队侦探科以备查考，若在马来亚发现其踪迹，恳请就其行踪提交报告，以待进一步指示。
    接获新西兰惠灵顿警察局来函，称维克斯已被遣返新西兰，无需采取进一步行动。若在马来亚发现凯利，恳请向新加坡警队侦探科提交报告。
80. 旺德雷斯，F. (WANDRES, F.)。
    参见 A. 迈尔·卡尔 (A. Maier Karl)，第 23 页。
81. 维德勒，埃尔莉 (WIDLER, ELLY)。（见第 17 段及第 26/34 段）。
    瑞士籍犹太人，年龄 46 岁，生于上海，持有瑞士护照第 1139/32 号，该护照于 1932 年 8 月 5 日由瑞士驻上海领事馆签发，有效期三年。此人系知名的武器、弹药及毒品走私犯，在华北有多次定罪记录。他于 1934 年 2 月 18 日乘“泰源”轮 (s.s. "Tai Yuen") 从上海抵达香港，1934 年 2 月 22 日，警方持搜查令前往其位于九龙基督教青年会 (Y.M.C.A.) 的房间对其进行搜查。他声称来港是为了在深圳（中国领土）的赌馆试验一种轮盘赌“系统”。此

page_data.en:
(39)
was to some extent borne out by a mass of mathematical
calculations found in his property. Nothing else of any
importance was found. Widler was arrested and ordered to
quit Hong Kong by 25th February, 1934, with the alternative
of having deportation proceedings taken against him. He
left for Canton on that date but passed through Hong Kong
again en route to Shanghai in the s.s. "Soochow" on 28th
February, 1934. After his departure, it came to the know-
ledge of the Police, that Widler whilst in Hong Kong had
inserted advertisements in the local press seeking women
for employment in an office or as governesses. Two ladies
who answered these advertisements and whose cases came to
the knowledge of this department were extremely suspicious
of Widler's real intentions. He is an associate of Julius
Serbousek (page 32).
It has now been ascertained that the above named was
sentenced to 3 months' R.I. in Shanghai in 1927 for utter-
ing forged documents. In 1928 he was arrested on a charge
highway robbery but was discharged. In 1933 he was fined
$30 for keeping a common gaming house. He is endeavouring
to seek permission to enter Hong Kong or Malaya, but
such permission should not be granted.
82. YOUNG, JAMES MACKINTOSH. (Para. 8/35).
A director of London Musical Comedy Co. was arrested
on an Ipoh warrant for criminal breach of trust. The
complainant would not continue proceedings and the charge
was withdrawn. Young had been many years in India where
he left a touring company of the Carl Rosa Opera stranded.
He has served a sentence of 4 months imprisonment in Poona.
He is an undesirable and prefers leaving unpaid bills to
settled accounts. He left for Bombay on 16th April. 1935.

在其财物中发现的大量数学计算资料，在某种程度上证实了这一点。未发现其他任何重要物品。维德勒（Widler）被捕，并被责令于1934年2月25日前离开香港，否则将面临递解出境程序。他于该日启程前往广州，但于1934年2月28日搭乘“苏州”号轮船（s.s. "Soochow"）途经香港前往上海。在他离港后，警方获悉，维德勒在香港期间曾在当地报刊刊登广告，招聘女性在办公室任职或担任家庭女教师。有两位女士回应了这些广告，其情况已为本处所知，她们对维德勒的真实意图极为怀疑。他是朱利叶斯·瑟布塞克（Julius Serbousek）（见第32页）的同伙。

现已查明，上述人员曾于1927年在上海因使用伪造文件罪被判处三个月苦役（R.I.）。1928年，他因涉嫌拦路抢劫被捕，但获释。1933年，他因经营普通赌博场所被罚款30元。他正试图寻求进入香港或马来亚的许可，但不应批准此类许可。

82. 扬，詹姆斯·麦金托什（YOUNG, JAMES MACKINTOSH）。（第8/35段）。

伦敦音乐喜剧公司（London Musical Comedy Co.）的一名董事因一张怡保（Ipoh）发出的刑事背信逮捕令而被捕。控告人不愿继续诉讼，指控遂被撤销。扬曾在印度多年，其间致使卡尔·罗萨歌剧团（Carl Rosa Opera）的一个巡回演出团陷入困境。他曾在浦那（Poona）服刑四个月。他是一个不受欢迎的人，宁愿留下未付账单也不愿结清账目。他于1935年4月16日启程前往孟买。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C.S.6 App. S.B. Branch.
Date June 17, 19 37

REPO...

Subject Filipino Club at 258 Range Road.

Made by D.S. Kourjansky. Forwarded by N. Medvedeff, D.S.

I beg to report that on a recent visit of foreign lodging houses on Range Road, I noticed a "Room to let" signboard on the front wall of premises No. 258 Range Road.

The occupants did not apply for licence for operating the premises in question as a Foreign Lodging house, therefore, I interviewed the former when the following was ascertained:-

The above house has been rented on May 16, 1937 by a Filipino named Mr. Jesus Y. Iglesias, aged 32, on behalf of the Filipino Club known under the name of "Lipunang Filipino" of which he is the secretary.

The club is headed by a president named Mr. A.Y. Celis and consists of 42 members at present. According to the rules of the club, 85 % of the members must be of the Filipino nationality and the remainder, Chinese, Spanish, and Americans.

The club, it is stated, was organised for the purpose of social entertainments and it is understood, that "Mah Jong" and "Bridge" parties will be arranged for the members from time to time.

Mr. Iglesias stated that practically all the premises are occupied by the club with the exception of two attic rooms which they intend to let. According to Mr. Iglesias, application for permission for the club was recently submitted by them to the U.S.A. Consulate General.

I pointed out to Mr. Iglesias that since they have two rooms to let and that there is a possibility that in future they may change their mind and have a larger number of rooms to let, application to the S.M.C. on their part for licence for Foreign Lodging house would be necessary to which he replied that he will take the matter up with the committee.

D.C. (Special Branch)
D.S.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
刑事调查科第六股 特务分部。
日期 1937年6月17日

报告...

事由：兰思路258号的菲律宾人俱乐部。

制作人：D.S. Kourjansky。转呈人：N. Medvedeff，副督察。

谨此报告，在近期巡视兰思路的外侨寄宿舍时，我注意到兰思路258号 premises 的前墙上挂有“房间出租”的招牌。

该处 occupants 并未申请将该处作为外侨寄宿舍经营的执照，因此，我对前者进行了面谈，查明情况如下：-

上述房屋已于1937年5月16日由一名32岁的菲律宾人Jesus Y. Iglesias先生代表名为“Lipunang Filipino”的菲律宾人俱乐部租用，他担任该俱乐部的秘书。

该俱乐部由一名名为A.Y. Celis先生的主席领导，目前拥有42名会员。根据俱乐部章程，85%的会员必须为菲律宾国籍，其余为中国、西班牙和美国籍。

据称，该俱乐部的组织目的是进行社交娱乐活动，据了解，将不时为会员安排“麻将”和“桥牌”聚会。

Iglesias先生表示，实际上除了两间他们打算出租的阁楼房间外，所有场所均由俱乐部占用。据Iglesias先生称，他们最近已向美国总领事馆提交了俱乐部的许可申请。

我向Iglesias先生指出，既然他们有两间房间出租，且将来有可能改变主意，出租更多房间，因此他们需要向工部局申请外侨寄宿舍执照，对此他回答说将与委员会商讨此事。

刑事调查科科长（特务分部）
副督察

REPORT
Date... March ... 15 ... 1937.
Subject......... Particulars of Hotels and Lodging Houses called for by
Japanese Consular Police --- Report.
Made by .................... and .................... Forwarded by ......... D.S.I. Golder.

Reference to attached memo, dated February 25, 1937,
from D. C. (Japanese), relative to the compilation of data on
Hotels and Lodging Houses. I have to report that its submission
has been delayed owing to the inability of the Revenue Depart-
ment to help.
Of the Hotels, 27 are operated by Chinese; a few such
as the Park Hotel, etc., being of very high class, whilst 9 are
operated by foreigners.
In the category of premises listed as Lodging Houses
(Foreign) very few are now operated by foreign capital, it is,
however, usual for the Chinese owners to employ foreign
manageresses.
No distinction as to class is made, the licence fee
being general at $8.00 per half year.
In the matter of Chinese lodging houses the licences
are issued according to size, or number of rooms, but again no
distinction is made.
The term "Boarding House" is not at present used by
the S.M.C. in reference to the issuance of licences.

（批：D.B.R. 15/3.）
D. C. (J) （签名） / （签名：Liu Yocan）
As requested. D. S. I.

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 28, 1935

LEGAL DEFINITION OF
HOTEL SOUGHT

The word "hotel" should be pro-
perly defined and bona fide establish-
ments certificated by the Government.
said Sir Henry Kimber, chairman of
the Country Committee of the Hotels
and Restaurants Association, in a
speech at the Wine and Food Con-
ference at Bath.
He was anxious to see some
restriction put upon the word "hotel."
Many attempts had been made, with-
out success, to find a satisfactory de-
finition. Hotels, especially the small-
er ones, suffered a great deal from
the very unfair use of the word, and
some steps should be taken to stop
it.
An effective method could be found
by empowering a Government de-
partment to issue a certificate to
every establishment that could satisfy
it that it was a bona fide hotel, and
by making it illegal for anyone
without the certificate to call his
house a hotel.

File
MB
29 NOV. 1935

《字林西报》，1935年11月28日，星期四

寻求“旅馆”的法律定义

旅馆与餐馆协会乡村委员会主席亨利·金伯爵士在巴斯举行的酒食会议上发表演讲时称，“旅馆”一词应有恰当的定义，且真正的 establishments 应由政府颁发证书。
他希望能对“旅馆”一词的使用加以某些限制。此前曾多次尝试寻找令人满意的定义，但均未成功。旅馆，尤其是小型旅馆，因该词被极不公平地使用而深受其害，应采取某些措施予以制止。
一个有效的方法是授权政府部门向每一个能证明其为真正旅馆的机构颁发证书，并规定任何无此证书者将其房屋称为旅馆属非法行为。

档案
MB
1935年11月29日

June 7th, 1928.

Further REPORT ON Attached List of Cabarets, bars and cafes in Central District.

Made by D. I. Hunter. Forwarded by [签名].

( 1 ) Engley's Bar II Class. Licensee E. R. Engley.
British. Foreign Manager of Eddies Cafe, roadway.
Mr. Wadham, Manager, once convicted in British Court on charge of fraud, connected with roulette wheels in the French Concession a few years ago, and prior to coming to Shanghai, was a well known racing man in South China. Reported to be mixed up with arms dealers. Mr. Quiert. Russian never charged criminally has been mixed up in several civil cases. Reported to be connected with arms dealers. Engley's Bar principally frequented by both American and British Sailors and Soldiers, a few civilians in different lines of business also frequents the place, but cannot be classed amongst the upper ten.

( 2 ) Williams Hotel. II Class. Licensee D. Chelmis ( Greek ). Frequented by American and British Sailors and a few foreigners. Always conducted in a proper manner and the Manager Mr. Chelmis has on different occasions proved very useful to the Police.

( 3 ) Ladow's Tavern. II Class. Licensee L. Ladow.
American. Manager A. J. Israel ( British ) Lower floor managed by Walter Smith, American, also Manager of the Alcazar Cafe, French Concession. No immoral conduct takes place in the lower or upper portions of the premises, although it is well known that the girls employed there take their fancy guests home with them after closing hours. On the whole the Police have had very little trouble at this establishment with the exception of an occasional drunken brawl between American and British Sailors who patronise the lower portion. The upstairs Cabaret is patronised by a

英国人。Eddies Cafe（埃迪咖啡馆）的外籍经理，位于马路边。
Wadham 先生，经理，曾因欺诈罪在英国法院被判有罪，几年前与法租界的轮盘赌具有关联，在来上海之前，他是华南地区知名的赛马人士。据报与军火商有牵连。Quiert 先生。俄国人，从未被提起刑事诉讼，但卷入过几起民事案件。据报与军火商有牵连。Engley's Bar 主要顾客为美国和英国水兵及士兵，也有少数从事不同行业的平民光顾，但不能归入上流社会阶层。

( 2 ) Williams Hotel（威廉姆斯酒店）。二级执照。持照人 D. Chelmis（希腊人）。顾客为美国和英国水兵及少数外国人。经营一直规范得当，经理 Chelmis 先生曾多次证明对警方非常有用。

( 3 ) Ladow's Tavern（拉多酒馆）。二级执照。持照人 L. Ladow。

“B”区巡官。

当静安寺捕房的侦探有空调查时，我很乐意了解以下情况。
此事不急，信息应机密获取：-

Del Monte Cafe（德尔蒙特咖啡馆）。
1. 那里是否有赌博活动？
2. 那里是否有不道德行为？
3. 是否有女性是警方“熟知”的？
4. 外籍男性雇员有哪些？

St. Georges Hotel（圣乔治酒店）。
1. 经常光顾者中，哪些人是警方“熟知”的，或者从我们的角度来看名声不佳。
2. 是否严格遵守执照条件，特别是关于打烊时间？
3. 是否有不道德行为？
4. 女性是否为人所知，属于什么类型？
（可疑人员可机密提及）。
5. 是否有大量扰乱秩序的行为？
6. 是否有外籍雇员？

Welcome Cafe（欢迎咖啡馆）。
1. 公园关闭后，此地是否被用作幽会场所？
2. 夜间是否有访客或士兵等占用房间？

Picnic Cafe（野餐咖啡馆）。
1. 是否有房间出租给公众？
2. 是否有外籍雇员？
3. 场所夜间是否开放？
4. 业主是否为人“熟知”？

西摩路91号。
学生是谁？
进一步了解他们。美国海军陆战队队员与中国学生之间的联系似乎很奇特。

June 12th 1928.

Sir, I beg to forward the following as
the result of my investigations on the
attached enquiry.

Del Monte Cafe.
No gambling is known to be conducted on
the premises, although owing to the locality
of the cafe and to the large amount of
spare rooms in the upstairs portion of the
premises, there may be occasional nights
when private gambling is indulged in by
a few of the patrons. No immoral conduct
is conducted on the premises as the class
of "Dancing Partners" employed there is of
a type superior to those employed in
other cafes. Many of them however are
kept by foreigners of the wealthier class in
Shanghai, while not a few of them work
to keep their families. Mr. J. Hyde, an
american citizen has been manager of the
Del Monte for several years, and to appearance
the premises are well conducted. No other
foreigners are employed.

St. Georges Cafe.
This cafe was formerly owned by an
naturalized American citizen, named
Fredericks, who died about two years
ago, the business being handed over

档案号
1928年6月12日。

先生，谨呈上附件查询事项的调查结果如下。

德尔蒙特咖啡馆（Del Monte Cafe）。
据知该场所内并未进行赌博活动，尽管鉴于咖啡馆的地理位置以及楼上部分有大量空闲房间，偶尔可能会有少数顾客在私下进行赌博。该场所内未发生不道德行为，因为那里雇用的“舞伴”阶层优于其他咖啡馆所雇用的人员。然而，她们中许多人被上海较富裕阶层的外国人包养，而不少人工作是为了养家糊口。美国公民 J. Hyde 先生担任德尔蒙特咖啡馆经理已有数年，从表面看，该场所经营良好。未雇用其他外国人。

圣乔治咖啡馆（St. Georges Cafe）。
这家咖啡馆以前归一位名为 Fredericks 的入籍美国公民所有，他于大约两年前去世，生意随后移交

page_data.en:
to his kept women, who disposed of it to her
manager and paramour E. Bartels, a
German citizen. Bartels then carried on
the business and allowed it to develope
into a low class dancing saloon, which
was largely patronized by British and
American soldiers and sailors. Fight between
the members of the above nationalities was
a common occurrence and on several
occasions the premises were placed "Out of
Bounds" to British and American troops.
The dancing girls, employed in this cafe
at that time, were nearly all prostitutes,
and while no actual prostitution was ever
committed on the premises arrangements
were made by visitors to the cafe, whereby
they met the girls on their leaving the premises
and escorted them to their homes, chiefly in
Avenue Joffre, for the purpose of sexual
intercourse. It is not known that gambling
was ever permitted on the premises. Recently
the premises were disposed of to Jimmy James,
an American citizen and proprietor of the
several places in Shanghai, known as
Gimmy's Kitchen. Bartels was retained
by J. James, as his manager, and the
premises are now conducted in a greatly
improved manner, only Beer, cocktails
and light wines being sold on the
premises for consumption. There are
page_data.zh: 给其包养的情妇，后者将其转卖给了她的经理兼情夫 E. Bartels，一名德国公民。Bartels 随后继续经营该生意，并任其发展成为一家低档舞厅，主要顾客为英美士兵和水手。上述国籍人员之间的斗殴事件屡见不鲜，且有数次该场所被对英美军队宣布为“禁入区”。当时在该咖啡馆雇用的舞女几乎全是妓女，虽然场所内从未发生过实际的卖淫行为，但咖啡馆的访客会安排在其离开场所时与女孩见面，并将她们护送至家中（主要在霞飞路），以进行性交。据知该场所内从未允许赌博。最近，该场所被转卖给美国公民 Jimmy James，他是上海多家名为“吉米厨房”（Gimmy's Kitchen）的场所的所有者。J. James 留用 Bartels 作为其经理，目前该场所的经营状况大有改善，仅在场所内出售啤酒、鸡尾酒和淡葡萄酒供消费。现有

Welcome Cafe.
This cafe is owned by a former Chinese
boy named S. F. Chan, who is also

rooms available for this purpose. No
foreigners are employed and the premises
are patronized by foreigners and Chinese
alike, most of whom are visitors to
Jessfield Park in the afternoons. The
cafe is also well patronized in the
summer evenings by visitors touring
round the outlying roads of the Western
District. in motor cars. No dancing
partners are employed in this cafe.

This cafe adjoins the Welcome cafe

On 26-5-28, The Wellington Cafe, 37 Brenan Road

a respectable class, mostly visitors to Jessfield Park.

The St. Georges Hotel, 352 Bubbling Well Road opened

Georges". The license is still issued in the name of
the owner of the place, S.G.Hertzberg. The former
proprietor, C.A.Kartels, German, is now manager. A
Russian woman, Mrs Rimer, is employed as a kind of
housekeeper. A fee of $1.00 is now charged for admission.

partners. Since opening, the place seems to be well
conducted and the license conditions adhered to. It is

sea-faring class. Two foreign assistant managers are employed
in the bar (one an American named J. Logan, the other a Britisher
named Billy Hodges) both have been in Shanghai for a number of
years, at one time were connected with the "Wheel", 24 North
Honan Road Extension. The dancing girls in the cabaret are
mostly Russians of the usual type, to be found in Shanghai
cabarets. The licensee A. Popovitch is also a long resident of
Shanghai and was connected with the old gambling resort "Alambra"
years ago. Occasionally foreigners of the undesirable type reside
at the hotel, who find it convenient for a short stay. The hotel,
cabaret and bar appears to be well controlled, no complaints are
ever received or made to the Police, neither have the Police had
occasion to interfere or warn the management. No comment.
86 Broadway. Eddie Cafe. Patrons are mixed, of all nationalities,
and occupation. The dancing girls are the usual type and nearly
all Russians. A British manager named E. Engley, formerly a
Sergeant in the S.M.P. is in charge of the restaurant. A Russian
in charge of the cabaret, and an American in charge of the bar.
There are frequent changes in the last two mentioned positions,
and it is difficult to form an opinion of them. The place is
well under control and no complaints are received. No comments.
Nos. 86 and 96 Broadway are the only places where dancing girls
are engaged the average number in each place is 10, but these are
increased or decreased according to business requirements and their
engagement is not permanent.
119 Range Road. Hotel Royal. A residential and family hotel of
good reputation. No comments.
2 Yuhang Road. St. Diago. A low class restaurant. The proprietor
has many convictions for white slave traffic, opium and arms
smuggling. Patrons are mostly sea-faring men and the place is also
frequented by women of loose morals. A license was given to the
proprietor, so that the police could have a better control over the
place. No complaints have been received since this place has been
licensed.
page_data.zh:
百老汇路96号。萨伏伊酒店（Savoy Hotel）。顾客混杂，但大多为海员阶层。酒吧雇有两名外籍副经理（一名是美国人，名叫 J. Logan，另一名是英国人，名叫 Billy Hodges），两人均在上海居住多年，曾一度与河南北路延伸段24号的“Wheel”有关联。舞厅内的舞女大多是上海舞厅中常见的那种俄国女性。持牌人 A. Popovitch 也是上海的长期居民，多年前曾与老赌场“Alambra”有关联。偶尔有不受欢迎类型的外国人居住在酒店，觉得此处便于短期停留。酒店、舞厅和酒吧似乎管理良好，从未收到或向警方提出投诉，警方也未曾有必要介入或警告管理层。无评论。
百老汇路86号。Eddie 咖啡馆。顾客混杂，来自各国及各行业。舞女是常见类型，几乎全是俄国人。餐厅由一位名叫 E. Engley 的英国经理负责，他曾是上海公共租界工部局警务处的巡长。舞厅由一名俄国人负责，酒吧由一名美国人负责。后两个职位的人员变动频繁，很难对他们形成看法。该场所管控良好，未收到投诉。无评论。
百老汇路86号和96号是唯一雇佣舞女的场所，每处平均人数为10人，但会根据业务需求增减，且雇佣关系并非永久性的。
兰思路119号。皇家酒店（Hotel Royal）。一家声誉良好的住宅及家庭式酒店。无评论。
余杭路2号。St. Diago。一家低档餐厅。业主有多次因贩卖白奴、鸦片和武器走私而被定罪的记录。顾客大多为海员，该处也常有行为不检的女性光顾。向业主颁发了执照，以便警方更好地控制该场所。自该处获得执照以来，未收到投诉。

page_data.en:
Detective opinion - A place which requires constant observation.
258 Boone Road patrons are mostly American Naval
men. Little business is done and the proprietor intends closing down.
31 Seward Road. Crystal Cafe. The proprietor is a noted arms smug-
gler and the place is often frequented by men who are known to the
police as dealer in arms, which includes also Chinese.
Detective opinion - A place which requires constant observation.
24 Haining Road. "Jocks Bar". The real proprietor and manager is a
Chinese, formerly employed as a boy in West Hongkew Station. It is
a small bar, attached to the Victoria Cinema. Patrons are mixed.
No comments.
1 - 3 Miller Road. "Franks Grill". Patrons are mixed and mostly
U.S.Naval men. The place is well under control. No comments.
23/4 N. Szechuen Road. Hongkew Hotel. This place is under Chinese
management, and patrons are chiefly Chinese, although occasionally
visited by foreigners. The place seems to be well controlled,
although at times the undesirable type of Chinese gains admission,
when usually gambling takes place, it is also visited by Chinese
females of loose morals, but if detected by the management, they are
quickly expelled, which at times requires police assistance.
Detective opinion - regular visits by detectives are required.
7/7a/8a Woochang Road. Linam Hotel. A Chinese hotel under Chinese
management, frequented mostly by Cantonese and occasionally by
foreigners accompanied by women of loose morals of all nationalities
Detective opinion - requires constant observation.
75 Broadway. A German restaurant, frequented by
foreigners of all nationalities. A place where good food and drinks
are served. No comments.
6a N. Soochow Road. Same as above (75 Broadway)
39 Seward Road. Same as 31 Seward Road. Needs constant
observation. Detective opinion - a doubtful place.
154 Range Road. A Russian restaurant, frequented by the Russian
Criminal classes. The proprietor is an ex-convict from Siberia,
and a license was given to this man, so that police could have a
better control over the place. Detective opinion - constant
observation required.
page_data.zh:
探员意见 - 一个需要持续观察的场所。
蓬路258号，顾客大多为美国海军人员。生意清淡，业主打算停业。
西华德路31号。Crystal 咖啡馆。业主是著名的武器走私商，该处常受警方熟知的武器经销商（包括中国人）光顾。
探员意见 - 一个需要持续观察的场所。
海宁路24号。“Jocks Bar”。真正的业主兼经理是一名中国人，以前曾在西虹口捕房当听差。这是一家附属于维多利亚电影院的小酒吧。顾客混杂。无评论。
密勒路1-3号。“Franks Grill”。顾客混杂，大多为美国海军人员。该处管控良好。无评论。
北四川路23/4号。虹口大酒店。该处由中国人管理，顾客主要是中国人，虽然偶尔也有外国人光顾。该处似乎管控良好，尽管有时不受欢迎的华人混入，通常进行赌博，也有行为不检的中国女性光顾，但若被管理层发现，她们会被迅速驱逐，有时这需要警方协助。
探员意见 - 需要探员定期走访。
武昌路7/7a/8a号。Linam 酒店。一家由中国人管理的中国酒店，顾客大多为广东人，偶尔也有由各国籍行为不检女性陪同的外国人光顾。
探员意见 - 需要持续观察。
百老汇路75号。一家德国餐厅，受各国籍外国人光顾。这是一家提供优质食物和饮料的场所。无评论。
北苏州路6a号。同上（百老汇路75号）
西华德路39号。同西华德路31号。需要持续观察。探员意见 - 一个可疑的场所。
兰思路154号。一家俄国餐厅，受俄国犯罪阶层光顾。业主是西伯利亚的前罪犯，向此人颁发执照是为了让警方能更好地控制该场所。探员意见 - 需要持续观察。

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 1249/6
C.S.6, Special Branch. /Sundry/ 111
REPORT
Date April 5, 1941.
Subject Reported Unlawful Activities in Foreign Lodging House No.2, Lane 1025,
(Hwa Kee Avenue), Bubbling Well Road.
Made by D.S. Mischenko. Forwarded by C.D.I. Tabrum.

I have to report that whilst inspecting
House No.2, Lane 1025, Bubbling Well Road, Mrs.C.I.
ZRITNEFF, the licensee of the house, informed me that
she suspects the occupant of Room No.2, a Korean,
registered under the name of Li Sz Ying, 30 years old,
merchant, of dealing in narcotics.
According to Mrs.C.I.Zritneff and her adult
son Mr.Victor Zritneff, the said Korean is visited daily
by a large number of Orientals - also suspicious looking
characters; the visitors using the front gate leading
directly into the room of the Korean tenant who is living
in the room together with his wife and two children and
employs one female Chinese servant.
It is reported that the said Korean although
unemployed appears to be quite prosperous at present.
The rent for the room is paid regularly and there is no
evidence to show that Mrs.C.I.Zritneff imparted the
information with a view to get rid of the tenant in
order to obtain a higher rent for the room.

D. Mischenko
D. S.

A.C.(Special Branch).

机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 1249/6
C.S.6，特别处。/杂项/ 111
报告
日期：1941年4月5日。
事由：据报静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）华基路（Hwa Kee Avenue）1025弄2号外侨寄宿公寓内的非法活动。
报告人：警佐 Mischenko。转呈人：刑事侦缉督察 Tabrum。

兹报告，本人在检查静安寺路1025弄2号时，该公寓持照人 C.I. ZRITNEFF 女士告知本人，她怀疑居住在2号房间的房客、一名登记姓名为 Li Sz Ying、30岁、职业为商人的朝鲜人从事毒品交易。

据 C.I. Zritneff 女士及其成年儿子 Victor Zritneff 先生称，该朝鲜人每日均有大量东方人——且多为形迹可疑之徒——前来拜访；访客使用直接通向该朝鲜房客房间的前门。该房客与其妻子及两名子女同住该房间，并雇佣一名中国女佣。

据报，该朝鲜人虽无业，但目前似乎相当富裕。房租按时缴纳，且并无证据表明 C.I. Zritneff 女士提供此信息是意图驱逐租客以便提高该房间租金。

D. Mischenko
警佐

助理处长（特别处）。
